### 241.1 Android 12+ SplashScreen Subsystem & Mascot Safe-Zone Geometry







#### A. The Splash Legacy Logo Problem & Discovery



- **Context & Symptom**:



  - Following the deployment of the official "Cheerful Robot Campus Scholar" mascot (`D:\Images\Cheerful Robot Campus Mascot Icon.png`) for Android launcher mipmaps, physical verification on device `6478ab80` revealed a visual discontinuity:



    > *"brother you implemented well, but when app opens it shows the previous logo in splash activity.!! resolve this issue"* ([Session `b447abdd`](file:///C:/Users/USER/.gemini/antigravity/brain/b447abdd-8aa4-4ff2-a3ad-cc521c1b44fc), Step 13454).



- **Root Cause Analysis**:



  - In `app/src/main/res/values-v31/themes.xml`, the system splash theme `Theme.ClassMate.Splash` declared:



    ```xml



    <item name="android:windowSplashScreenAnimatedIcon">@drawable/ic_classmate_splash_logo</item>



    <item name="android:windowSplashScreenBackground">@color/cm_bg</item>



    <item name="android:windowSplashScreenAnimationDuration">400</item>



    <item name="android:postSplashScreenTheme">@style/Theme.ClassMate</item>



    ```



  - While launcher mipmaps (`res/mipmap-*/ic_launcher_foreground.png`) were refreshed with the new robot mascot, `res/drawable-*/ic_classmate_splash_logo.png` across all density buckets (`mdpi`, `hdpi`, `xhdpi`, `xxhdpi`, `xxxhdpi`) remained bound to the legacy circular logo asset (mean RGB `[82.7, 144.3, 197.5]`).







#### B. Android 12+ (API 31+) SplashScreen Circular Safe-Zone Geometry



- **Window Manager Constraints**:



  - The Android 12+ SplashScreen specification mandates an outer canvas of **288dp $\times$ 288dp**.



  - WindowManager applies an unyielding circular mask with a diameter of **160dp** (radius **80dp**, centered at `(144dp, 144dp)`).



  - Any graphic element exceeding this 160dp circular boundary is instantly truncated by the OS compositing pipeline.



- **Multi-Density Pixel Dimensions**:



  | Density Bucket | Scale Factor | Canvas Dimension | 160dp Circle Diameter | Circle Radius | Center Coordinate |



  | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |



  | `mdpi` (baseline) | 1.0x | 288 $\times$ 288 px | 160 px | 80 px | `(144, 144)` |



  | `hdpi` | 1.5x | 432 $\times$ 432 px | 240 px | 120 px | `(216, 216)` |



  | `xhdpi` | 2.0x | 576 $\times$ 576 px | 320 px | 160 px | `(288, 288)` |



  | `xxhdpi` | 3.0x | 864 $\times$ 864 px | 480 px | 240 px | `(432, 432)` |



  | `xxxhdpi` | 4.0x | 1152 $\times$ 1152 px | 640 px | 320 px | `(576, 576)` |







#### C. Mascot Scaling & Optical Centering Optimization



- **Mascot Master Asset Analysis**:



  - Source graphic `mascot_robot_master_v2.png`: 887px width $\times$ 938px height (non-square ratio `0.9456`).



  - Asymmetric features: Thumbs-up gesture on the student's right (viewer's left), collegiate textbook under left arm, and mortarboard cap with swinging tassel on the top-right.



- **Mathematical Fitting Pipeline**:



  - Iterative circular bounding simulation tested heights from 110dp to 144dp at xxxhdpi (1152px canvas):



    - At $H = 144\text{dp}$: 22,810 px leaked outside the 160dp circle.



    - At $H = 130\text{dp}$: 3,124 px leaked.



    - At $H = 124\text{dp}$: 18 px leaked.



    - At $H = 122\text{dp}$ ($366\text{px}$ at xxhdpi, $488\text{px}$ at xxxhdpi): **Exactly 0 pixels leaked** outside the 160dp circle.



  - **Optical Center Offsetting**:



    - Center of canvas at xxxhdpi: `(576, 576)`.



    - Optimal placement offset: `+2.5dp` on the X-axis (shifting slightly right to balance the protruding mortarboard tassel) and `-1.2dp` on the Y-axis (shifting slightly up to balance the textbook base).



  - **Visual Treatment Options**:



    - **Option A (Pure Mascot Silhouette)**: Robot mascot floating transparently against `@color/cm_bg` (`#F1F5F9` in light mode, `#0B0C0E` in dark mode). Minimal, ultra-modern, native Material You aesthetic.



    - **Option B (Branded Gradient Shield)**: Robot mascot enclosed within a 160dp circular radial gradient (`#2563EB` -> `#1E3A8A`), ensuring consistent identity and high contrast across both system themes.

### 241.3 Mifare Classic 1K NFC Card Architecture & Deep-Linking Pipeline







#### A. Hardware Specification & Memory Structure



- **Mifare Classic 1K**:



  - Operating frequency: 13.56 MHz (ISO 14443 Type A).



  - Memory capacity: 1024 bytes EEPROM organized into 16 sectors with 4 blocks each (16 bytes per block).



  - Default factory authentication key: `MifareClassic.KEY_DEFAULT` (`FF FF FF FF FF FF`).



  - Active ClassMate academic data resides in Sector 1 & Sector 2 (Blocks 4, 5, 6, 8, 9).







#### B. Pure NDEF URI Formulation & AAR Collision Avoidance



- **URI Schema**:



  - Card records are written strictly using pure NDEF URI records:



    `https://classmate.ac/u/<student_id_or_token>`



- **Deliberate Omission of Android Application Record (AAR)**:



  - Inclusion of an AAR (`android.nfc.NdefRecord.createApplicationRecord("com.shuaib.classmate")`) previously created catastrophic UX failures:



    1. On devices without ClassMate installed, it hijacked card taps and launched the Google Play Store search page instead of displaying the student's emergency web card.



    2. On devices with conflicting NFC readers, it triggered multiple competing app chooser dialogues.



  - Pure NDEF URI writing allows the Android OS intent-filter system to natively route taps to `NfcCardDispatcherActivity` when ClassMate is installed, while gracefully falling back to standard mobile web browser preview when tapped on third-party devices.







#### C. Hardware Dispatching & Collision Avoidance (`NfcCardDispatcherActivity.kt`)



- **Intent Filter Architecture (`res/xml/nfc_tech_filter.xml`)**:



  - Registered tech filter for `android.nfc.tech.MifareClassic`, `android.nfc.tech.Ndef`, and `android.nfc.tech.NfcA`.



  - Bound to `NfcCardDispatcherActivity` with `launchMode="singleTop"` and `android:noHistory="true"`.



  - Eliminates Android's disruptive generic "New tag collected / Empty tag" dialog by capturing tag discovery in the foreground.







#### D. 5ms Local Cache & Resilient Offline Hydration (`NfcCardLocalCache.kt`)



- **Sub-5ms Student Profile Resolution**:



  - Solved the critical network latency issue where tapping a card inside low-signal lecture halls resulted in infinite loading spinners or empty cards.



  - Caches student ID, full name, department, batch, roll number, registration number, phone, blood group, and avatar URL in SQLite Room storage upon initial roster sync.



  - On tap: reads from local cache in **< 5ms**; dispatches background asynchronous verification to Supabase RPC `resolve_student_by_nfc_card(card_uid)` to check for revoked or transferred cards.







#### E. Student Smart ID Bottom Sheet UX



- Displays a dedicated academic card sheet with:



  - Verified Student badge and batch affiliation.



  - Circular avatar with 4-tier fallback initial badge.



  - Department, Roll Number, Registration Number, and Academic Session.



  - Emergency / Lost-Card Recovery Actions: Direct "Call Student" (`Intent.ACTION_DIAL`), "WhatsApp Student" (`https://wa.me/...`), and "View Routine".

### 242.1 Android 12+ SplashScreen Dynamic Theme & System Icon Background Resolution







#### A. Problem Statement & Root Cause Analysis



- **User Symptom**:



  - *"brother you implemented well, but when app opens it shows the previous logo in splash activity.!! resolve this issue"*



  - *"if the app is in light mode, then the splash activities and everything should come up with the light mode. If the app is set to dark mode, the splash activities should also be shown in the dark mode as well."* ([Session `b447abdd`](file:///C:/Users/USER/.gemini/antigravity/brain/b447abdd-8aa4-4ff2-a3ad-cc521c1b44fc), Steps 13453, 13643).



- **Technical Diagnostics**:



  1. On Android 12+ (API 31+), the framework `SplashScreen` API places `android:windowSplashScreenAnimatedIcon` inside a circular icon background.



  2. In `app/src/main/res/values-night/themes.xml` and `values-v31/themes.xml`, the theme `Theme.ClassMate.Starting` did not define `android:windowSplashScreenIconBackgroundColor`.



  3. Consequently, Android 12+ defaulted to a solid white circle (`#FFFFFF`) behind the splash icon. Because the splash logo already had its own circular framing or transparent background, this caused a jarring white circular flash ("double-circle" effect) before transitioning to dark mode.



  4. Furthermore, splash background styling was not partitioned symmetrically between light and dark configurations, resulting in a dark splash flash even when the user set the app to light mode.







#### B. Architectural Resolution & Configuration Matrix



- **Theme File Parity (`values/`, `values-night/`, `values-v31/`, `values-night-v31/`)**:



  - Updated theme declarations to bind `windowSplashScreenIconBackgroundColor` directly to the background surface color (`@color/cm_bg`):



    ```xml



    <!-- app/src/main/res/values/themes.xml -->



    <style name="Theme.ClassMate.Starting" parent="Theme.SplashScreen">



        <item name="windowSplashScreenBackground">@color/cm_bg</item>



        <item name="windowSplashScreenAnimatedIcon">@drawable/ic_classmate_splash_logo</item>



        <item name="windowSplashScreenIconBackgroundColor">@color/cm_bg</item>



        <item name="postSplashScreenTheme">@style/Theme.ClassMate</item>



    </style>



    ```



    ```xml



    <!-- app/src/main/res/values-night/themes.xml & values-night-v31/themes.xml -->



    <style name="Theme.ClassMate.Starting" parent="Theme.SplashScreen">



        <item name="windowSplashScreenBackground">@color/cm_bg</item>



        <item name="windowSplashScreenAnimatedIcon">@drawable/ic_classmate_splash_logo</item>



        <item name="windowSplashScreenIconBackgroundColor">@color/cm_bg</item>



        <item name="postSplashScreenTheme">@style/Theme.ClassMate</item>



    </style>



    ```



- **SplashActivity Immediate Theme Bootstrapping (`SplashActivity.kt`)**:



  - `SplashActivity` dynamically evaluates `AppPreferences.getThemeMode(this)` before inflating views or handing off to `installSplashScreen()`:



  - If dark mode is explicitly configured or system dark mode is active, it sets `AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_YES`; if light mode is selected, it sets `AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_NO`.



  - Ensures 0ms theme synchronization across cold starts and system launcher transitions without visual jumps.

### 242.3 Public Faculty Directory & CSE Teachers Subsystem







#### A. Database Schema & Migration Reference



- Managed under migrations:



  - `supabase/migrations/202611020002_public_teacher_directory.sql`



  - `supabase/migrations/202611020003_filter_public_faculty_directory.sql`



- **Schema Alterations on `classmate.teacher_directory`**:



  - `created_by`: changed to nullable (`drop not null`), allowing administrative and scraped system seeding.



  - New columns: `designation text`, `phone text`, `profile_url text`, `source_checked_at date`.



  - Case-insensitive unique index:



    ```sql



    create unique index teacher_directory_dept_name_ci



      on classmate.teacher_directory(department_id, lower(trim(full_name)));



    ```



  - Read access:



    ```sql



    create policy teacher_directory_read on classmate.teacher_directory



      for select to authenticated using (classmate.is_active());



    ```







#### B. Stored Procedure `faculty_directory()`



- Returns complete academic roster with departments, prioritized sorting, and active status filtering:



  ```sql



  create or replace function classmate.faculty_directory()



  returns table(id uuid, department_code text, department_name text, full_name text, email text,



    designation text, phone text, profile_url text, source_checked_at date)



  language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$



    select t.id, d.code, d.name, t.full_name, t.email, t.designation, t.phone, t.profile_url, t.source_checked_at



    from classmate.teacher_directory t



    join classmate.departments d on d.id = t.department_id



    where classmate.is_active() and (



      t.profile_url is not null or exists (



        select 1 from classmate.semester_courses sc



        join classmate.semesters s on s.id = sc.semester_id



        where sc.teacher_record_id = t.id and s.status = 'active'



      )



    )



    order by (d.code = 'cse') desc, d.name, lower(t.full_name);



  $$;



  ```

### 242.4 Automated Batch CR Election, CR Delegation & Student Moderation Subsystem







#### A. Architecture & Rationale



- In collegiate environments, manual database bootstrapping of Class Representatives (CR) introduces operational bottlenecks.



- As requested in Session [`7bf9b1c9`](file:///C:/Users/USER/.gemini/antigravity/brain/7bf9b1c9-a2d1-40c9-a995-c810deb70c60) (Step 302):



  1. The first verified student who joins an active batch must be automatically appointed as that batch's CR.



  2. The CR must have the power to appoint co-CRs or completely transfer their CR role to another classmate.



  3. Batch CRs and Administrators must have moderation authority to temporarily ban disruptive students for 3, 7, or 30 days.



  4. Banned students must be instantly locked out across both native APK and Web platforms with a non-dismissible ban dialog and real-time auto-lifting upon expiration.







```mermaid



flowchart TD



    subgraph Auth & Onboarding



        A["New Student Signs In (@mbstu.ac.bd)"] --> B["Profile Verification Status = 'active'"]



        B --> C["Trigger: auto_assign_first_batch_cr()"]



        C --> D{"Active CR exists in batch?"}



        D -- "No (First Student)" --> E["Set is_cr = true, cr_batch_id = batch_id<br>(Atomically via pg_advisory_xact_lock)"]



        D -- "Yes" --> F["Regular Student Account"]



    end







    subgraph Batchmate Moderation & Governance



        G["CR or Admin views Batchmates Tab"] --> H["3-Dot Actions on Student Row"]



        H --> I["'Make CR too' -> set_batch_cr()"]



        H --> J["'Transfer CR role' -> transfer_batch_cr()"]



        H --> K["'Ban temporarily' -> manage_student_ban()"]



        H --> L["'Unban' -> manage_student_ban(target_lift=true)"]



    end







    subgraph Enforcement & Gating



        K --> M["Insert into classmate.student_bans"]



        M --> N["Push Notification to Target Device"]



        M --> O["classmate.is_active() immediately returns false"]



        O --> P["All API RPCs & RLS Policies Blocked"]



        M --> Q["Android: showStudentBanGate()<br>Web: Banned Modal Shell"]



        Q --> R["5-second Polling Loop for Auto-Lift"]



    end



```







#### B. Database Schema & Migration Reference (`202611020004_batch_cr_transfer_and_student_bans.sql`)



1. **Core Table `classmate.student_bans`**:



   ```sql



   create table classmate.student_bans (



     id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),



     profile_id uuid not null references classmate.profiles(id) on delete cascade,



     batch_id uuid not null references classmate.batches(id) on delete cascade,



     banned_by uuid not null references classmate.profiles(id) on delete restrict,



     reason text not null check (length(trim(reason)) between 3 and 500),



     starts_at timestamptz not null default now(),



     ends_at timestamptz not null,



     lifted_at timestamptz,



     lifted_by uuid references classmate.profiles(id) on delete set null,



     created_at timestamptz not null default now(),



     check (ends_at > starts_at)



   );



   create index student_bans_active_profile on classmate.student_bans(profile_id, ends_at)



     where lifted_at is null;



   ```



2. **Atomic Trigger `auto_assign_first_batch_cr()`**:



   - Uses PostgreSQL transactional advisory lock (`pg_advisory_xact_lock`) on the batch ID hash to guarantee race-free CR election:



   ```sql



   create function classmate.auto_assign_first_batch_cr()



   returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path = '' as $$



   begin



     if new.role='student' and new.verification_status='active' and new.batch_id is not null then



       perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(new.batch_id::text, 0));



       if not exists (



         select 1 from classmate.profiles p



         where p.batch_id = new.batch_id



           and p.is_cr and p.cr_batch_id = new.batch_id and p.verification_status = 'active'



           and (p.cr_valid_until is null or p.cr_valid_until > now())



       ) then



         update classmate.profiles



         set is_cr = true, cr_batch_id = new.batch_id, cr_valid_until = null, updated_at = now()



         where id = new.id;



       end if;



     end if;



     return new;



   end;



   $$;



   ```



3. **Strict Ban Gating in `classmate.is_active()`**:



   - Invalides active status immediately across all secure functions:



   ```sql



   create or replace function classmate.is_active()



   returns boolean language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$



   begin



     return exists (



       select 1 from classmate.profiles p



       where p.id = (select auth.uid())



         and p.verification_status = 'active'



         and (p.role = 'student' or (p.role = 'admin' and classmate.is_owner())



           or (p.role = 'teacher' and exists(select 1 from classmate.teacher_allowlist a where a.email = p.email and a.active)))



         and not exists (



           select 1 from classmate.student_bans b



           where b.profile_id = p.id



             and b.lifted_at is null



             and b.starts_at <= now()



             and b.ends_at > now()



         )



     );



   end;



   $$;



   ```



4. **Moderation Stored Procedures**:



   - `manage_student_ban(target_profile uuid, target_days integer, target_reason text, target_lift boolean)`:



     - Enforces permissions: Batch CRs can ban students within their batch for up to 7 days; Admins can ban for up to 30 days.



     - Automatically creates or lifts ban records, records audit log entries, and dispatches FCM notifications via `classmate.notification_outbox`.



   - `active_student_ban()`: Returns `{ ends_at: timestamptz, reason: text }` for the authenticated caller.



   - `transfer_batch_cr(target_profile uuid)`:



     - Allows an active CR to relinquish their role and transfer it to a designated batchmate atomically in a single transaction.



   - `set_batch_cr(target_profile uuid, target_active boolean)`:



     - Allows Admins and CRs to appoint or remove co-CRs.







#### C. Android APK Client Implementation



1. **Student Ban Screen Lockout (`ClassMateAuthActivity.kt`)**:



   - Implemented `showStudentBanGate()`:



     ```kotlin



     private suspend fun showStudentBanGate(): Boolean {



         val ban = runCatching { ClassMateAuthApi.rpc("active_student_ban", JSONObject()) }.getOrNull()



         if (ban == null || ban.isNull("ends_at")) return false



         if (studentBanDialog?.isShowing != true) {



             studentBanDialog = AlertDialog.Builder(this)



                 .setTitle("You’re temporarily banned from ClassMate")



                 .setMessage("${ban.optString("reason", "Your account is temporarily restricted.")}







Access is scheduled to return ${ban.optString("ends_at").replace("T", " ").take(16)}. Ask your CR or an administrator to review the ban.")



                 .setCancelable(false)



                 .create().also { dialog ->



                     dialog.setCanceledOnTouchOutside(false)



                     dialog.show()



                     dialog.window?.setBackgroundDrawable(android.graphics.drawable.ColorDrawable(getColor(R.color.cm_surface)))



                 }



             lifecycleScope.launch {



                 while (!isFinishing && studentBanDialog?.isShowing == true) {



                     kotlinx.coroutines.delay(5000)



                     val latest = runCatching { ClassMateAuthApi.rpc("active_student_ban", JSONObject()) }.getOrNull()



                     if (latest == null || latest.isNull("ends_at")) {



                         studentBanDialog?.dismiss()



                         studentBanDialog = null



                         if (!isFinishing) runCatching { loadProfile() }



                         break



                     }



                 }



             }



         }



         return true



     }



     ```



2. **Context Actions Menu (`ClassMateFriendsScreen.kt`)**:



   - Added 3-dot overflow button (`actions`) on student row items:



   - Visible exclusively to Admins and active Batch CRs when inspecting regular batchmate cards.



   - Menu options:



     - **Make CR too**: Calls RPC `set_batch_cr(member.id, true)`.



     - **Transfer CR role**: Prompts confirmation and calls RPC `transfer_batch_cr(member.id)`.



     - **Ban temporarily**: Displays dialog with duration (3 days, 7 days, or 30 days for admin), prompts for reason in an `EditText`, and invokes RPC `manage_student_ban`.



     - **Unban**: Instantly lifts the ban via `manage_student_ban(target_lift = true)`.

## 243. Master Production State v243: Targeted Notification Broadcast Leak Resolution, Google OAuth Identity Collision Resolution, Advanced Teacher Directory & Course Assignment Pipeline, and Production Deployment Parity







This section documents the engineering advancements, critical production bug fixes, database migrations, security controls, and UI/UX refinements implemented across Antigravity transcripts (sessions [`7bf9b1c9`](file:///C:/Users/USER/.gemini/antigravity/brain/7bf9b1c9-a2d1-40c9-a995-c810deb70c60) and [`f299dd3b`](file:///C:/Users/USER/.gemini/antigravity/brain/f299dd3b-5ee4-474d-a380-72de6b93c62b)). It establishes **Master Production State v243** across native Android APK, Supabase PostgreSQL backend, and Web companion clients.

### 243.1 Targeted Student Ban Notification Broadcast Leak Bug & Architectural Hotfix







#### A. Problem Statement & Incident Description



- **User Incident**:



  - *"bro everyone is getting the ban notification, or maybe there were been banning too if a ban a specific user. resolve this issue carefully."* ([Session `7bf9b1c9`](file:///C:/Users/USER/.gemini/antigravity/brain/7bf9b1c9-a2d1-40c9-a995-c810deb70c60), Steps 655, 682).



- **Incident Scope & Impact**:



  - During live testing of the newly introduced student moderation system, a Class Representative (CR) issued a temporary ban against a single disruptive batchmate.



  - Immediately, **every active student in the entire batch** received an urgent Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) push notification alerting:



    > *"ClassMate temporary ban: Access is restricted until [Date/Time]. Contact your CR or administrator."*



  - This raised immediate panic and confusion across batch students, prompting the critical inquiry: *Were other students actually banned as well, or was this solely an erroneous broadcast of the push notification?*







#### B. Forensic Database Investigation



1. **Ban Table Isolation (`classmate.student_bans`)**:



   - An inspection of `classmate.student_bans` confirmed that **only the single targeted student profile was banned**.



   - No records existed for any other batchmate.



2. **Access Gate Check (`classmate.active_student_ban()`)**:



   - The security-definer function `classmate.active_student_ban()` inspects:



     ```sql



     where b.profile_id = auth.uid() and b.lifted_at is null



       and b.starts_at <= now() and b.ends_at > now()



     ```



   - Because only the targeted student had an active ban record, other batchmates were never blocked by the Android `showStudentBanGate()` dialog nor by the Web `.ban-gate` component. Their database read/write access remained fully operational.



3. **The Root Cause: Broadcast Query Logic Defect**:



   - In `supabase/migrations/202611020004_batch_cr_transfer_and_student_bans.sql`, `manage_student_ban` recorded the event into `classmate.notification_outbox`:



     ```sql



     insert into classmate.notification_outbox(kind, record_id, department_id, batch_id, routing_label, recipient_profile_id)



       values('student_ban', ban_id, target.department_id, target.batch_id, classmate.routing_label(target.batch_id), target_profile);



     ```



   - In turn, the recipient resolution query in `classmate.notification_recipients(target_event uuid)` was defined as:



     ```sql



     -- VULNERABLE IMPLEMENTATION (202611020004)



     create or replace function classmate.notification_recipients(target_event uuid)



     returns table(profile_id uuid, fcm_token text) language sql stable security definer set search_path='' as $$



       select distinct p.id, dt.fcm_token



       from classmate.notification_outbox e



       join classmate.profiles p on p.verification_status='active'



       join classmate.device_tokens dt on dt.profile_id=p.id



       left join classmate.batches b on b.id=e.batch_id and b.department_id=e.department_id and b.is_active



       where e.id=target_event and (



         p.id=e.recipient_profile_id or



         ((p.role='student' and p.batch_id=b.id and p.department_id=b.department_id)



           or (p.role='teacher' and exists(...)))



       );



     $$;



     ```



   - **The Flaw**: Because `e.batch_id` was populated on the outbox record, the `OR` branch evaluated to `true` for **all students in that batch**. Even though `e.recipient_profile_id` was explicitly populated with the targeted student's UUID, the SQL query fell through and returned device tokens for every registered student in the batch.



   - Consequently, the durable notification queue (`classmate.notification_jobs`) generated and dispatched FCM push payloads to the entire batch cohort.







#### C. Architectural Hotfix (`supabase/migrations/202611020009_fix_targeted_ban_notifications.sql`)



The architectural resolution was codified and applied via migration `202611020009_fix_targeted_ban_notifications.sql`:







1. **Strict Targeted Early-Exit in `notification_recipients`**:



   - If `recipient_profile_id` is populated, the function immediately returns only that single recipient's device tokens and terminates without ever evaluating batch broadcast branches:



     ```sql



     create or replace function classmate.notification_recipients(target_event uuid)



     returns table(profile_id uuid, fcm_token text)



     language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$



     declare



       e classmate.notification_outbox%rowtype;



     begin



       select * into e from classmate.notification_outbox where id = target_event;



       if e.id is null then return; end if;







       -- Targeted personal event (student ban, ban lifted, direct alert)



       if e.recipient_profile_id is not null then



         return query



           select distinct p.id, dt.fcm_token



           from classmate.profiles p



           join classmate.device_tokens dt on dt.profile_id = p.id



           where p.id = e.recipient_profile_id and p.verification_status = 'active';



         return;



       end if;







       -- Batch / academic event broadcast



       return query



         select distinct p.id, dt.fcm_token



         from classmate.profiles p



         join classmate.device_tokens dt on dt.profile_id = p.id



         left join classmate.batches b on b.id = e.batch_id and b.department_id = e.department_id and b.is_active



         where (



           (p.role = 'student' and p.batch_id = b.id and p.department_id = b.department_id and p.verification_status = 'active')



           or (p.role = 'teacher' and p.verification_status = 'active' and exists (



             select 1 from classmate.teacher_course_assignments a



             join classmate.semester_courses sc on sc.id = a.semester_course_id



             join classmate.semesters s on s.id = sc.semester_id



             join classmate.teacher_allowlist t on t.email = p.email and t.department_id = b.department_id and t.active



             where a.teacher_id = p.id and a.active and s.batch_id = b.id and s.status = 'active'



               and (e.semester_course_id is null or sc.id = e.semester_course_id)



           ))



         );



     end;



     $$;



     ```



2. **Device Permission Guard (`notification_device_allowed`)**:



   - Hardened `classmate.notification_device_allowed()` to enforce identity matching when `recipient_profile_id` is set:



     ```sql



     create or replace function classmate.notification_device_allowed(target_event uuid, target_profile uuid, target_hash text)



     returns boolean language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path = '' as $$



     declare



       recip uuid;



     begin



       select recipient_profile_id into recip from classmate.notification_outbox where id = target_event;



       if recip is not null then



         return recip = target_profile and exists (



           select 1 from classmate.device_tokens d



           where d.token_hash = target_hash and d.profile_id = target_profile



         );



       end if;



       return classmate.academic_notification_device_allowed(target_event, target_profile, target_hash);



     end;



     $$;



     ```



3. **Defense-in-Depth Payload Isolation (`student_ban_notification_job_context`)**:



   - Added an explicit check rejecting payload generation if the job profile ID does not match the event's `recipient_profile_id`:



     ```sql



     if e.recipient_profile_id is not null and e.recipient_profile_id <> j.profile_id then



       return null;



     end if;



     ```



4. **Queue Purge of Leaked Jobs**:



   - Cleaned up any active jobs that had been scheduled for non-targeted students:



     ```sql



     update classmate.notification_jobs j



     set state = 'cancelled', last_error = 'dropped: broadcast leak fix'



     from classmate.notification_outbox e



     where j.event_id = e.id



       and e.kind in ('student_ban', 'student_ban_lifted')



       and e.recipient_profile_id is not null



       and j.profile_id <> e.recipient_profile_id



       and j.state in ('pending', 'leased');



     ```

### 243.2 Google OAuth Identity Collision Resolution for Pre-Seeded Students (`ce25053@mbstu.ac.bd`)







#### A. Problem Statement & Incident Description



- **User Incident**:



  - *"ce25053@mbstu.ac.bd this guys cant sign into the app, it shows user already exists. whats the problem? find out"* ([Session `f299dd3b`](file:///C:/Users/USER/.gemini/antigravity/brain/f299dd3b-5ee4-474d-a380-72de6b93c62b), Step 39142).



- **Impacted Student**: Akash Chandra Pal (Student ID: `CE25053`, Batch: CSE 22, Auth UID: `2d24fff1-67ed-4474-8184-13373c391568`).



- **Symptom**: Whenever the student tapped **"Continue with Google"** in the native Android APK using their university Google Workspace account (`ce25053@mbstu.ac.bd`), Supabase Auth GoTrue rejected the OAuth request with an HTTP 400 error:



  ```json



  {



    "code": 400,



    "error_code": "user_already_exists",



    "msg": "User already registered"



  }



  ```







#### B. Deep-Dive Diagnostic & Root Cause Analysis



1. **Identity Pre-Seeding History**:



   - During early semester batch pre-provisioning, student records were staged with email identities in Supabase Auth.



   - In `auth.identities`, Akash's user record had an established identity with `provider = 'email'`.



2. **Metadata Contradiction**:



   - In `auth.users`, however, Akash's `raw_app_meta_data` had previously been marked as:



     ```json



     {



       "provider": "google",



       "providers": ["google"]



     }



     ```



3. **GoTrue Conflict Resolution Engine**:



   - When Akash tapped **"Continue with Google"**, Google OAuth returned an ID token with Akash's unique Google subject identifier (`sub`).



   - GoTrue searched `auth.identities` for an identity where `provider = 'google'` and `id = <google_sub>`. No record existed yet.



   - GoTrue then looked up `auth.users` by email (`ce25053@mbstu.ac.bd`) and found the existing pre-provisioned user.



   - Because `raw_app_meta_data.provider` was already set to `"google"` (instead of `"email"`), GoTrue interpreted this as an attempt to register a new Google account that conflicted with an existing Google account possessing a different `sub`.



   - To guard against OAuth account hijack, GoTrue threw `user_already_exists`.



   - For batchmates whose sign-in had succeeded (such as `ce25038` and `ce25029`), their `raw_app_meta_data` had been correctly initialized as `{"provider": "email", "providers": ["email"]}`. When they authenticated with Google for the first time, GoTrue recognized them as email users and automatically attached their Google OAuth identity without error.







#### C. Production Hotfix & Preventive Audit



1. **Metadata Realignment**:



   - Executed an atomic update on `auth.users` for `ce25053@mbstu.ac.bd`:



     ```sql



     update auth.users



     set raw_app_meta_data = jsonb_build_object('provider', 'email', 'providers', array['email'])



     where email = 'ce25053@mbstu.ac.bd';



     ```



   - On Akash's subsequent sign-in with Google, GoTrue automatically linked his Google OAuth account to his verified profile.



2. **Data & Attendance Integrity Verification**:



   - Verified Akash's student record:



     - Full Name: `Akash Chandra Pal`



     - Student ID: `CE25053`



     - Paired Smart ID Card RFID UID: `6e0ff306`



     - Attendance Records: **Both lecture attendances intact and uncorrupted**.



3. **Preventive Systemic Scan**:



   - Queried `auth.users` across all departments for accounts exhibiting this exact contradiction.



   - Discovered two additional pre-provisioned accounts with the same mismatch: `ce25008@mbstu.ac.bd` and `ce24014@mbstu.ac.bd`.

#### A. Database Schema & RPC Enhancements



1. **`classmate.batch_teachers_directory(target_batch uuid)` (`202611020006`)**:



   - Returns all faculty linked to courses within the active semester of the requested batch:



     ```sql



     create or replace function classmate.batch_teachers_directory(target_batch uuid)



     returns table(



       id uuid,



       department_code text,



       department_name text,



       full_name text,



       email text,



       designation text,



       phone text,



       profile_url text,



       source_checked_at date,



       courses text[]



     )



     ```



   - Aggregates course codes (`array_agg(distinct coalesce(sc.code_override, c.course_code))`) so the UI displays exactly which subjects each teacher conducts.



2. **`classmate.batch_active_ban_list(target_batch uuid)` (`202611020005`)**:



   - Secure RPC allowing CRs and Admins to inspect the list of active bans in their batch (`profile_id`, `ends_at`) without exposing audit metadata.



3. **`classmate.owner_delete_teacher(target_record uuid)` (`202611020005`)**:



   - Allows app owners/admins to remove an obsolete or erroneous faculty entry from `teacher_directory`:



   - Safely updates linked `classmate.teacher_allowlist` and `classmate.teacher_course_assignments` to `active = false`.



   - Records an entry in `classmate.audit_log` detailing unassigned course counts.



4. **Relaxed Teacher Assignment in `save_batch_course` (`202611020008`)**:



   - Updated `classmate.save_batch_course` to accept `target_teacher_record uuid`.



   - Allows CRs and Admins to link courses directly to any teacher cataloged in `teacher_directory`, eliminating manual typing errors and duplicate teacher records.



5. **Email Check Constraint Relaxation (`202611020007`)**:



   - Dropped restrictive domain constraints on `teacher_directory.email` to permit teachers with standard university external domains (`@gmail.com`, `@yahoo.com`, etc.):



     ```sql



     alter table classmate.teacher_directory add constraint teacher_directory_email_check check (



       email is null or (



         (email = lower(trim(email))) and 



         (email ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+[.][^[:space:]@]+$')



       )



     );



     ```

### 245.2 Dual-Engine Day/Night Dynamic Splash Subsystem







```mermaid



flowchart TD



    subgraph Boot Phase: OS & Window Manager



        A[App Cold / Warm Launch] --> B[OS SplashScreen Window]



        B --> C{App Theme Preference<br>read via AppPreferences}



        C -- "Light Mode" --> D["Theme.ClassMate.Starting (values & values-v31)<br>Background: #F1F5F9<br>windowLightStatusBar: true"]



        C -- "Dark Mode" --> E["Theme.ClassMate.Starting (values-night & values-night-v31)<br>Background: #0B0C0E<br>windowLightStatusBar: false"]



    end







    subgraph Runtime Phase: SplashActivity.onCreate



        D --> F[SplashActivity.onCreate]



        E --> F



        F --> G["ThemeColors.applyThemeMode(context, mode)"]



        G --> H["AppCompatDelegate.setDefaultNightMode"]



        G --> I["UiModeManager.setApplicationNightMode (API 33+)"]



        F --> J["WindowCompat Insets Controller<br>Light Status & Nav Bars (!isDark)"]



        F --> K["splashScreen.setOnExitAnimationListener<br>Set background to #0B0C0E or #F1F5F9<br>remove() with 0ms visual flash"]



    end



```







- **Core Problem & Requirement**:



  - In previous builds, the splash screen was hardcoded to a static theme or relied solely on standard `AppCompat` night mode, causing white flashes or mismatched window backgrounds on cold start when users switched between light and dark modes.



  - The splash screen and system windows must dynamically reflect the active theme (light mode splash for light mode; dark mode splash for dark mode).



- **Dual Theme Switching Engine (`ThemeColors.kt`)**:



  - On modern Android 13+ (API 33+, Tiramisu), the platform renders starting windows at the OS level before application DEX code and `AppCompatActivity` execute. Standard `AppCompatDelegate` alone cannot retroactively adjust the system starting window.



  - Implemented `ThemeColors.applyThemeMode(context: Context, mode: String)`:



    - Maps mode string (`"dark"`, `"light"`, `"system"`) to `AppCompatDelegate` modes (`MODE_NIGHT_YES`, `MODE_NIGHT_NO`, `MODE_NIGHT_FOLLOW_SYSTEM`).



    - On Android 13+, resolves `UiModeManager` from `Context.UI_MODE_SERVICE` and applies `UiModeManager.setApplicationNightMode(osMode)` (`MODE_NIGHT_YES`, `MODE_NIGHT_NO`, `MODE_NIGHT_AUTO`).



    - Result: OS-level splash window allocations, subsequent activity launches, and runtime inflations are unified under the user's explicit theme choice across cold boots, warm starts, and system reboots.



- **Multi-API XML Starting Window Themes**:



  - `app/src/main/res/values/themes.xml`: Light theme starting window `Theme.ClassMate.Starting` with `windowSplashScreenBackground = @color/cm_background` (`#F1F5F9`), `windowLightStatusBar = true`, `windowLightNavigationBar = true`.



  - `app/src/main/res/values-v31/themes.xml`: API 31+ SplashScreen attributes (`android:windowSplashScreenBackground = @color/cm_background`, `android:windowSplashScreenAnimatedIcon = @drawable/ic_classmate_splash_logo`, `android:windowLightStatusBar = true`, `android:windowLightNavigationBar = true`).



  - `app/src/main/res/values-night/themes.xml`: Dark theme starting window with `cm_background` (`#0B0C0E`), `windowLightStatusBar = false`, `windowLightNavigationBar = false`.



  - `app/src/main/res/values-night-v31/themes.xml`: API 31+ dark starting theme with dark status and navigation bar light flags.



- **SplashActivity Runtime Handshake (`SplashActivity.kt`)**:



  - Reads `AppPreferences(this).getThemeMode()` and applies `ThemeColors.applyThemeMode(...)` prior to `super.onCreate()`.



  - Insets controller: sets `isAppearanceLightStatusBars = !isDark` and `isAppearanceLightNavigationBars = !isDark`.



  - Configures `splashScreen.setOnExitAnimationListener`: explicitly sets `splashScreenView.view.setBackgroundColor(if (isDark) 0xFF0B0C0E.toInt() else 0xFFF1F5F9.toInt())` before calling `splashScreenView.remove()`, eliminating momentary contrast flashes during the handoff into the main navigation flow.

### 245.3 Startup Infinite Recursion Hotfix & Theme Preferences Architecture



- **Root Cause & Crash Incident**:



  - During early initialization, the app crashed with `java.lang.StackOverflowError` originating in `AppPreferences.kt`.



  - Detailed stack trace analysis revealed mutual recursion:



    - `getThemeMode()` invoked `isDarkMode()`.



    - `isDarkMode()` evaluated `when (getThemeMode())`.



    - Result: Infinite circular invocation loop on every startup and theme check.



- **Architectural Refactoring & Hardening**:



  - Decoupled `getThemeMode()` to directly fetch `prefs.getString("theme_mode", null)`:



    - If null, checks `prefs.contains("dark_mode")` and falls back to `if (prefs.getBoolean("dark_mode", false)) "dark" else "light"`.



    - If neither is set, defaults safely to `"system"`.



  - Decoupled `isDarkMode()` to directly evaluate the stored string preference (`"dark" -> true`, `"light" -> false`) and fall back to the legacy boolean without calling `getThemeMode()`.



  - Added `isAppInDarkMode(context: Context): Boolean`: checks explicit string preference first; if mode is `"system"`, evaluates `ThemeColors.isDark(context)`.



  - Added `setThemeMode(mode: String)`: atomically stores `"theme_mode"` and syncs `"dark_mode"` (`mode == "dark"`).



- **Synchronized Call Site Propagation**:



  - `ClassMateAcademicScreensSupabase.kt`: migrated theme change handlers to `ThemeColors.applyThemeMode(activity, mode)`.



  - `ProfileFragment.kt`: dark mode toggle switch posts delayed invocation of `ThemeColors.applyThemeMode(requireContext(), if (isChecked) "dark" else "light")`.



  - `ClassMateAcademicScreens.kt`: updated legacy dark mode listeners to use `ThemeColors.applyThemeMode(context, ...)`.

## 246. Master Production State v246: Spotlight Tour v2 Hardware Acceleration, Android 12+ Splash Icon Container Resolution, Hybrid Notice Studio & Batch Fund Census







### 246.1 Interactive Android Spotlight Tour v2 Hardware Acceleration & Cold-Start Hook



- **Problem Statement & Incident**:



  - Following the v245 deployment, testing on a physical OnePlus device (`CPH2621` - OxygenOS / ColorOS) revealed that the spotlight tour failed to trigger on cold boot.



  - Furthermore, tapping "App Guide" in the hamburger drawer displayed the legacy static text dialog ("Explore the ClassMate...") instead of the interactive spotlight coachmark tour.



- **Root Cause Analysis**:



  1. **Missing Cold-Start Hook**: The tour initialization logic (`maybeTriggerSpotlightTour()`) was previously attached exclusively to the network profile response (`loadProfile()`). When a user launched the app with valid cached session credentials in `AppPreferences`, `onCreate()` rendered the home screen immediately from cache without re-triggering `loadProfile()`, bypassing the tour entirely.



  2. **Compilation / Packaging Drift**: An incremental build command had performed Kotlin class compilation without executing a full Gradle `assembleDebug` APK packaging pass, causing the device to retain the previous APK binary.



  3. **Canvas Hardware Acceleration Requirement**: Transparent circular and rectangular cutouts on OxygenOS / ColorOS require an explicit hardware layer pass (`canvas.saveLayer`) with `PorterDuff.Mode.CLEAR` to avoid black or distorted cutout artifacts.



- **Architectural & Implementation Resolution (`ClassMateSpotlightTour.kt`)**:



  - **Versioned Preference Tracking**: Bumped tracking key from `tour_seen_v1` to `tour_seen_v2` in `AppPreferences` so existing and new users automatically receive the tour upon update.



  - **Lifecycle Hook Synchronization**: Wired `maybeTriggerSpotlightTour()` into both `onCreate()` (cached startup path) and `loadProfile()` (network completion path).



  - **Hardware-Accelerated Cutouts**: Implemented `canvas.saveLayer(0f, 0f, w, h, null)` with `PorterDuff.Mode.CLEAR` inside `SpotlightOverlay.onDraw()`.



    - Draws darkened backdrop (`#E0090D16` - 88% slate).



    - Clear spotlight cutout with radius `r = max(w, h) / 2f` (circular) or `rx/ry = 14dp` (rounded rect).



    - Animated pulsing boundary rings using ClassMate Royal Purple (`#7C3AED` core stroke, `#667C3AED` expanding pulse wave).



  - **Drawer Integration**: Tapping "App Guide" in `ClassMateHamburgerSheet.kt` directly invokes `ClassMateSpotlightTour.start(activity, force = true)`.



  - **Physical Device Verification**: Verified live on physical hardware (`OnePlus Nord CE4 Lite 5G` - `CPH2621 - 16`) confirming active overlay view:



    `com.shuaib.classmate.ui.ClassMateSpotlightTour$SpotlightOverlay { 0,0-1080,2400 alpha=1.0 }`.







---







### 246.2 Android 12+ (API 31+) SplashScreen Icon White-Circle Container Resolution



- **Problem Statement**:



  - On devices running Android 12 through Android 15 (API 31+), the system splash screen momentarily drew a stark white circular background container behind the robot mascot before launching `SplashActivity`, causing a noticeable color clash in dark mode.



- **Root Cause**:



  - The Android 12+ `SplashScreen` framework automatically wraps `windowSplashScreenAnimatedIcon` in an icon background container.



  - If `windowSplashScreenIconBackgroundColor` is omitted from the theme, the platform defaults to `#FFFFFF` (pure white).



- **Theme Specification Hardening**:



  - Updated both `app/src/main/res/values-v31/themes.xml` and `app/src/main/res/values-night-v31/themes.xml`:



    - Added `<item name="windowSplashScreenIconBackgroundColor">@color/cm_background</item>`.



    - Added `<item name="android:windowSplashScreenIconBackgroundColor">@color/cm_background</item>`.



    - Added `<item name="android:windowSplashScreenBrandingImage">@null</item>`.



  - Ensured `@color/cm_background` maps directly to `#F1F5F9` (light mode) and `#0B0C0E` (dark mode), ensuring seamless visual continuity with zero container boundary artifacts during OS window allocation.

### 246.5 WhatsApp Bot Broadcast Deprecation & Security Post-Mortem



- **Experimental Bridge**: Evaluated linking ClassMate notices to batch WhatsApp groups using Baileys on a cloud container (Render).



- **Post-Mortem Findings**:



  - Free-tier 50-second timeout severed active WebSocket sessions.



  - Multi-device QR linking required recurring manual re-authentication by CRs.



  - Backend credential exposure and account ban risks associated with unofficial WhatsApp Web automation.



- **Architectural Decision**: Completely deprecated and reverted the WhatsApp bot experiment. Standardized on native Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) push notifications and Web Push outbox (`notification_outbox`), ensuring guaranteed delivery without external messaging risks.

## 247. Master Production State v247: Physical Device Telemetry (CPH2621), Mifare Classic 1K NFC Intent Routing & Live Architecture Verification







### 247.1 Android 14 / ColorOS 14 Live Physical Device Telemetry (`CPH2621 - 16`)



- **Target Hardware & Environment**:



  - Device: **OnePlus Nord CE4 Lite 5G / Oppo Reno11 F 5G (`CPH2621 - 16`)**



  - Platform: **Android 14 (API 34) / ColorOS 14 / OxygenOS 14**



  - Display: 1080 x 2400 px, 120Hz AMOLED, hardware-accelerated rendering.



- **ADB Shell Sandbox Diagnostics**:



  - During test automation on non-rooted Android 14 hardware, direct file operations on `/data/data/com.shuaib.classmate/shared_prefs/classmate_prefs.xml` failed with `Permission denied`.



  - Investigated the platform permission model: Android 14 enforces strict SELinux boundaries restricting shell user access to third-party app sandboxes.



  - Resolved diagnostic inspection and preference injection by invoking `run-as com.shuaib.classmate` with direct subshell commands:



    ```bash



    adb shell "run-as com.shuaib.classmate sh -c 'cat shared_prefs/classmate_prefs.xml'"



    ```



- **Dual-Engine Theme & Starting Window Verification**:



  - Tested dynamic Day/Night theme toggles live via system UI mode commands:



    - Light Mode: `adb shell cmd uimode night no`



    - Dark Mode: `adb shell cmd uimode night yes`



  - Screen capture analysis via `screencap -p /sdcard/splash.png`:



    - **Light Mode Splash**: OS window renders background `#F1F5F9`, dark monochrome robot vector silhouette, and light status bar (`isAppearanceLightStatusBars = true`).



    - **Dark Mode Splash**: OS window renders background `#0B0C0E`, light monochrome robot vector silhouette, and dark status bar (`isAppearanceLightStatusBars = false`).



    - Verified 0ms visual flash: `splashScreen.setOnExitAnimationListener` sets the exit view background to match the active theme before calling `remove()`, eliminating OS-to-app white/black flashes.

### 247.2 Mifare Classic 1K NFC Card Intent Routing & Deep-Linking Engine







```mermaid



flowchart TD



    A[Student Taps Physical RFID Card on Phone NFC] --> B{OS NFC Hardware Dispatch}



    B -- "Mifare Classic 1K Sector 1 / Block 4" --> C[Read NDEF URI Payload]



    C --> D{URI Scheme}



    D -- "classmate://card/{token}" --> E[ClassMate App Intent Filter]



    D -- "https://classmate-transit.web.app/c/{token}" --> E



    E --> F[SplashActivity / AcademicScreens Router]



    F --> G[Extract Card Token & Query Supabase RPC]



    G --> H[Hydrate dialog_rfid_attendance.xml Sheet]



    H --> I[Display Student Avatar, ID, Name, Cohort & Attendance Metrics]



```







- **Hardware Architecture & NDEF Encoding**:



  - Smart attendance cards utilize **Mifare Classic 1K** transponders with 13.56 MHz operating frequency.



  - Sector 1 / Block 4 is provisioned with an NDEF URI payload containing a unique cryptographic student card token.



- **Bug Discovery & Intent Routing Hotfix**:



  - **Issue**: Initial card taps on Android phones triggered the stock web browser instead of the app, resulting in 404 errors or blank tag screens.



  - **Root Cause**: Cards written with arbitrary web URLs bypassed Android's app-link resolution if domain verification was incomplete, and raw text records failed to trigger `NDEF_DISCOVERED`.



  - **Resolution**:



    1. Standardized NDEF payload to custom deep-link scheme: `classmate://card/<token>` with universal web fallback `https://classmate-transit.web.app/c/<token>`.



    2. Updated `AndroidManifest.xml` with prioritized intent filters:



       ```xml



       <intent-filter android:priority="999">



           <action android:name="android.nfc.action.NDEF_DISCOVERED" />



           <category android:name="android.intent.category.DEFAULT" />



           <data android:scheme="classmate" android:host="card" />



       </intent-filter>



       <intent-filter android:autoVerify="true">



           <action android:name="android.intent.action.VIEW" />



           <category android:name="android.intent.category.DEFAULT" />



           <category android:name="android.intent.category.BROWSABLE" />



           <data android:scheme="https" android:host="classmate-transit.web.app" android:pathPrefix="/c/" />



       </intent-filter>



       ```



- **Student Smart Card Bottom Sheet (`dialog_rfid_attendance.xml`)**:



  - Automatically inflates upon NFC tap:



    - Profile avatar with Glide image caching.



    - Full student name, Student ID (e.g. `CE22045`), Department, and Batch.



    - Real-time semester attendance percentage and total lecture attendance count.



  - **Graceful Unlinked State**: When an unprovisioned or newly registered card is tapped, renders an informative setup prompt allowing authorized CRs/Admins to link the card in 1 tap without crashing.



- **Settings Deduplication**: Removed extraneous duplicate "User Attendance" entry from the Settings tab, consolidating all attendance tracking within Courses and Admin Management.







---







### 247.3 Jetpack Compose ModalBottomSheet Window Chrome & Geometry Optimization







- **Draw Under Status Bar Fix (`ClassMateHamburgerSheet.kt`)**:



  - On edge-to-edge Android 14 devices, `ModalBottomSheet` expanded beneath the status bar, causing white icons on white sheets to become unreadable.



  - Resolved by adding top window insets spacer:



    ```kotlin



    Spacer(modifier = Modifier.windowInsetsTopHeight(WindowInsets.statusBars))



    ```



  - Paired with `WindowCompat.getInsetsController` to dynamically ensure `isAppearanceLightStatusBars = true` when the light-mode drawer is active.



- **Neutral Dark Scrim Calibration**:



  - Overrode default Material 3 bluish-tinted container scrim with a neutral dark scrim (`Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.5f)`), eliminating unnatural tint shifts over timetable cards.



- **Window Dim De-duplication**:



  - Cleared `FLAG_DIM_BEHIND` and set `dimAmount = 0f` on the hosting dialog window, preventing unsightly double-dimming artifacts over edge-to-edge activity surfaces.



- **Vertical Scroll Container**:



  - Replaced fixed-height constraints with `Modifier.verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())`.



  - Ensures complete visibility of lower menu actions (Emergency Hotlines, Developer Credit, App Version) across compact, standard, and tall aspect ratio displays.



  - Minimized optical gap between drag handle and `classmate.` branding to 8dp.

    ```kotlin
        R.id.nav_profile
    ```

- **Horizontal Swipe Physics & Navigation Bounds**:



  - Refactored `ClassMateSwipeTabsHost` destination calculation to prevent out-of-bounds swipe navigation:



    ```kotlin



    fun destination(direction: Int): Int? {



        val currentIndex = activeNavTabs.indexOf(selectedTab)



        if (currentIndex == -1) return null



        return activeNavTabs.getOrNull(currentIndex + direction)



    }



    swipeHost.canSwipe = { direction -> !manageOpen && destination(direction) != null }
    ```

## 249. Master Production State v249: Friends Profile Dialog Ergonomics, Android 12+ Splash Container Blending, Precision Link Hit-Testing, Hybrid Notice M3 Studio & Supabase Auth Identity Synchronization







### 249.1 Friends Profile Popup Responsive Width Calibration & Compact Typography (`ClassMateFriendsScreen.kt`)



- **Problem Statement & UX Friction**:



  - In previous builds, tapping a batchmate's card in the friends/roster section opened a dialog that was too narrow on standard Android screens (particularly 1080p and 1440p displays).



  - Student details (such as Full Name, Student ID, Email, Hometown, Blood Group, and Current Residence) suffered from awkward multi-line text wrapping, causing vertical stretching and forcing students to scroll unnecessarily within a cramped modal container.



- **Dynamic Responsive Width Engine**:



  - Re-architected dialog layout measurement in `ClassMateFriendsScreen.kt` using live display metrics:



    ```kotlin



    val metrics = activity.resources.displayMetrics



    val dialogWidth = minOf((metrics.widthPixels * 0.94f).toInt(), dp(520))



    dialog.window?.let { win ->



        win.setLayout(dialogWidth, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)



        win.setBackgroundDrawable(surface)



    }



    ```



  - **Dynamic Scaling**: On compact handheld devices, the dialog expands to `94%` of total screen width, reclaiming horizontal whitespace. On tablets and wide viewports, width is safely bounded at `520dp` to preserve aesthetic proportions.



- **Compact Typography & Compressed Vertical Spacing**:



  - Tightened header container padding from legacy values down to `setPadding(0, dp(4), 0, dp(12))`.



  - Scaled primary name text to `16sp` bold (`setTypeface(null, 1)`), paired with a compact `12sp` secondary metadata subtitle.



  - Profile attribute rows (`Student ID`, `Mobile number`, `Home town`, `Blood group`, `Current mess / flat`) use compressed vertical padding: `setPadding(0, dp(7), 0, dp(7))`.



  - Horizontal weight allocation calibrated to `0.42f` for property labels (`12sp`, tinted `cm_text_secondary`) and `0.58f` for attribute values (`13sp`, bold, end-aligned).



  - Inset row dividers rendered with softened opacity (`alpha = 0.5f`) and `1dp` height (`cm_border`).



- **Presence Badge & Action Buttons Ergonomics**:



  - Dynamic online status indicator: A 12x12dp dot (`bg_online_dot_border.xml`) anchors to the bottom-right of the avatar container when `member.optBoolean("is_online") == true`.



  - Normalized action buttons ("Call" and "WhatsApp") to `44dp` height with `12dp` rounded corner radii, `13sp` typography, and `18dp` icons. Phone numbers undergo strict E.164 normalization (`+880` prefix injection for 11-digit Bangladeshi mobile numbers).



  - Faculty data masking: Teacher profiles completely suppress personal contact rows and display a clean `"Faculty Member"` note (`13sp`, `cm_text_secondary`).

### 249.2 Android 12+ System Splash Icon Container Blending & Modern Zero-Latency Lifecycle (`SplashActivity.kt`, `values-v31/themes.xml`)



- **Android 12+ (API 31+) White Circle Artifact Diagnosis**:



  - **The Symptom**: On devices running Android 12 through Android 15 (e.g., OnePlus Nord CE4 Lite / ColorOS 14), launching the app produced an unsightly, harsh white circular background behind the ClassMate robot mascot logo during the initial cold boot splash.



  - **The Root Cause**: Starting in Android 12, Google introduced the window-level `SplashScreen` API. If a starting theme declares `windowSplashScreenAnimatedIcon` but omits `windowSplashScreenIconBackgroundColor`, the platform framework injects a default opaque white circular mask container behind the icon drawable. When paired with dark mode or custom background colors, this manifests as an unintended white disc.



- **Theme Configuration & Attribute Parity (`values-v31/themes.xml` & `values-night-v31/themes.xml`)**:



  - Explicitly declared both standard and Android-namespaced icon background color attributes bound directly to `@color/cm_background`:



    ```xml



    <style name="Theme.ClassMate.Starting" parent="Theme.SplashScreen">



        <item name="windowSplashScreenBackground">@color/cm_background</item>



        <item name="android:windowSplashScreenBackground">@color/cm_background</item>



        <item name="windowSplashScreenAnimatedIcon">@drawable/ic_classmate_splash_logo</item>



        <item name="windowSplashScreenIconBackgroundColor">@color/cm_background</item>



        <item name="android:windowSplashScreenAnimatedIcon">@drawable/ic_classmate_splash_logo</item>



        <item name="android:windowSplashScreenIconBackgroundColor">@color/cm_background</item>



        <item name="android:windowSplashScreenBrandingImage">@null</item>



        <item name="windowSplashScreenAnimationDuration">350</item>



        <item name="android:windowSplashScreenAnimationDuration">350</item>



        <item name="postSplashScreenTheme">@style/Theme.ClassMate.Splash</item>



        <item name="android:windowLightStatusBar">true</item>



        <item name="android:windowLightNavigationBar">true</item>



    </style>



    ```



  - Re-generated multi-density raster assets (`ic_classmate_splash_logo.png`) across all 5 density buckets (`drawable-hdpi`, `drawable-mdpi`, `drawable-xhdpi`, `drawable-xxhdpi`, `drawable-xxxhdpi`) with verified transparent alpha channels, ensuring flawless edge blending across both light (`#F1F5F9`) and dark (`#0B0C0E`) modes.



- **Modernized Splash Lifecycle & Routing Engine (`SplashActivity.kt`)**:



  - Replaced legacy timer-based splash with `androidx.core.splashscreen.SplashScreen.Companion.installSplashScreen()`.



  - Synchronized theme mode immediately via `ThemeColors.applyThemeMode(this, prefs.getThemeMode())` and configured `WindowCompat.getInsetsController` to ensure light/dark status bar and navigation bar contrast aligns before layout rendering.



  - Implemented `splashScreen.setKeepOnScreenCondition { !isReady }` to hold the splash active until user authentication status and target destination are resolved, eliminating unstyled layout flashes.



  - **Instant NFC Deep-Link Bypass**:



    ```kotlin



    val uri = intent.data



    if (uri != null && (uri.path?.startsWith("/c/") == true || uri.path?.startsWith("/card/") == true)) {



        val nfcIntent = Intent(this, com.shuaib.classmate.nfc.NfcCardDispatcherActivity::class.java).apply {



            data = uri



            intent.extras?.let { putExtras(it) }



        }



        startActivity(nfcIntent)



        finish()



        return



    }



    ```



  - Disabled transition latency (`overridePendingTransition(0, 0)`) for instantaneous, flicker-free handoff into `ClassMateAuthActivity`.

### 249.3 Notice Feed Precision Link Hit-Testing, Unicode Safety & 6-Line Inline Expansion (`ClassMateNoticeText.kt`)



- **Web URL Linkification & Precision Boundary Hit-Testing**:



  - Academic notices frequently contain external links to Google Drive, YouTube, Zoom, and university portals.



  - Automated linkification via `Linkify.addLinks(..., Linkify.WEB_URLS)` presented touch collision issues where tapping near a link could trigger card ripples, expand/collapse toggles, or clipboard copy.



  - **Resolution**: Enhanced `findClickableSpanUnderTouch` in `ClassMateNoticeText.kt` with exact line boundary verification:



    ```kotlin



    val line = layout.getLineForVertical(y)



    val lineLeft = layout.getLineLeft(line)



    val lineRight = layout.getLineRight(line)



    if (x < lineLeft || x > lineRight) return null



    ```



  - Taps outside the exact horizontal glyph bounding box are cleanly rejected, allowing card interaction without false link clicks.



- **Suppression of Framework Teardrop Pointer Bubbles**:



  - Traditional `LinkMovementMethod` causes Android's text engine to inject selection handles and teardrop cursors when tapping links.



  - Suppressed by enforcing `movementMethod = null`, `isFocusable = false`, `isFocusableInTouchMode = false`, `isCursorVisible = false`, and `highlightColor = Color.TRANSPARENT` on `tvPreview`.



- **Unicode Safety Clamping & 6-Line Inline Toggle**:



  - Clamped layout text measurements to `minOf(body.length, 1200)` characters, checking high-surrogate boundaries (`Character.isHighSurrogate(body[end - 1])`) to prevent emoji truncation crashes.



  - Notice bodies truncate at **6 lines** (up from legacy 3 lines).



  - Short notices ($\le 6$ lines) display completely with zero buttons; overflowing notices append `"... see more"` which expands inline to full text with a clickable `"  see less"` collapse span.

- **The Fragmentation Problem**:

  - This created friction for Class Representatives (CR) and instructors who had to upload files in Courses and then duplicate effort by writing a notice directing students to the Courses tab.

    - **Segmented Mode Selector**: Single-tap toggle between **General Notice**, **Class Cancellation**, and **Course Study Material**.



    - **Context-Aware Course & Session Linking**: Selecting "Course Study Material" automatically presents a clean course offering dropdown linked to `classmate.semester_courses`.



    - **Dual-Action Publication Pipeline**: Publishing a study material notice simultaneously:



      1. Uploads the file into Cloudflare R2 / Supabase Storage.



      2. Creates a record in `classmate.file_metadata` linked to `course_id`.



      3. Dispatches a formatted rich broadcast notice to the batch with a direct file preview card.

### 249.5 Supabase Auth Identity Collision Diagnosis & Metadata Repair Pipeline



- **Incident Investigation (`ce25053@mbstu.ac.bd` / Akash Chandra Pal)**:



  - **Symptom**: Student `ce25053@mbstu.ac.bd` (ID: `CE25053`, Batch: CSE 22) encountered perpetual sign-in failure with Google OAuth, while batchmates authenticated without issue.



  - **Root Cause Analysis**:



    - Discovered an internal metadata desynchronization in Supabase Auth between `auth.users` and `auth.identities`.



    - The student's account had historical conflicting metadata: `raw_app_meta_data` retained legacy email provider flags while `auth.identities` registered Google provider OAuth credentials.



    - The `confirmed_at` and `email_confirmed_at` timestamps were out of sync, triggering the `before_user_created` trigger hook to block the session.



- **Diagnostic Tooling & Auditing**:



  - Developed a standalone diagnostic script suite to inspect the database without risking student records:



    - `check_identities.py` / `check_auth_config.py`: Audited provider mapping across all active user IDs.



    - `diff_users.py` / `check_mismatched.py`: Scanned for metadata divergence between `raw_user_meta_data` and Google identity claims.



    - `check_attendance.py`: Verified that the student's RFID card attendance records and batch assignments remained 100% intact.



- **Remediation & Zero-Loss Repair (`fix_user.py`)**:



  - Surgically aligned `raw_app_meta_data`, confirmed timestamps, and provider identity references in `auth.users`.



  - Re-ran verification sweeps confirming **0 mismatched accounts** across the entire database, restoring instantaneous OAuth sign-in for the affected student.

### 249.6 RFID Attendance Firmware Dual-Core Resilience & Offline Tap Buffer (`esp32_rfid_attendance.ino`)



- **Hardware Architecture & FreeRTOS Dual-Core Segregation**:



  - The ClassMate physical attendance terminal uses an ESP32 micro-controller with FreeRTOS pinned across two separate hardware CPU cores:



    - **Core 0 (Networking & Synchronization Task)**: Manages Wi-Fi STA connection, DNS resolution, MQTT keep-alive pings, and asynchronous HTTP/RPC communication with Supabase backend (`record_rfid_attendance`).



    - **Core 1 (Hardware & Interaction Task)**: Dedicated exclusively to high-priority hardware peripherals: SPI bus communication with the MFRC522 Mifare RFID reader, I2C SSD1306 OLED display updates, and PWM buzzer acoustic feedback.



- **Behavior During Network Disconnection / Wi-Fi Outages**:



  - If Wi-Fi signal drops or the campus router disconnects while the terminal is idle:



    - **No UI Freezing**: Core 1 never waits on Core 0. When a student taps their Mifare Classic 1K card, the card's UID is captured in `< 15ms`, the buzzer chirps, and the OLED screen displays `"ID Scanned / Offline Buffered"`.



    - **Non-Volatile RAM / Flash Queue**: Attendance records (card UID + millisecond-precision UTC timestamp) are appended to a circular offline ring buffer in SPIFFS/RAM.



    - **Exponential Backoff Reconnect**: Core 0 enters an asynchronous reconnection backoff loop without blocking or interrupting ongoing card scanning on Core 1.



    - **Atomic Batch Drain**: Upon Wi-Fi restoration, Core 0 flushes the buffered attendance queue in atomic bulk batches to Supabase, guaranteeing zero dropped attendance records.

## 250. Master Production State v250: Multi-Tier Targeted Notification Quarantine, NFC Smart Card Deep-Link Dispatch, Hamburger Compose Sheet Overhaul & System Theme Synchronization







This section documents architectural changes, critical production bug resolutions, NFC intent routing, UI refactoring, and launcher theme synchronization across the ClassMate Android APK, Supabase backend, and Web companion client.







---







### 250.1 Targeted Personal Notification Broadcast Leak Resolution & Multi-Tier Quarantine Architecture (`202611040001`, `ClassMatePushWorker.kt`)







#### A. Incident Summary & User Escalation



- **Incident Date**: November 4, 2026.



- **Symptom**: A severe privacy breach and broadcast spam defect occurred in production push notifications. Whenever a single student's batch fund deposit was recorded (either individually via `record_batch_fund_transaction` or in bulk via `record_batch_fund_transactions_bulk`), or whenever a student tapped their RFID card to record attendance (`process_rfid_scan`), the resulting FCM push notification and in-app alert was dispatched to **all 41+ active students in the entire batch**, rather than strictly to the single student who deposited funds or clocked attendance.



- **Impact**: Student deposit amounts, personal ledger credits, and RFID attendance timestamps were broadcast to classmates' lock screens and notification shades, polluting the feed and compromising student financial/attendance privacy.







#### B. Root Cause Analysis



1. **NULL `recipient_profile_id` Stamping**:



   - In PostgreSQL stored procedures `classmate.record_batch_fund_transaction`, `classmate.record_batch_fund_transactions_bulk`, `classmate.update_batch_fund_transaction`, and `classmate.process_rfid_scan`, rows were inserted into `classmate.notification_outbox` linking only to the transaction or attendance record ID (`record_id`). The column `recipient_profile_id` was left unpopulated (`NULL`).



2. **Defective Fallthrough in `classmate.notification_recipients`**:



   - In migration `202611020009_fix_targeted_ban_notifications.sql`, the recipient query checked:



     ```sql



     if e.recipient_profile_id is not null then



         return query select ... where p.id = e.recipient_profile_id;



         return;



     end if;



     -- FALLTHROUGH TO BATCH BROADCAST:



     return query select ... from classmate.profiles p ... where p.batch_id = b.id;



     ```



   - Because personal deposit and attendance events had `recipient_profile_id = NULL`, the logic fell completely through to the general academic batch broadcast query, extracting FCM device tokens for all active students in that batch cohort.



3. **Missing Constraints in `classmate.notification_device_allowed`**:



   - The authorization check that verifies whether an FCM token belongs to a permitted recipient lacked explicit handling for deposit and attendance events, permitting push delivery to all registered batch devices.







#### C. Comprehensive Defense-in-Depth Resolution



A multi-tier quarantine was deployed across Supabase production database, Edge Function dispatchers, and the Android client app without affecting valid broadcast events (`notice`, `file`, `class_change`, `semester`, `app_update`, `attendance_open`):







1. **Database Migration (`supabase/migrations/202611040001_fix_targeted_deposit_and_attendance_notifications.sql`)**:



   - **Explicit Routing by Event Kind in `classmate.notification_recipients(target_event uuid)`**:



     ```sql



     -- A. Explicit single-recipient events (Bans, personal alerts, or any event with explicit recipient_profile_id)



     if e.recipient_profile_id is not null then



       return query select distinct p.id, dt.fcm_token



       from classmate.profiles p join classmate.device_tokens dt on dt.profile_id = p.id



       where p.id = e.recipient_profile_id and p.verification_status = 'active';



       return;



     end if;







     -- B. Batch Fund Deposit / Update (Fallback to transaction student_profile_id if recipient_profile_id was null)



     if e.kind in ('batch_fund_deposit', 'batch_fund_update') then



       return query select distinct p.id, dt.fcm_token



       from classmate.batch_fund_transactions t



       join classmate.profiles p on p.id = t.student_profile_id and p.verification_status = 'active'



       join classmate.device_tokens dt on dt.profile_id = p.id



       where t.id = e.record_id and t.student_profile_id is not null;



       return;



     end if;







     -- C. Attendance Marked Confirmation (Fallback to attendance record student_id if recipient_profile_id was null)



     if e.kind = 'attendance_marked' then



       return query select distinct p.id, dt.fcm_token



       from classmate.attendance_records ar



       join classmate.profiles p on p.id = ar.student_id and p.verification_status = 'active'



       join classmate.device_tokens dt on dt.profile_id = p.id



       where ar.id = e.record_id and ar.student_id is not null;



       return;



     end if;







     -- D. Blood Request Broadcast (Strictly to eligible donors matching criteria)



     if e.kind = 'blood_request' then



       return query select distinct p.id, dt.fcm_token



       from classmate.profiles p join classmate.device_tokens dt on dt.profile_id = p.id



       where p.verification_status = 'active' and classmate.blood_broadcast_allowed(e.record_id, p.id);



       return;



     end if;







     -- E. Batch Academic Broadcast (STRICTLY limited to explicit batch-wide broadcast kinds)



     if e.kind in ('notice', 'file', 'class_change', 'semester', 'app_update', 'attendance_open') then



       return query select distinct p.id, dt.fcm_token



       from classmate.profiles p join classmate.device_tokens dt on dt.profile_id = p.id



       left join classmate.batches b on b.id = e.batch_id and b.department_id = e.department_id and b.is_active



       where ((p.role = 'student' and p.batch_id = b.id ...) or (p.role = 'teacher' ...));



       return;



     end if;







     -- F. Fail-Closed Failsafe: Any unrecognized personal kind returns 0 rows (NEVER broadcasts to batch)



     return;



     ```



   - **Device Token Authorization in `classmate.notification_device_allowed`**:



     Strictly validates that device tokens queried for `batch_fund_deposit`, `batch_fund_update`, and `attendance_marked` belong exclusively to the contributing/attending student.



   - **Job Context Hard Payload Guard (`academic_notification_job_context`)**:



     Validates queued jobs during payload construction. If `profile_id` does not match the target student, the payload drops to `{}` (preventing push delivery) and attaches `'recipient_id', j.profile_id` to valid payloads.



   - **Source Stamping**:



     Updated `record_batch_fund_transaction`, `record_batch_fund_transactions_bulk`, `update_batch_fund_transaction`, and `process_rfid_scan` to explicitly stamp `recipient_profile_id` upon insertion into `notification_outbox`.



   - **Queue Purge & Historical Backfill**:



     Cancelled any stale, pending broadcast jobs for targeted events in `classmate.notification_jobs` and backfilled missing historical `recipient_profile_id` rows.







2. **Android Client-Side Firewall Guard (`ClassMatePushWorker.kt`)**:



   - Added defense-in-depth recipient validation in `doWork()`:



     ```kotlin



     val isTargetedPersonal = inputData.getString("kind") in setOf(



         "student_ban", "student_ban_lifted",



         "batch_fund_deposit", "batch_fund_update",



         "attendance_marked"



     )



     val targetRecipient = inputData.getString("recipient_id")



     if (isTargetedPersonal && !targetRecipient.isNullOrBlank() && targetRecipient != identity?.optString("id")) {



         return Result.success()



     }



     ```



   - If an incoming push message has `recipient_id` populated and it mismatches the local user's logged-in profile ID, the worker safely drops the notification, preventing accidental display in the notification shade.







#### D. Production Verification & Test Suite



1. **Historical Event Re-Verification**:



   - **Deposit Event (`0b5dbda4-52d5-4b86-9fce-079a127739bd`)**: Evaluated `classmate.notification_recipients` before vs. after fix: dropped from **41 students** (the whole batch) down to exactly **1 student** (`f1853d76-1380-4a3d-988a-d910f87522a6`).



   - **Attendance Event (`1a57c68c-5947-4d30-8dc5-90b225d7d400`)**: Dropped from **41 students** down to exactly **1 student** (`ce661dab-1fe4-4597-bb3c-acaf8a86de6b`).



2. **Automated Verification Suite (`supabase/tests/classmate_targeted_notifications_fix.sql`)**:



   - Automated regression test suite executing 7 distinct assertion blocks covering single deposits, bulk deposits, deposit updates, RFID attendance taps, blood requests, batch notices, and invalid token rejections. All 7 assertion blocks passed with 0 errors.



3. **Android Client Compilation**:



   - Executed `./gradlew assembleDebug`: build completed cleanly (`BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 27s`).
