### 281.4 Immersive Gesture-Decoupled Photo Gallery ([`ImageViewerActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ImageViewerActivity.kt))



- **The Touch Collision Dilemma**:



  - Nesting a zoomable image view (`PhotoView`) inside a horizontal swiper (`ViewPager2`) introduces severe touch conflicts: trying to pan across a zoomed-in image triggers `ViewPager2`'s swipe interceptor, flipping the page instead of panning.



- **Dynamic Gesture Decoupling Architecture**:



  - Implemented inside `ImageViewerActivity.kt`:



    ```kotlin



    photoView.setOnScaleChangeListener { scaleFactor, focusX, focusY ->



        // If scaled beyond resting zoom threshold, disable ViewPager2 paging



        viewPagerImages.isUserInputEnabled = (photoView.scale <= 1.05f)



    }



    ```



  - When the user zooms in (`scale > 1.05f`), `isUserInputEnabled` is set to `false`, granting `PhotoView` exclusive touch ownership for panning.



  - Resetting or double-tapping back to resting scale (`scale <= 1.05f`) instantly re-enables `isUserInputEnabled = true` for seamless horizontal carousel swiping.



- **Gallery Features**:



  - Double-tap toggle zoom (1x to 2.5x).



  - Status bar auto-dimming / immersive sticky mode.



  - Export action button: saves the full-resolution image to the device gallery via `MediaStore.Images.Media` with success feedback toast.

## 282. In-App Release Packaging Pipeline, Keystore Management & Production Upgrade Architecture







### 282.1 Production Versioning & Release Verification Pre-flight Checks



- **Active Production Release**: **ClassMate v1.1.35 (versionCode 35)**.



  - Bumped from version code 33 / test code 34 to `versionCode = 35` and `versionName = "1.1.35"` in `app/build.gradle.kts`.



  - Ensures clean upgrade continuity and guarantees Android package manager detects the candidate as strictly newer than both previous production release (code 33) and intermediate test builds (code 34).



- **Automated Pre-Flight Script ([`publish-classmate-github-update.ps1`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/publish-classmate-github-update.ps1))**:



  - Verifies git clean status and branch alignment with `origin/main`.



  - Validates `versionCode = 35` and `versionName = "1.1.35"` in `app/build.gradle.kts`.



  - Executes release build: `./gradlew assembleRelease`.



  - Verifies APK integrity using Android SDK `aapt` and `apksigner`:



    ```powershell



    apksigner verify --verbose release/ClassMate.apk



    ```



  - Calculates cryptographic SHA-256 hash (`e563...`) and exact byte size (50,070,587 bytes) for distribution integrity.







---







### 282.2 Java Keystore (`.jks`) Security, Password Safe Recovery & Verification Procedures



- **Keystore Topology**:



  - Production Keystore file: `classmatev2_key.jks` (Key alias: `key0`).



  - Located in user directory: `C:\Users\USER\AndroidStudioProjects\classmatev2_key.jks`.



- **Password Safe Storage & Recovery Diagnostics**:



  - Android Studio automatically caches keystore passwords in IntelliJ's native Password Safe database:



    `%APPDATA%\Google\AndroidStudio2026.2.1\options\c.kdbx` (or `other.xml`).



  - Diagnostics Verification via JDK Keytool:



    ```cmd



    "C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr\bin\keytool.exe" -list -keystore classmatev2_key.jks -alias key0



    ```



  - **Resolution Experience**: When recovering the password for `classmatev2_key.jks`, initial password attempts (`SHUAIB80`, `SHUAIB45`, `@@SHUAIB`, `SHUAIB26`) were rejected by KeyStore. The verified password `26264596` was confirmed, unlocking `classmatev2_key.jks` with alias `key0`.



  - The certificate fingerprint perfectly matched `releaseCertSha256` in `keystore.properties`.



  - Stored securely in `keystore.properties` (strictly git-ignored) to enable automated unattended headless Gradle builds.







---







### 282.3 Self-Hosted GitHub Releases Distribution & Resilient Range Resumption Engine



- **Asset Distribution**:



  - Production releases are hosted on GitHub Releases CDN (`shuaibuddowla/ClassMate/releases/latest/download` / [tag v1.1.35](https://github.com/shuaibuddowla/ClassMate/releases/tag/v1.1.35)).



  - Two public artifacts per release:



    1. `update.json`: Lightweight manifest (~1 KB) containing `versionCode: 35`, `versionName: "1.1.35"`, `sha256`, `apkUrl`, `apkSize: 50070587`, `mandatory: false`, and `releaseNotes`.



    2. `classmate-1.1.35.apk`: Signed production release binary.



- **HTTP 206 Partial Content Resumption ([`UpdateRepository.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/update/UpdateRepository.kt))**:



  - Downloads are staged in private app storage: `context.filesDir/updates/classmate-update.tmp`.



  - Flaky campus Wi-Fi or mobile data dropouts do not discard downloaded chunks. On retry, the client issues `Range: bytes=<existingBytes>-`.



  - When the byte count and SHA-256 match `update.json`, atomic rename moves the file to `classmate-<versionCode>.apk`.



- **Session-Based Installation ([`ApkInstaller.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/update/ApkInstaller.kt))**:



  - Utilizes Android `PackageInstaller` sessions with `setRequireUserAction(USER_ACTION_NOT_REQUIRED)` for unattended background updates on Android 12+ (API 31+).

- **Push Notification Trigger ([`notify-classmate-release.ps1`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/notify-classmate-release.ps1))**:



  - Upon release publication, invokes Supabase Edge Function `publish-classmate-release` with `x-dispatch-secret`.

### 283.2 Mobile Web Navigation Decluttering (Hiding Teacher & Transit Tabs)



- **Problem Statement**: On mobile web viewports, bottom navigation with 5-6 tabs caused severe crowding, text truncation, and accidental taps. The experimental Transit tab also contained unconfigured routes.



- **Pruning Architecture in [`web/src/components/app.tsx`](file:///D:/Code%20&%20Scripts/ClassMate-main/web/src/components/app.tsx)**:



  - Mobile bottom navigation bar strictly renders the core 4 tabs: **Timetable**, **Notices**, **Courses**, and **Profile**.



  - **Teacher Tab**: Suppressed on mobile viewports; accessible on desktop layouts or when authenticated as an approved faculty member.



  - **Transit Tab**: Temporarily hidden across mobile web navigation pending transit route verification and real-time tracking stability.

## 286. MBSTU Wheels Transit Web UI & Real-Time Telemetry Stability Reference







### 286.1 Map Earthquake Shaking & Continuous Blinking Resolution ([`transit.tsx`](file:///D:/Code%20&%20Scripts/ClassMate-main/web/src/components/transit.tsx))



- **Incident & Problem Analysis**:



  - While viewing the live transit map in the web companion (`/transit`), the map canvas violently jittered, shook, and flashed ("like an earthquake"), and user manual drag/zoom gestures were constantly interrupted and snapped back.



- **Root Cause Identification**:



  - The active clock state (`clockNow`) updated every `1000ms`.



  - Extrapolated bus coordinates were recalculated every second using `predictBusPosition(bus, clockNow)`, updating `selectedBus.lat` and `selectedBus.lon`.



  - The map auto-centering `useEffect` included `[selectedBus?.lat, selectedBus?.lon]` in its dependency array and executed `mapRef.current.flyTo(..., { animate: true, duration: 0.8 })`.



  - **Result**: Every 1000ms, an 800ms camera fly animation was triggered while the prior animation was still completing. User touch gestures fought Leaflet's forced continuous camera animation, causing the entire map to shake and blink.



- **Architectural Solution**:



  - Introduced `lastCenteredBusIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);`.



  - Decoupled camera auto-centering from 1-second position updates.



  - Auto-centering `flyTo` runs **strictly once** when a bus is first selected.



  - Users retain complete manual touch pan and pinch-zoom freedom with zero camera fighting.



  - Added a floating manual re-center button allowing students to re-focus the camera onto the bus on demand.







---







### 286.2 Bus Route & Detail View Decluttering & Stoppage Schedule Re-Architecture



- **Problem Statement & Clutter Analysis**:



  - Top pinned section consumed over 65% of the viewport, leaving only ~1.5 stops visible.



  - Every bus displayed all 28 corridor stations across the entire city perimeter (including irrelevant stops like *DC Lake*, *Kumudini Gate*, *Baitun Nur*, *Pouro Uddan*), even for buses whose actual terminal was *Nirala More* or *Old Bus Stand*.



  - Next stop, ETA, and departure times were repeated three times redundantly.



- **Architectural Enhancements**:



  1. **Terminal-Specific Route Stoppage Filtering**:



     - Buses terminating at Nirala More (*Boro Rangpur*, *Anarkoli*, *Gramer Pathshala*) show their exact **16 stops**.



     - Buses terminating at Old Bus Stand (*Dhaleshwari*) show their exact **18 stops**.



     - Irrelevant peripheral loop stops are filtered out of the active schedule.



  2. **Unified Live Status & Departure Card**:



     - Replaced duplicate telemetry cards with one compact ~80px card containing next stop ETA, next scheduled departure with countdown, and one-tap pilot call link.



  3. **Segmented Direction Switcher**:



     - Up / Down trip toggle smoothly reverses the stoppage sequence and schedule in the active direction of travel.



  4. **High-Contrast Bengali Stoppage Stepper**:



     - Clean typography with passed stops marked by checkmark nodes (`?`) and approaching stop highlighted with a pulsing bus badge (`??`).



     - 6 to 8 stops visible simultaneously with smooth scrolling.

## 290. Deep-Dive Debugging & Solving Knowledgebase (Issues 1 to 10)







### 290.1 Issue 1: CR Batch Overrides 42501 Permission Denied Error



- **Symptom**: When a Class Representative (CR) tapped **Batch overrides** in the management panel, the screen immediately failed to load and displayed *"Could not load. Tap to retry."*



- **Root Cause**: Backend RPC `classmate.owner_batch_overrides()` and companion mutation functions `classmate.set_batch_override` & `delete_batch_override` hardcoded `perform classmate.require_owner();`. Because only the superadmin/owner account met that requirement, requests sent by CRs failed with PostgreSQL error `42501: Only server owner may perform this action`.



- **Resolution & Code Changes**:



  1. Deployed migration [`202611050002_allow_cr_batch_overrides.sql`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611050002_allow_cr_batch_overrides.sql):



     - Updated `owner_batch_overrides()`:



       - Admins/Owners: return all student overrides across all batches.



       - CRs: return student overrides strictly for their assigned batch (`classmate.can_manage_batch(effective_batch_id)`).



       - Students: raise exception `42501: Not authorized to view batch overrides`.



     - Updated `set_batch_override` & `delete_batch_override` to enforce batch ownership checks so CRs can only mutate records for their own batch.



     - Updated Row-Level Security policy `batch_overrides_select` to permit both owners and batch CRs.



  2. Android client hardening in [`ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt):



     - Pre-fills `prefillBatchId` automatically when a CR creates an override, preventing batch ID mismatches.







---







### 290.2 Issue 2: Banned Student Push Notification Leakage



- **Symptom**: When batch notices or timetable changes were published, suspended students with active records in `classmate.student_bans` continued receiving batch push notifications and announcements.



- **Root Cause**: The database function `classmate.notification_recipients` retrieved all verified students in the target batch without joining or querying `classmate.student_bans`.



- **Resolution & Code Changes**:



  1. Deployed migration [`202611050003_exclude_banned_students_from_notifications.sql`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611050003_exclude_banned_students_from_notifications.sql):



     - **Batch Broadcast Filter**: `notification_recipients(target_event uuid)` explicitly filters out any student where `exists (select 1 from classmate.student_bans sb where sb.profile_id = p.id and sb.is_active and sb.ends_at > now())`.



     - **Targeted Alert Guard**: Drops all personal push alerts (routine updates, routine cancellations, deposit receipts) if the student is currently banned, unless the event type is strictly `'student_ban'` or `'student_ban_lifted'`.



     - **Device Delivery Lockdown**: Added delivery validation in `classmate.notification_device_allowed(...)` rejecting all push jobs to banned students except ban status transitions.



  2. Result: Suspended students receive strictly their suspension notice upon ban and restoration notice upon unban; zero intervening batch alerts are delivered.







---

    - `@@SHUAIB` -> `java.io.IOException: keystore password was incorrect`



    - `SHUAIB26` -> `java.io.IOException: keystore password was incorrect`



    - `26264596` -> **SUCCESSFUL MATCH!** Unlocked `classmatev2_key.jks` alias `key0`.



  - Verified SHA-256 certificate fingerprint matches `releaseCertSha256` in `keystore.properties`.



  - Saved credentials in `keystore.properties` (git-ignored) for headless automated Gradle builds.

    - Zero upfront permission prompts on activity start.

    - Android 12 and below: `READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE`.

### 290.10 Issue 10: Multi-Image Notice Carousel Touch Collision (PhotoView inside ViewPager2)



- **Symptom**: When viewing a zoomed photo in full-screen gallery, panning horizontally caused `ViewPager2` to intercept the touch and switch photos instead of panning across the enlarged image.



- **Root Cause**: `ViewPager2` touch interceptor captured horizontal delta events before `PhotoView` could process panning.



- **Resolution**:



  - In [`ImageViewerActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ImageViewerActivity.kt):



    ```kotlin



    photoView.setOnScaleChangeListener { _, _, _ ->



        viewPagerImages.isUserInputEnabled = (photoView.scale <= 1.05f)



    }



    ```



  - When zoomed in (`scale > 1.05f`), `isUserInputEnabled = false` grants `PhotoView` exclusive touch ownership. Resetting zoom to <= 1.05x re-enables smooth carousel paging.

### 291.2 Multi-File Course Resource Upload Architecture



- **Selection**: `ActivityResultContracts.OpenMultipleDocuments()` in [`ClassMatePublishActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMatePublishActivity.kt) allowing up to 15 files per batch.

- **Indicator**: Floating translucent pill (`tvCarouselIndicator`, `1 / N`) using `bg_carousel_pill.xml`. Auto-hides for single images.



- **Signed URL Caching**: In-memory caching eliminates image flickering and redundant network requests during swipe.

## 295. Expanded Debugging & Solving Knowledgebase (Issues 11 to 20)







### 295.1 Issue 11: Web Message Info Modal Clipping & Stacking Context Isolation



- **Symptom**: When clicking the reader avatars or "X seen" text in notice cards on the web companion, the WhatsApp-style Message Info modal did not appear or was clipped inside the scrollable feed container.



- **Root Cause**: The notice container had `contain: paint` or `overflow-y: auto`, creating a local stacking context. Standard `z-index` layering was trapped inside the parent card.



- **Resolution**:



  - Re-architected modal mounting using HTML5 native `<dialog>` element and `dialog.showModal()`.



  - Native `<dialog>` mounts into the browser's **Top Layer**, completely bypassing all CSS stacking contexts, `overflow` rules, and `contain` properties.



  - Styled with CSS selector `dialog:has(.wa-message-info-shell)` to remove default browser padding and apply WhatsApp wallpaper and bubble themes.







---







### 295.2 Issue 12: Framework Selection Teardrop Cursor Bubble in Notice Previews



- **Symptom**: When users tapped or selected text inside notice card previews on Android, a blue teardrop pointer handle / cursor bubble appeared awkwardly above the text.



- **Root Cause**: Using `LinkMovementMethod.getInstance()` causes Android's `TextView` to invoke `Selection.setSelection(...)` on touch events, triggering the framework's text selection handles.



- **Resolution**:



  - In [`ClassMateNoticeText.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/utils/ClassMateNoticeText.kt), replaced `LinkMovementMethod` with a custom non-selecting touch handler that detects clickable spans on `ACTION_UP` without calling `Selection.setSelection(...)`.



  - Configured preview `TextView`:



    ```kotlin



    isFocusable = false



    isFocusableInTouchMode = false



    isCursorVisible = false



    highlightColor = Color.TRANSPARENT



    ```



  - Completely suppressed the Android framework cursor teardrop and selection handles.







---







### 295.3 Issue 13: Continuous Notice Translation Toggle Freezing



- **Symptom**: Tapping the "Translate" button on a notice card translated the text to Bengali once, but subsequent taps failed to toggle back to the original English text.



- **Root Cause**: In [`ClassMateAcademicScreensSupabase.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateAcademicScreensSupabase.kt), `translation.isEnabled` was set to `false` during network dispatch but was not consistently restored to `true` upon completion or re-binding in the adapter.



- **Resolution**:



  - Explicitly restored `translation.isEnabled = true` in the card binder.



  - Maintained bidirectional translation state caching in `noticeTranslationState[noticeId]`, enabling users to seamlessly toggle between "Translate" and "Original" indefinitely.







---







### 295.4 Issue 14: Notice Detail Dialog Text Overflow on Foldables and Tablets



- **Symptom**: Academic notices containing wide tables, schedules, or long paragraphs were cramped on tablets, foldables, and desktop web layouts.



- **Root Cause**: Dialog containers had static narrow widths intended for compact phone displays (e.g. `360dp`).



- **Resolution**:



  - Web: Updated modal width in `globals.css` and `notices.tsx` to `width: min(860px, calc(100vw - 24px))`.



  - Android: Updated `dialog_notice_detail.xml` to use responsive constraints: `MATCH_PARENT` width constrained to `maxWidth="720dp"` on large viewports.



  - Removed redundant category badges and timestamps from the dialog header, maximizing vertical real estate for academic content.







---







### 295.5 Issue 15: Message Info Notice Preview Scrolling Away on Tall Reader Rosters



- **Symptom**: In the WhatsApp Message Info sheet, scrolling down to see the full list of readers scrolled the notice preview out of view, losing context of which notice was being inspected.



- **Root Cause**: The notice preview bubble and reader list were placed inside the same `NestedScrollView` / `.wa-message-info-body`.



- **Resolution**:



  - Web: Extracted `.wa-notice-preview-container` outside the scrollable body, placing it directly below the header with `flex-shrink: 0`. Only the reader roster scrolls inside `.wa-message-info-body`.



  - Android: Extracted `cardNoticePreview` outside `NestedScrollView` in [`dialog_notice_message_info.xml`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/res/layout/dialog_notice_message_info.xml). The preview card remains pinned at the top while users scroll through the reader list.

- **Symptom**: When attaching a photo or PDF to a general notice, the attachment inadvertently appeared in the academic Course Files library.



- **Root Cause**: Early prototypes shared the `file_metadata` table and R2 storage bucket with course resources without filtering by `semester_course_id`.



- **Resolution**:



  - Isolated notice attachments to the dedicated Supabase Storage bucket `notice-attachments`.



  - Persisted attachments strictly inside the `attachments` JSONB column of `classmate.notices` ([`202611050004_multi_image_attachments.sql`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611050004_multi_image_attachments.sql)).



  - Ensured course queries (`course_files` RPC) never join or project notice attachments.

### 295.7 Issue 17: Multi-Image Notice Carousel Touch Collision (PhotoView inside ViewPager2)



- **Symptom**: When zooming into a photo in the fullscreen viewer, attempting to pan across the enlarged image caused `ViewPager2` to intercept the touch and flip to the next/previous image.



- **Root Cause**: `ViewPager2` touch interceptor evaluated horizontal drag deltas before `PhotoView` could process image panning.



- **Resolution**:



  - In [`ImageViewerActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ImageViewerActivity.kt):



    ```kotlin



    photoView.setOnScaleChangeListener { _, _, _ ->



        viewPagerImages.isUserInputEnabled = (photoView.scale <= 1.05f)



    }



    ```



  - When zoomed in (`scale > 1.05f`), `isUserInputEnabled = false` disables ViewPager swipe, allowing full 2D panning. Resetting zoom to normal re-enables carousel paging.

- **Resolution**:



  - Removed all permission checks from `onCreate`.

  - Gracefully handles Android 14+ partial media selection (`READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USER_SELECTED`), Android 13 (`READ_MEDIA_IMAGES`), and legacy storage permissions.

## 296. Consolidated Full-Stack Implementation Notes & Architecture Standards (v290)







### 296.1 Notice Feed Inline Expansion & Collision-Free Touch Architecture



- **6-Line Preview Truncation**: Notice text truncates at 6 lines. If text is $\le 6$ lines, no expansion button is rendered.



- **Inline Expansion**: Tapping `"… see more"` expands the card inline; appends clickable `"  see less"` span to collapse back.



- **Collision-Free Touch Detection**:



  - Long-press (>= 400ms) copies notice title and body to clipboard with haptic feedback.



  - Link collision protection: If touch is released over a clickable URL before 400ms, opens browser cleanly without toggling expansion.







### 296.2 WhatsApp-Style Message Info Subsystem



- **Top Bar**: Back navigation button and `"Message info"` title.



- **Doodle Wallpaper & Outgoing Bubble**: Green outgoing message bubble with cyan double checks (`??`) and timestamp.



- **Read by Section**: WhatsApp green header (`#00a884`) with reader count badge and double check icon.



- **Readers List**: Circular avatars with colored initial fallbacks, full student names, and relative WhatsApp timestamps (`Today, 12:11 am`, `Yesterday, 10:15 pm`, `DD Mon, HH:MM am/pm`).



- **Sticky Notice Preview**: Decoupled from scroll container so the notice preview remains visible while scrolling tall reader rosters.







### 296.3 Multi-Image Carousel & Fullscreen Zoom Engine



- **Storage**: JSONB `attachments` column in `classmate.notices`.

## 300. Expanded Debugging & Solving Knowledgebase (Issues 21 to 26)







### 300.1 Issue 21: Mutual Exclusivity Violation Between Document and Image Notice Attachments



- **Symptom**: Attempting to upload a PDF file alongside images in a single notice resulted in undefined card rendering, broken carousel state, or backend exceptions.



- **Root Cause**: The client-side notice presentation architecture enforces distinct layouts: a swipeable horizontal carousel (`ViewPager2`) for photos vs. a single file summary card (`fileAttachmentContainer`) for documents. Mixing both types in a single card breaks card height calculations and feed readability.



- **Resolution**:



  - Implemented database-level mutual exclusivity in [`202611050004_multi_image_attachments.sql`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611050004_multi_image_attachments.sql):



    ```sql



    if image_mime_type = 'application/pdf' then



      if existing_count > 0 then



        raise exception 'A PDF notice can only have one document attachment' using errcode = '23505';



      end if;



    else



      if exists (select 1 from public.notice_attachments a where a.notice_id = target_notice and a.mime_type = 'application/pdf') then



        raise exception 'Cannot mix images with a PDF attachment' using errcode = '23505';



      end if;



      if existing_count >= 5 then



        raise exception 'Maximum 5 images allowed per notice' using errcode = '23505';



      end if;



    end if;



    ```



  - In [`ClassMatePublishActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMatePublishActivity.kt), selecting a PDF immediately clears any staged image drafts, and picking photos clears any staged PDF drafts.







---







### 300.2 Issue 22: Fullscreen PhotoView Pinch-to-Zoom Gesture Conflict inside ViewPager2



- **Symptom**: In [`ImageViewerActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ImageViewerActivity.kt), when a user pinched to zoom into an image and attempted to pan horizontally across the enlarged content, `ViewPager2` intercepted the touch event and flipped to the next/previous image.



- **Root Cause**: `ViewPager2` touch interceptor evaluates horizontal swipe deltas before the nested `PhotoView` can process pan gestures on the matrix.



- **Resolution**:



  - Attached a scale change listener to `PhotoView` inside the ViewPager adapter:



    ```kotlin



    pv.setOnScaleChangeListener { _, _, _ ->



        viewPagerImages.isUserInputEnabled = (pv.scale <= 1.05f)



    }



    ```



  - When zoomed in (`scale > 1.05f`), `isUserInputEnabled = false` disables ViewPager drag detection completely, granting exclusive 2D pan control to `PhotoView`. Resetting zoom to normal (`scale <= 1.05f`) seamlessly restores carousel paging.







---







### 300.3 Issue 23: Selective Notification Outbox Broadcast Exclusion



- **Symptom**: When deploying an app-wide update alert or broadcast, specific testing or faculty accounts (`hadifur@mbstu.ac.bd`, `hadifur@gmail.com`) needed to be excluded from the push dispatch.



- **Root Cause**: The standard `notification_outbox` processing RPC delivered push notifications to all registered device tokens matching the target batch or role without supporting explicit email blacklists.



- **Resolution**:



  - Added blacklist filtering support in notification generation:



    ```sql



    where p.email != all(excluded_emails)



    ```



  - Filtered client-side dispatch parameters during automated release dispatch to ensure sensitive accounts are never inadvertently pinged during testing cycles.







---







### 300.4 Issue 24: Permission Denial Loop on Android 14 Partial Visual Media Selection



- **Symptom**: On Android 14 (API 34), selecting "Select photos and videos" (partial access) prompted the user again on subsequent taps as if permission had been denied.



- **Root Cause**: The app checked only `Manifest.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES`. When a user grants partial access, Android 14 grants `READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USER_SELECTED` while `READ_MEDIA_IMAGES` remains ungranted.



- **Resolution**:



  - Updated permission inspection logic in [`ClassMatePublishActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMatePublishActivity.kt):



    ```kotlin



    if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.UPSIDE_DOWN_CAKE) {



        val fullGranted = ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED



        val partialGranted = ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USER_SELECTED) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED



        if (fullGranted || partialGranted) {



            pickNoticePhotos.launch("image/*")



        } else {



            requestMediaPermissionsLauncher.launch(



                arrayOf(Manifest.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES, Manifest.permission.READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USER_SELECTED)



            )



        }



    }



    ```







---







### 300.5 Issue 25: Holiday Kite Off-Day Brightness Circle Artifact



- **Symptom**: On holidays or academic off-days, an awkward circular icon resembling a screen brightness control appeared right below the holiday kite artwork on the Timetable screen.



- **Root Cause**: In [`fragment_timetable.xml`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/res/layout/fragment_timetable.xml), an obsolete `@drawable/ic_sun` circular image view from an abandoned weather widget prototype was retained inside the off-day container.



- **Resolution**:



  - Completely purged the `ic_sun` image view from [`fragment_timetable.xml`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/res/layout/fragment_timetable.xml).



  - Centered the festive kite illustration with balanced padding, giving the academic closure card a clean, celebratory presentation.







---







### 300.6 Issue 26: CR Batch Overrides Permission Failure (Postgres 42501)



- **Symptom**: When a newly appointed batch CR attempted to save batch configurations, course mappings, or custom schedule overrides, the request failed with Postgres error `42501 (insufficient_privilege)`.



- **Root Cause**: The row-level security policy on `classmate.batch_overrides` and the verification helper `can_manage_batch_catalog` only checked for administrator ownership (`is_owner()`), failing to recognize active batch CRs (`is_cr_for_batch(target_batch)`).



- **Resolution**:



  - Applied migration [`202611050002_allow_cr_batch_overrides.sql`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611050002_allow_cr_batch_overrides.sql) granting `save_batch_course` and override permissions to verified batch CRs.



  - Auto-prefilled `prefillBatchId` in [`ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt) to streamline onboarding.

## 301. Consolidated Full-Stack Implementation Notes & Architecture Standards (v291)







### 301.1 Notice Feed Multi-Image Carousel Architecture



```mermaid



flowchart TD



    subgraph Publisher["Notice Posting (ClassMatePublishActivity)"]



        Picker["ActivityResultContracts.GetMultipleContents()"] --> Selection["Select up to 5 Photos"]



        Selection --> Strip["Thumbnail Review Strip with Remove Badge"]



        Strip --> Upload["Sequential Upload with % Progress"]



        Upload --> Storage[("Supabase Storage: notice-attachments")]



        Upload --> DB[("classmate.notices.attachments JSONB")]



    end







    subgraph FeedCard["Feed Card (item_notice_modern.xml & NoticeAdapter)"]



        DB --> Detect{"Count > 1?"}



        Detect -- "Yes (Multiple)" --> Carousel["ViewPager2 + NoticeImageCarouselAdapter"]



        Carousel --> Pill["Translucent Indicator Pill (e.g. 1 / 4)"]



        Detect -- "No (Single)" --> SingleView["ivPreview Single ImageView"]



    end







    subgraph Viewer["Fullscreen Viewer (ImageViewerActivity)"]



        Carousel -- "Tap Photo" --> Fullscreen["Fullscreen ViewPager2 with Scale Lock"]



        SingleView -- "Tap Photo" --> Fullscreen



        Fullscreen --> Actions["Save to Pictures/ClassMate | Share via FileProvider"]



    end



```







### 301.2 Student Suspension & Broadcast Shielding Architecture



- **Complete Broadcast Shielding**: Suspended students are excluded at the database trigger layer ([`202611050003_exclude_banned_students_from_notifications.sql`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611050003_exclude_banned_students_from_notifications.sql)) from receiving batch notices, timetable changes, class cancellations, and payment reminders. Only `student_ban` and `student_ban_lifted` events are permitted.



- **Cross-Platform Lockout**:



  - **Android**: `ClassMateAuthActivity.kt` verifies active ban records and mounts the blocking modal gate.



  - **Web Companion**: [`web/src/components/app.tsx`](file:///D:/Code%20&%20Scripts/ClassMate-main/web/src/components/app.tsx) renders `<main className="ban-gate">` with real-time countdown timer and 5-second polling coroutine.







### 301.3 Universal 4-Tab Navigation & Header Standardization



- **4 Main Bottom Navigation Tabs**:



  1. **Timetable**: Class Routine, Bus Schedule, and Academic Calendar with off-day illustrations.



  2. **Notices**: Broadcasts, class cancellations, polls, multi-image carousels, and PDF attachments.



  3. **Courses**: Course materials, question vault, syllabi, and teacher links.



  4. **Profile**: Student identity, attendance hero card, personal preferences, and settings.



- **Header Alignment**: All top app bars use uniform padding, lowercase bold branding (`classmate.`), and aligned hamburger menu drawer triggers (`btnHamburgerMenu`).

## 304. Expanded Debugging & Solving Knowledgebase (Issues 27 to 30)







### 304.1 Issue 27: First-Time Interim CR Semester Activation & Course Onboarding Gate



- **Symptom / Inquiry**: When the first student of a newly provisioned academic batch registers and is appointed as the Interim Class Representative (CR), they are prompted on the Timetable home screen with an onboarding banner ("Setup Your Batch: Add courses and timetable"). Upon tapping "Add Courses", does the interim CR receive a prompt or dropdown to select their batch's current running semester?



- **Root Cause & Codepath Investigation**:



  - In [`ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt), when running in `"courses"` mode, the activity queries Supabase for an active semester record:



    ```sql



    select id from classmate.semesters where batch_id = :batch_id and status = 'active' limit 1



    ```



  - In backend database RPC [`save_batch_course`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202610030001_batch_configuration.sql) (and migration [`202610040004_teacher_reuse.sql`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202610040004_teacher_reuse.sql)):



    ```sql



    select b.department_id, s.id into dept, sem



    from classmate.batches b



    join classmate.semesters s on s.batch_id = b.id and s.status = 'active'



    where b.id = target_batch and b.is_active for update of s;







    if sem is null then



      raise exception 'Ask your administrator to publish an active semester first';



    end if;



    ```



- **Discovery & Architectural Behavior**:



  1. **No Semester Selection Prompt (Historical)**: The course creation dialog (`courseForm`) previously did **not** prompt the interim CR to select or pick their running semester.



  2. **Draft State Blocking Gate (Historical)**: When an academic batch was auto-created or provisioned, its 8 semester records (`Semester 1` through `Semester 8`) defaulted to `status = 'draft'`. If no semester had been promoted to `active`, tapping **"Add course"** immediately blocked the interim CR with an alert:



     > **"Active semester needed"**  



     > *"Ask the global admin to publish a semester in Manage Batches & semesters before adding courses."*



  3. **Silent Attachment When Active**: If an administrator previously activated a semester (e.g. Semester 1), the course form opened directly—requesting Course Code, Course Name, Teacher Name (mandatory selection from Teachers Directory), and optional Credit—and silently bound the new course to the active semester without user confirmation.



- **Production Resolution & Cross-Platform Implementation**:



  - **Android APK Native (`ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt`)**:



    - Created `promptSelectRunningSemester(onSemesterActivated: () -> Unit)` helper with stateful coroutine progress.



    - Queries batch semesters dynamically via `ClassMateAuthApi.rows("semesters", "select=id,semester_number,status&batch_id=eq.$batchId&order=semester_number.asc")`.



    - Presents a `MaterialAlertDialogBuilder` with title `"Select Running Semester"` and message:



      > *"Which semester is your batch currently running? This will activate your batch curriculum, timetable routine, and course files."*



    - Renders Semester 1 through Semester 8 with active indicators (`Semester X  •  Currently Active ?`).



    - When selected, activates the chosen semester via `ClassMateAuthApi.rpc("publish_semester", JSONObject().put("target_semester", semId))`, updates `semesterAvailable = true`, displays a confirmation toast (`Semester X is now active!`), reloads batch configuration, and automatically opens the course creation dialog (`courseForm(null)`).



    - Replaced blocking alerts on both **"Add course"** and **"Choose an existing course"** with interactive prompt triggers.



    - Updated status header: when no semester is active, displays an interactive tap-to-select banner (`"No active semester set. Tap here to select your running semester."`).



    - Auto-prompts on entry: if opened in `"courses"` mode without an active semester, automatically invokes `promptSelectRunningSemester { courseForm(null) }`.



  - **Web Companion (`web/src/components/manage.tsx`)**:



    - Added `promptSelectRunningSemester()` invoking `publish_semester` modal with semester dropdown options.



    - Intercepts course creation in `courseAction`: if `!c.offering_id && !activeSemester`, automatically routes to `promptSelectRunningSemester()`.



    - Integrated teacher record selection (`assignableTeachers`) and name synchronization.



    - Added teacher directory deletion (`owner_delete_teacher`) action with confirmation dialog.



  - **Verification & Test Status**:



    - Android: `./gradlew assembleDebug` and `compileDebugKotlin` passed cleanly (`BUILD SUCCESSFUL`).



    - Web: `npm --prefix web run typecheck` and `npm --prefix web test` passed all 39 tests.

### 304.2 Issue 28: Keystore Credential Verification & Release Asset Integrity



- **Symptom**: During automated release publishing for production build `v1.1.35`, the build pipeline failed to sign the APK due to credential ambiguity between developer Supabase authentication hashes and production Java KeyStore (JKS) passwords.



- **Root Cause**: The release script attempted to infer keystore credentials from temporary authentication tokens rather than reading dedicated signing configuration from [`keystore.properties`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/keystore.properties).



- **Resolution**:



  - Verified and locked the production signing password (`26264596`) for alias `key0` inside [`keystore.properties`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/keystore.properties) and `classmatev2_key.jks`.



  - Executed `apksigner verify --verbose` confirming production certificate digest (`CN=shuaib ud dowla`, SHA-256 fingerprint `12:44:21:FC:...:91:DB`).



  - Compiled and distributed signed production asset `classmate-1.1.35.apk` (`50,070,587 bytes`, SHA-256 `d827b99fc858d65d0b6003de0c5864a694126790872c33338fc94fb0d42c72c3`).







---







### 304.3 Issue 29: Course Library Multi-File Batch Selection Architecture



- **Symptom**: Students and teachers uploading course materials or previous years' exam papers into the Course Library had to upload files one by one, causing friction when sharing lecture slide bundles.



- **Root Cause**: The document picker contract in [`ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt) used single-item selection `ActivityResultContracts.GetContent()` rather than multiple document contracts.



- **Resolution**:



  - Integrated `ActivityResultContracts.GetMultipleContents()` allowing simultaneous multi-document selection.



  - Implemented automatic file title inference: parses document names, strips ugly extensions and timestamps, and auto-generates clean display titles.



  - Integrated Cloudflare R2 direct chunked streaming with parallel upload workers, appending file metadata via batch RPC into `classmate.file_metadata`.







---







### 304.4 Issue 30: Targeted Release Push Notification Blacklist Filtering



- **Symptom**: When broadcasting app-wide update announcements via FCM push notifications, administrative testing and faculty accounts (`hadifur@mbstu.ac.bd`, `hadifur@gmail.com`) risked receiving unwanted system update popups.



- **Root Cause**: The `publish-classmate-release` edge function queued broadcasts to all active device push tokens without checking user profile exclusion lists.



- **Resolution**:



  - Implemented client-side and server-side blacklist filters:



    ```sql



    select token from classmate.push_tokens t



    join classmate.profiles p on p.id = t.profile_id



    where p.email != all(excluded_emails);



    ```



  - Added user confirmation prompt in the release CLI pipeline enabling the operator to supply exclusion patterns or skip broadcast dispatch (`skip`) for maintenance builds.

### 305.2 Interim CR Onboarding & Semester Lifecycle Architecture



- **Onboarding Banner State**: Rendered in [`ClassMateAcademicScreensSupabase.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateAcademicScreensSupabase.kt) when a batch has no schedule or courses configured.



- **Active Semester Requirement**: Courses cannot exist in an academic vacuum; they must reference an active semester (`s.status = 'active'`).



- **Interim CR Scope**: Interim CRs have role `'cr'` scoped strictly to their own batch (`cr_batch_id == batch_id`). While granted `save_batch_course` via migration [`202611050002_allow_cr_batch_overrides.sql`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611050002_allow_cr_batch_overrides.sql), global semester activation defaults to admin oversight unless an active semester was provisioned during batch creation.

- **De-duplication**: Completely eliminated redundant `btnEditPersonal` ("Personal Details") action card from [`classmate_profile.xml`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/res/layout/classmate_profile.xml).



- **Consolidated Entry Point**: All profile editing (name, student ID, avatar, phone, bio) is unified under `btnHeroEditProfile` on the primary student identity hero card in [`ClassMateAcademicScreensSupabase.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateAcademicScreensSupabase.kt).

### 305.4 Interactive Running Semester Selection & Guided Onboarding Architecture



```mermaid



flowchart TD



    A["Interim CR Opens Course Setup<br>(ClassMateConfigurationActivity / web manage.tsx)"] --> B{"Active Semester<br>Exists?"}



    B -- "Yes (Active)" --> C["Direct Course Creation<br>(courseForm / save_batch_course)"]



    B -- "No (Draft State)" --> D["Prompt: Select Running Semester<br>(Semester 1 to Semester 8)"]



    D --> E["User Chooses Semester"]



    E --> F["RPC publish_semester(target_semester)<br>Status -> active"]



    F --> G["Batch Cache Reloaded<br>(semesterAvailable = true)"]



    G --> H["Automatic Transition to Course Creation<br>(0 Extra Clicks / courseForm(null))"]



```







- **Seamless Guided Onboarding**: Eliminates administrative dead-ends for newly elected interim CRs. Tapping "Add Courses" from the timetable onboarding banner immediately leads to running semester selection followed by direct course registration.



- **Zero-Friction Fallback**: If an interim CR closes the prompt, the clickable status bar remains visible (`"No active semester set. Tap here to select your running semester."`), and tapping either "Add course" or "Choose an existing course" re-opens the prompt cleanly.



- **Full Web Parity**: Both Android native and Next.js companion enforce identical behavior via Supabase RPC `publish_semester`.

## 308. Master Production State v294: Notice Multi-Image Carousel, Zero-Permission Media Attachment Pipeline & Interim CR Onboarding Synthesis



### 308.1 Notice Multi-Image Carousel & ViewPager2 Fullscreen Zoom Architecture

```mermaid

flowchart TD

    A["Notice Loaded in Feed<br>(ClassMateNoticeRow / NoticeAdapter.kt)"] --> B{"imageUrls.size"}

    B -- "== 0" --> C["Hide imagePreviewContainer<br>(isVisible = false)"]

    B -- "== 1" --> D["Single Image Mode<br>(ivPreview VISIBLE, Pager GONE)"]

    B -- "> 1" --> E["Multi-Image Carousel Mode<br>(ViewPager2 VISIBLE, ivPreview GONE)"]

    E --> F["NoticeImageCarouselAdapter<br>(RoundedCornersImage + Glide)"]

    E --> G["Dynamic Pill Indicator<br>(tvCarouselIndicator: 1 / N)"]

    E --> H["Page Change Callback<br>(OnPageChangeCallback updates text)"]

    E --> I["Tap on Carousel Image / Container<br>(Intent -> ImageViewerActivity)"]

    I --> J["Fullscreen ViewPager2 Gallery<br>(FullscreenImagePagerAdapter)"]

    J --> K["PhotoView Pinch-to-Zoom<br>(Decoupled Swipe: isUserInputEnabled = scale <= 1.05)"]

    J --> L["In-Memory Bitmap Preload<br>(cachedBitmaps for instant Save & Share)"]

```



- **Core Components & Integration**:

  - [`NoticeAdapter.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/adapters/NoticeAdapter.kt):

    - Multi-image detection: Evaluates `val hasImages = imageUrls.isNotEmpty()`, activating `binding.imagePreviewContainer.isVisible = hasImages`.

    - Mode Branching:

      - If `imageUrls.size > 1`: Suppresses `ivPreview` (`View.GONE`), displays `imageCarouselPager` (`View.VISIBLE`) and `tvCarouselIndicator` (`View.VISIBLE`), setting text to `"1 / ${imageUrls.size}"` and subtitle to `"Tap to view & zoom"`.

      - Mounts [`NoticeImageCarouselAdapter`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/adapters/NoticeImageCarouselAdapter.kt) onto `binding.imageCarouselPager`.

      - Registers `ViewPager2.OnPageChangeCallback`: On `onPageSelected(position)`, dynamically updates `tvCarouselIndicator.text = "${position + 1} / ${imageUrls.size}"`.

      - Container click listener captures `binding.imageCarouselPager.currentItem` and passes it as `ImageViewerActivity.EXTRA_INITIAL_POSITION`.

      - If `imageUrls.size == 1`: Renders `ivPreview` (`View.VISIBLE`), hides `imageCarouselPager` and `tvCarouselIndicator` (`View.GONE`), and updates subtitle to `"Tap to view"`.

  - [`NoticeImageCarouselAdapter.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/adapters/NoticeImageCarouselAdapter.kt):

    - Clean, lightweight `RecyclerView.Adapter` using [`item_notice_carousel_image.xml`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/res/layout/item_notice_carousel_image.xml).

    - Features `ShapeableImageView` with `@style/RoundedCornersImage` and `?attr/selectableItemBackground` ripple.

    - Glide pipeline: `.transition(DrawableTransitionOptions.withCrossFade())`, `.placeholder(R.drawable.bg_notice_modern_card)`, `.centerCrop()`.

  - Fullscreen Gallery & Gesture Decoupling in [`ImageViewerActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ImageViewerActivity.kt):

    - Multi-image intent handling: Reads `EXTRA_IMAGE_URLS` (`getStringArrayListExtra`) and `EXTRA_INITIAL_POSITION`.

    - Swapping views: In multi-image mode, `photoView.visibility = View.GONE` and `viewPagerImages.visibility = View.VISIBLE`.

    - Dynamic header: Updates `tvImageTitle` to `"Image ${position + 1} of ${imageUrls.size}"`.

    - Pinch-to-Zoom & Swipe Decoupling: Each item in `FullscreenImagePagerAdapter` uses `PhotoView`. Whenever `photoView.scale > 1.05f`, ViewPager2 swiping is locked (`viewPagerImages.isUserInputEnabled = false`), eliminating horizontal conflict between zooming/panning a photo and flipping pages.

    - Bitmap Caching & Operations: Decoded bitmaps are cached in `cachedBitmaps[pos]`. Save button writes directly to `MediaStore.Images.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI` with clean timestamp and MIME type `image/jpeg`. Share button generates secure `FileProvider` URI and invokes `Intent.ACTION_SEND`.

### 308.2 Modern Android Zero-Permission Media Attachment & Cloudflare R2 Isolated Storage

- **Modern Photo Picker Adoption**:

  - Replaced intrusive legacy storage permission flows (`READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE`, `READ_MEDIA_IMAGES`) with the modern Android Photo Picker contract (`ActivityResultContracts.PickVisualMedia` and `PickMultipleVisualMedia`).

  - **Zero Manifest Permission Overhead**: Modern Photo Picker runs out-of-process via Android System UI, requiring zero runtime permission requests, eliminating user friction and permission denial crashes.

  - Document picker for PDFs uses `ActivityResultContracts.GetContent()` or `GetMultipleContents()` with MIME type `application/pdf`.

- **Notice Storage Isolation**:

  - Dedicated storage bucket: `notice-attachments` in Cloudflare R2 / Supabase Storage.

  - Keeps broadcast media strictly decoupled from academic course archives (`course-materials` bucket).

  - Secure signed URLs with configurable TTL protect attachments from unauthorized public scraping.

- **Visual Parity for PDF Attachments**:

  - PDF attachments in notices match the academic course library cards:

    - Red squircle icon container (`@drawable/bg_library_file_icon_red` / `#FEE2E2`).

    - Red PDF icon (`@drawable/ic_picture_as_pdf` / `#DC2626`).

    - Bold `PDF` pill badge (`@drawable/bg_badge_pdf`).

    - Formatted file size readout (`1.4 MB`, `850 KB`) and clean filename.

### 308.3 Interim CR Running Semester Activation & 0-Click Course Flow Engine

- **Lifecycle Context & Problem**:

  - During batch provisioning, 8 semester records (`Semester 1` to `Semester 8`) are seeded in `classmate.semesters` with initial `status = 'draft'`.

  - When a newly elected interim CR opened Course Setup from the Timetable onboarding banner, the app previously blocked them with:

    > *"Active semester needed — Ask the global admin to publish a semester in Manage ? Batches & semesters before adding courses."*

  - This prevented autonomous course and schedule setup by batch leaders.

- **Cross-Platform Resolution & Architecture**:

  - **Android APK Native** ([`ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt)):

    - Integrated `promptSelectRunningSemester(onSemesterActivated: () -> Unit)`:

      - Automatically invoked if `mode == "courses" && !semesterAvailable`.

      - Queries `semesters` ordered by `semester_number`.

      - Displays `MaterialAlertDialogBuilder` with title `"Select Running Semester"` and explanatory prompt:

        > *"Which semester is your batch currently running? This will activate your batch curriculum, timetable routine, and course files."*

      - Active semesters display `"Semester N     Currently Active ?"`.

      - Selection invokes Supabase RPC `publish_semester(target_semester)`.

      - Sets `semesterAvailable = true`, reloads batch configuration, and immediately calls `onSemesterActivated()`.

    - **0-Click Transition**: Tapping a semester activates it and immediately opens the `"Add Course"` dialog (`courseForm(null)`), eliminating extra navigation steps.

    - **Clickable Fallback Banner**: If dismissed, the status bar displays `"No active semester set. Tap here to select your running semester."` with tap-to-prompt listener.

  - **Web Companion Parity** ([`manage.tsx`](file:///D:/Code%20&%20Scripts/ClassMate-main/web/src/components/manage.tsx)):

    - `promptSelectRunningSemester()` presents `"Set Running Semester"` modal triggering RPC `publish_semester`.

    - Intercepts course creation when `!activeSemester`.

    - Displays guidance banner: `"Step 1: Set your Batch's Running Semester"`.

    - Batch creation includes `target_initial_semester` dropdown (Semesters 1-8 or None/Draft).

### 309.2 Web Transit Real-Time Radar & Leaflet Camera Stabilization Architecture

```mermaid

flowchart TD

    A["Active Clock Tick<br>(clockNow every 1000ms)"] --> B["predictBusPosition(bus, clockNow)"]

    B --> C["Extrapolated lat/lon Updated"]

    C --> D{"User Selected Bus?"}

    D -- "Yes" --> E{"lastCenteredBusIdRef == bus.id?"}

    E -- "No (Initial Selection)" --> F["mapRef.flyTo(busPos, zoom, 0.8s)<br>lastCenteredBusIdRef = bus.id"]

    E -- "Yes (Continuous Tick)" --> G["Do NOT flyTo!<br>Update Marker Position ONLY"]

    G --> H["User Free to Pan & Pinch Map<br>ZERO Camera Jitter / Earthquake Shaking"]

    H --> I["Floating Manual Recenter Button<br>(Available on-demand if panned away)"]

```



- **Root Cause & Earthquake Shaking Diagnosis**:

  - In [`transit.tsx`](file:///D:/Code%20&%20Scripts/ClassMate-main/web/src/components/transit.tsx), the active clock (`clockNow`) updates every `1000ms`.

  - Bus positions are continuously extrapolated each second using `predictBusPosition(bus, clockNow)`, recalculating `selectedBus.lat` and `selectedBus.lon`.

  - Previously, the camera auto-centering `useEffect` included `[selectedBus?.lat, selectedBus?.lon]` in its dependency array and invoked `mapRef.current.flyTo(..., { animate: true, duration: 0.8 })`.

  - **Symptom**: Every 1000ms, an 800ms camera fly animation was triggered while the previous one was barely finishing. When the user touched or moved the map, user gesture input fought Leaflet's forced continuous camera animation, causing the entire map to violently shake, jitter, and blink ("like an earthquake").

- **Architectural Solution & Stabilization**:

  - Introduced `lastCenteredBusIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);`.

  - Decoupled camera auto-centering from extrapolated 1-second position updates.

  - When a bus is selected, `flyTo` runs **strictly once** to focus the bus marker.

  - The user retains complete manual camera pan/zoom control with zero camera jitter or gesture fighting.

  - If the user pans away, a floating manual re-center button allows instant manual re-centering on demand.

- **Bus Detail View Decluttering & Redesign**:

  - **Viewport Rebalancing**: Reduced top pinned section footprint from **over 65% of the viewport** down to a slim, unified **~80px live status card**, leaving abundant vertical space for stoppage lists.

  - **Terminal-Specific Routes**: Eliminated the hard-wired 28-corridor station loop that previously crowded terminating buses with irrelevant stations.

    - Buses terminating at *Nirala More* display their clean **16 stops**.

    - Buses terminating at *Puraton Bus Stand (Dhaleshwari)* display their clean **18 stops**.

  - **Unified Live Status & Departure Card**: Replaced duplicate hero cards and 4-pill telemetry boxes with a single unified card displaying:

    - Next stop and live drive ETA.

    - Next scheduled departure for the active direction with live countdown.

    - Direct pilot/driver contact call link and user proximity distance.

  - **Segmented Direction Switcher**: Slim segmented control toggling departure schedule and smoothly reversing stoppage order in the exact direction of travel.

  - **High-Contrast Bengali Stepper**: Muted passed stops with checkmarks, highlighted approaching stops with a pulsing active bus badge, and clean Bengali typography displaying 6 to 8 stops simultaneously.

- **Multi-Image Carousel Mode** ([`NoticeAdapter.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/adapters/NoticeAdapter.kt), [`NoticeImageCarouselAdapter.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/adapters/NoticeImageCarouselAdapter.kt)):

  - Evaluates `val hasImages = imageUrls.isNotEmpty()`, activating `binding.imagePreviewContainer.isVisible = hasImages`.

  - When `imageUrls.size > 1`: Suppresses `ivPreview` (`View.GONE`), displays `imageCarouselPager` (`ViewPager2`, `View.VISIBLE`), and renders floating indicator `tvCarouselIndicator` (`"1 / ${imageUrls.size}"`) with subtitle `"Tap to view & zoom"`.

  - Single-image notices cleanly retain standard single-image rendering (`ivPreview`).

  - Registers `ViewPager2.OnPageChangeCallback` to dynamically update the indicator on page selection.

  - Container click listener passes `binding.imageCarouselPager.currentItem` as `ImageViewerActivity.EXTRA_INITIAL_POSITION`.

- **Fullscreen Gallery & Gesture Decoupling** ([`ImageViewerActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ImageViewerActivity.kt)):

  - Multi-image intent handling via `EXTRA_IMAGE_URLS` and `EXTRA_INITIAL_POSITION`.

  - Uses `PhotoView` inside `FullscreenImagePagerAdapter`.

  - **Pinch-to-Zoom & Swipe Decoupling**: Whenever `photoView.scale > 1.05f`, ViewPager2 touch swiping is locked (`viewPagerImages.isUserInputEnabled = false`), eliminating horizontal conflict between zooming/panning a photo and flipping carousel pages.

  - In-memory bitmap cache (`cachedBitmaps[pos]`) powers instant image saving to `MediaStore.Images.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI` and secure `FileProvider` sharing via `Intent.ACTION_SEND`.

- **Zero-Permission Photo Picker & Isolated Storage**:

  - Replaced legacy runtime storage permission flows with the modern Android Photo Picker contract (`ActivityResultContracts.PickVisualMedia` and `PickMultipleVisualMedia`), eliminating manifest permission overhead.

  - Dedicated `notice-attachments` bucket in Cloudflare R2 / Supabase Storage with signed URL TTL.

  - PDF attachments styled to match academic course library cards: red squircle container (`bg_library_file_icon_red`), bold `PDF` badge pill (`bg_badge_pdf`), and clean file size readouts.

### 309.4 Interim CR Running Semester Activation & 0-Click Course Flow Engine

- **Lifecycle Context & Problem**:

  - During initial batch provisioning, 8 semester records (`Semester 1` to `Semester 8`) are seeded in `classmate.semesters` with initial `status = 'draft'`.

  - When a newly elected interim CR attempted to configure courses from the Timetable onboarding banner, the app blocked them with:

    > *"Active semester needed - Ask the global admin to publish a semester in Manage Batches & semesters before adding courses."*

- **Cross-Platform Resolution & Architecture**:

  - **Android APK Native** ([`ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt)):

    - Integrated `promptSelectRunningSemester(onSemesterActivated: () -> Unit)` automatically invoked if `mode == "courses" && !semesterAvailable`.

    - Queries `semesters` ordered by `semester_number` and displays a `MaterialAlertDialogBuilder` prompting the CR to select their batch's current running semester.

    - Selection invokes Supabase RPC `publish_semester(target_semester)`, sets `semesterAvailable = true`, reloads batch configuration, and immediately calls `onSemesterActivated()`.

    - **0-Click Transition**: Tapping a semester activates it and immediately opens the `"Add Course"` dialog (`courseForm(null)`), eliminating extra navigation steps.

    - Clickable fallback banner: If dismissed, displays `"No active semester set. Tap here to select your running semester."` with tap-to-prompt listener.

  - **Web Companion Parity** ([`manage.tsx`](file:///D:/Code%20&%20Scripts/ClassMate-main/web/src/components/manage.tsx)):

    - `promptSelectRunningSemester()` presents `"Set Running Semester"` modal triggering RPC `publish_semester`.

    - Intercepts course creation when `!activeSemester` and displays guidance banner `"Step 1: Set your Batch's Running Semester"`.

### 309.6 Expanded Debugging & Solving Knowledgebase (Issues 31 to 36)



#### Issue 31: Continuous Leaflet Camera Jitter & Rapid Blinking ("Earthquake Shaking") during Real-Time GPS Extrapolation

- **Symptom**: In the Web Transit module, selecting a live bus caused the map to violently oscillate, jerk, and blink. Touching or panning the map resulted in extreme gesture stutter, making the interface completely unusable.

- **Root Cause**: The 1000ms clock interval extrapolated live bus positions, continuously altering `selectedBus.lat` and `selectedBus.lon`. The camera auto-centering hook depended directly on these coordinate values, triggering an 800ms `mapRef.current.flyTo` animation every 1000ms. The ongoing animation continuously conflicted with user touch gestures and subsequent ticks.

- **Resolution**: Implemented `lastCenteredBusIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);` in [`web/src/components/transit.tsx`](file:///D:/Code%20&%20Scripts/ClassMate-main/web/src/components/transit.tsx). Decoupled camera auto-centering so that `flyTo` executes strictly once upon selecting a bus. Position updates alter only the marker icon coordinates. Added an on-demand floating manual re-center button.



#### Issue 32: Transit Detail Sheet Viewport Crowding & City Loop Route Clutter

- **Symptom**: Opening transit details covered over 65% of the mobile screen with duplicate telemetry boxes, leaving only 1 to 2 stops visible. Furthermore, terminating buses displayed irrelevant stops from across the entire 28-station city perimeter.

- **Root Cause**: Hard-coded 28-stop corridor array was shared across all bus routes without terminal boundary filtering. Next stop, ETA, and departure countdown were duplicated across three separate layout cards.

- **Resolution**: Filtered routes by terminal: 16 stops for Nirala More buses and 18 stops for Dhaleshwari / Old Bus Stand buses. Replaced redundant cards with a single unified ~80px live status card and a compact, high-contrast Bengali stoppage stepper with pulsing active node.



#### Issue 33: Interim CR Course Setup Onboarding Deadlock with Draft Semesters

- **Symptom**: When a newly elected interim CR clicked "Add Course" from the Timetable onboarding card, the application blocked them with an error indicating an active semester was required, directing them to contact a global admin.

- **Root Cause**: Batch provisioning seeds 8 semester records in `status = 'draft'`. Course creation requires an `active` semester ID, but interim CRs lacked an obvious workflow to promote a draft semester.

- **Resolution**: Implemented `promptSelectRunningSemester` in [`ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt) and [`manage.tsx`](file:///D:/Code%20&%20Scripts/ClassMate-main/web/src/components/manage.tsx). Prompts CR to choose Semesters 1-8, invokes Supabase RPC `publish_semester`, and seamlessly transitions to `courseForm(null)` in 0 clicks.



#### Issue 34: PhotoView Pinch-to-Zoom Gesture Collision with ViewPager2 Swiping

- **Symptom**: When attempting to pinch and zoom an image in the fullscreen notice gallery, horizontal panning gestures inadvertently flipped to the next/previous image in the ViewPager2 carousel.

- **Root Cause**: ViewPager2 intercepted horizontal touch slop events before child PhotoView touch listeners could consume them for image panning.

- **Resolution**: In [`ImageViewerActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ImageViewerActivity.kt), monitored `photoView.scale`. Whenever `scale > 1.05f`, ViewPager2 swiping is locked via `viewPagerImages.isUserInputEnabled = false`. When zoomed out to normal scale, swiping is re-enabled.



#### Issue 35: Banned Students Receiving Batch Broadcast Push Notifications

- **Symptom**: Suspended students continued to receive FCM push notifications for batch notices and timetable cancellations.

- **Root Cause**: The notification dispatch view `notification_recipients` joined profiles on `batch_id` without filtering on `profile_status != 'suspended'`.

- **Resolution**: Applied migration [`202611050003_exclude_banned_students_from_notifications.sql`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611050003_exclude_banned_students_from_notifications.sql) adding `where p.status != 'suspended'` to `notification_recipients`, ensuring banned students receive zero broadcast notifications.



#### Issue 36: PostgreSQL 42501 Permission Error on CR Batch Overrides Management

- **Symptom**: Batch CRs attempting to save or view batch schedule overrides encountered PostgreSQL error `42501: permission denied for table batch_overrides`.

- **Root Cause**: RLS policies on `classmate.batch_overrides` were restricted to role `admin`, omitting CR permissions.

- **Resolution**: Applied migration [`202611050002_allow_cr_batch_overrides.sql`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611050002_allow_cr_batch_overrides.sql), granting CRs full CRUD access on overrides for their own batch (`batch_id = (select cr_batch_id from classmate.profiles where id = auth.uid())`).

## 310. Master Production State v296: Universal UI Synthesis, Hardware Telemetry Hardening & Multi-Course Batch Media Architecture



### 310.1 Multi-Course Resource Upload & Batch Document Pipeline

```mermaid

flowchart TD

    subgraph MultiFileFlow["Multi-File Course Resource Ingestion"]

        P1["User Selects Multiple Files<br>(PDFs, DOCX, PPTX, Images)"] --> P2["Android Storage Access Framework / Web File Picker<br>(Zero-Permission SAF Intent)"]

        P2 --> P3["Automatic Title Disambiguation<br>(Sanitize Filename, Strip Extensions, Replace Underscores)"]

        P3 --> P4["Parallel Upload Queue<br>(Supabase Storage: course-materials bucket)"]

        P4 --> P5["Atomic Metadata Batch Insertion<br>(classmate.file_metadata & classmate.course_resources)"]

        P5 --> P6["Instant In-Memory Cache Invalidation<br>(0ms Reactive UI Refresh in Course Screen)"]

    end

```



- **High-Level Overview & Workflow**:

  - Previously, adding course resources required students, CRs, and teachers to upload files one by one, manually typing titles and metadata for every individual syllabus handout, lecture slide, or lab manual.

  - Upgraded both the Android APK ([`ClassMateAcademicScreensSupabase.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateAcademicScreensSupabase.kt)) and Web Companion ([`courses.tsx`](file:///D:/Code%20&%20Scripts/ClassMate-main/web/src/components/courses.tsx)) to support multi-file batch ingestion.

- **Automatic Title Disambiguation Engine**:

  - Raw filenames (e.g. `CSE_3201_Lecture_04_Pointers_and_Memory.pdf` or `Lab_Manual_v2.docx`) are automatically parsed and sanitized:

    - Strips file extensions (`.pdf`, `.pptx`, `.docx`, etc.).

    - Converts delimiter characters (`_`, `-`, `%20`) to clean spaces.

    - Preserves numerical tokens (`Lecture 04`, `Lab 2`, `Chapter 7`).

    - Capitalizes title tokens for immediate academic readability while allowing users to refine individual titles inline prior to final commit.

- **Parallel Upload Architecture & Storage Isolation**:

  - Client initiates parallel asynchronous uploads directly to Supabase Storage bucket `course-materials` via chunked multipart streaming.

  - Strictly isolated from notice attachments (`notice-attachments` bucket) and student avatar assets (`avatars` bucket).

  - Employs transactional batch insertion into `classmate.file_metadata` and `classmate.course_resources`, ensuring that if any single file upload fails due to mobile network interruption, successfully uploaded assets are preserved and failed items can be individually retried.



---



### 310.2 Hardware IoT Attendance Terminal Security & Backward-Compatible Handshake Protocol

```mermaid

flowchart LR

    subgraph HardwareTerminal["$14.50 Classroom Edge Node"]

        RFID["RC522 RFID Reader<br>(SPI Bus @ 13.56 MHz)"] --> ESP["ESP32 DevKit V1<br>(Wi-Fi WPA2 Enterprise)"]

        ESP --> OLED["SSD1306 0.96 inch OLED<br>(I2C Bus: 128x64 px)"]

        ESP --> BUZZ["Piezo Buzzer<br>(Success / Failure Beep)"]

    end



    subgraph CloudAPI["Next.js Edge API /api/scan"]

        ESP -->|"HTTP POST JSON {uid, device_id}"| SCAN["Scan Ingestion Route<br>(web/src/app/api/scan/route.ts)"]

        SCAN --> AUTH{"HARDWARE_DEVICE_SECRET<br>Verified?"}

        AUTH -->|"Yes (Upgraded Firmware)"| PROC["Process Attendance Scan"]

        AUTH -->|"No Header (Legacy Box)"| DBCHECK{"Pre-Registered Device in<br>classmate.attendance_devices?"}

        DBCHECK -->|"Whitelisted ID"| PROC

        DBCHECK -->|"Unrecognized Device"| REJECT["HTTP 401 Unauthorized<br>(Security Shield Active)"]

        PROC --> DB[("PostgreSQL RPC<br>process_rfid_scan")]

        DB --> FCM["FCM Push Notification<br>(Immediate Student Alert)"]

    end

```



- **Production Hardware Node Configuration**:

  - Classroom attendance terminals are constructed using commodity open-source hardware (~$14.50 USD total Bill of Materials per classroom):

    - **Microcontroller**: ESP32 DevKit V1 (32-bit dual-core Xtensa LX6 @ 240 MHz, integrated 802.11b/g/n Wi-Fi).

    - **Card Transceiver**: MFRC522 RFID reader module communicating via high-speed SPI bus, scanning 13.56 MHz MIFARE Classic 1K / Ultralight student Smart ID cards.

    - **Telemetry Display**: SSD1306 0.96" monochrome OLED display (I2C interface at address `0x3C`) rendering real-time tap feedback (Student Name, Roll Number, Attendance Confirmation, Timestamp).

    - **Acoustic Feedback**: Active 5V Piezo buzzer emitting distinct frequency signatures: single high-pitch chime (success) vs double low-pitch beep (unregistered / error).

    - **Enclosure**: Custom 3D-printed snap-fit wall-mount enclosure (`esp32_rfid_flat_snapfit_enclosure.stl`) designed specifically for classroom doorway mounting without external exposed wiring.

- **Zero-Downtime Backward-Compatible API Handshake** ([`web/src/app/api/scan/route.ts`](file:///D:/Code%20&%20Scripts/ClassMate-main/web/src/app/api/scan/route.ts)):

  - During the daily security audit, endpoint `/api/scan` was hardened to require a pre-shared cryptographic header `X-Device-Secret: HARDWARE_DEVICE_SECRET`.

  - **Critical Field Challenge**: Physical ESP32 attendance terminals were already deployed and actively mounted inside university classrooms running original baseline firmware that transmitted bare JSON payloads (`{"uid": "...", "device_id": "..."}`) without custom authorization headers.

  - **Resolution**: Implemented dual-mode authentication in [`route.ts`](file:///D:/Code%20&%20Scripts/ClassMate-main/web/src/app/api/scan/route.ts):

    1. If `X-Device-Secret` header matches the Vercel environment secret, the request is immediately authorized.

    2. If the header is missing, the endpoint queries `classmate.attendance_devices` for the provided `device_id`. If the device is found in the verified campus hardware inventory and has `status = 'active'`, the scan is permitted, logging an internal deprecation notice without disrupting student attendance.

    3. Unregistered device IDs without the secret are strictly rejected with `HTTP 401 Unauthorized`.

- **Smart Card Lookup Privacy Masking** (Migration [`202611040002_harden_student_card_lookup.sql`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611040002_harden_student_card_lookup.sql)):

  - When students or third parties scan a card via public NFC reader / lookup interfaces, the public response omits sensitive academic performance data (`attendance_percentage`).

  - Full statistical records and attendance percentages are returned exclusively when authenticated as the student themselves, the enrolled batch CR, or the assigned course teacher.

### 310.3 Universal 4-Tab Navigation & Header Alignment Standardization

- **Android App Architectural Alignment**:

  - The ClassMate Android APK is anchored by a streamlined 4-tab bottom navigation structure:

    1. **Timetable** ([`fragment_timetable.xml`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/res/layout/fragment_timetable.xml))

    3. **Courses** ([`fragment_courses.xml`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/res/layout/fragment_courses.xml))

    4. **Profile** ([`classmate_profile.xml`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/res/layout/classmate_profile.xml))

- **Universal Hamburger Drawer Trigger (`btnHamburgerMenu`)**:

  - In earlier versions, the top hamburger drawer button was only present on the Timetable screen, leaving users stranded on Notices, Courses, or Profile tabs without access to secondary modules (Bus Schedule, Batch Fund, Emergency Contacts).

  - Promoted `btnHamburgerMenu` to a universal header component present on all 4 tabs.

  - Standardized the toolbar layout geometry:

### 310.7 Deep-Dive Debugging & Solving Knowledgebase (Issues 37 to 42)



#### Issue 37: Multi-File Course Resource Upload Batch Ingestion & Title Disambiguation

- **Symptom**: Class representatives and teachers uploading course materials had to repeatedly open file pickers and enter metadata for each individual handout or lecture slide, creating high friction during beginning-of-semester course setup.

- **Root Cause**: The storage upload flow in both Android and Web was architected as a strictly single-item pipeline with blocking modal dialogs per file.

- **Resolution**: Implemented multi-file selection support for course documents. Automatically derives initial document titles from sanitized file names (stripping extensions and URL encoded delimiters), with batch parallel upload to Supabase Storage and atomic bulk insertion into `classmate.file_metadata` and `classmate.course_resources`.



#### Issue 38: Deployed Classroom ESP32 Attendance Terminal Backward Compatibility & Hardware Secret Enforcement

- **Symptom**: Hardening the scan API endpoint (`/api/scan`) with mandatory `HARDWARE_DEVICE_SECRET` risked immediately breaking physically deployed ESP32 RFID attendance boxes installed on campus walls if they ran older firmware without secret headers.

- **Root Cause**: Previous hardware firmware sent raw JSON `{ "uid": "...", "device_id": "..." }` without authorization bearer headers.

- **Resolution**: In [`web/src/app/api/scan/route.ts`](file:///D:/Code%20&%20Scripts/ClassMate-main/web/src/app/api/scan/route.ts), implemented backward-compatible fallback validation. Verified secret header if present; for deployed legacy hardware devices, cross-validated `device_id` against pre-registered classroom hardware records in `classmate.attendance_devices` before processing scans, logging migration telemetry without disrupting physical class attendance.



#### Issue 39: Universal Hamburger Menu & Header Typography Misalignment across Android Tabs

- **Symptom**: The hamburger navigation icon (`btnHamburgerMenu`) only appeared on the Timetable screen. On Notices, Courses, and Profile screens, users had no quick drawer access. When initially copied to all tabs, the hamburger icon and header titles had inconsistent vertical alignment, unequal top padding, and broken centering.

- **Root Cause**: Each tab layout (`fragment_timetable.xml`, `item_notice_modern.xml`/notice fragment, `fragment_courses.xml`, `classmate_profile.xml`) utilized disparate toolbar heights (`wrap_content` vs `56dp`), inconsistent top margins, and mismatched gravity properties.

- **Resolution**: Unified app bar layout patterns across all 4 tab headers. Standardized toolbar container height to `56dp`, set vertical centering (`layout_gravity="center_vertical"`), matched icon size (`24dp` with `40dp` touch target / padding), and consistent typography (`Plus Jakarta Sans Bold 20sp`).



#### Issue 40: Redundant "Personal Details" Action Row in Profile Screen

- **Symptom**: Users viewing the Profile screen saw two separate ways to edit personal info: the hero edit badge (`btnHeroEditProfile`) on the profile card and a duplicate "Personal Details" item in the settings list (`btnEditPersonal`).

- **Root Cause**: Historical migration left legacy settings item in `classmate_profile.xml` when modern hero header was introduced.

- **Resolution**: Removed `btnEditPersonal` from `classmate_profile.xml` and removed its click listener binding in [`ClassMateAcademicScreensSupabase.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateAcademicScreensSupabase.kt). Consolidated all personal profile edits under the hero action badge.



#### Issue 41: Timetable Off-Day Sun Indicator Artifact

- **Symptom**: When viewing off-days or university holidays in the Timetable, a redundant circular `@drawable/ic_sun` icon appeared directly below the holiday kite artwork, cluttering the empty state illustration.

- **Root Cause**: Legacy empty-state layout retained a nested icon container from an older weather-integrated routine mockup.

- **Resolution**: Cleaned [`fragment_timetable.xml`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/res/layout/fragment_timetable.xml), removing the extraneous sun icon view and preserving the clean, centered holiday kite vector with proper text hierarchy.



#### Issue 42: Targeted Push Notification Filtering for Production Releases

- **Symptom**: When deploying production APK updates (e.g. v1.1.35), broadcast update push notifications were being delivered to internal testing/faculty accounts (`hadifur@mbstu.ac.bd`, `hadifur@gmail.com`) that should not receive automated update prompts.

- **Root Cause**: The release publication Edge Function broadcasted FCM alerts to all enrolled FCM tokens without recipient email suppression.

- **Resolution**: Enhanced Supabase Edge Function `publish-classmate-release` to parse email suppression lists, excluding specified email addresses from notification recipient batch queries. Added CLI parameter `--skip-recipients` to release scripts.
