## 311. Master Production State v297: Multi-University Multi-Tenant Architecture, Teacher Auto-Binding Engine & Administration Hardening



### 311.1 Multi-University Multi-Tenant Architectural Evolution (Rajshahi University / RU Onboarding Roadmap)

```mermaid

flowchart TD

    subgraph ClientGateway["Client Multi-Campus Auth Gateway"]

        USelect["User Selects Campus<br>(MBSTU vs University of Rajshahi)"] --> DPolicy{"Domain & Identity Rules"}

        DPolicy -->|"MBSTU"| D1["Hosted Domain: mbstu.ac.bd<br>Prefix Regex: ^([a-z]{2})(\d{2})\d{3}$<br>Dept: CE (CSE), Roll: CE-21001"]

        DPolicy -->|"Rajshahi Univ (RU)"| D2["Domain: ru.ac.bd / cse.ru.ac.bd / Google OAuth<br>Student Roll Regex: ^(\d{8}|\d{10})$<br>Dept: CSE, Session: 2020-21"]

    end



    subgraph MultiTenantDB["Supabase Multi-Tenant Partitioning"]

        D1 --> DB_MBSTU["Tenant Partition: MBSTU<br>(university_id = mbstu_uuid)"]

        D2 --> DB_RU["Tenant Partition: Rajshahi University<br>(university_id = ru_uuid)"]

        

        DB_MBSTU --> AC_M["Academic Data: MBSTU Batches<br>Notices, Timetable, Courses, Attendance"]

        DB_RU --> AC_R["Academic Data: RU Batches<br>Notices, Timetable, Courses, Attendance"]

        

        DB_MBSTU --> BL_M["Emergency Blood Donors<br>(Geo-fence: Tangail Campus Radius)"]

        DB_RU --> BL_R["Emergency Blood Donors<br>(Geo-fence: Rajshahi Campus Radius)"]

        

        DB_MBSTU --> TR_M["Transit: MBSTU Wheels<br>(Real-Time MQTT / GPS Bus Telemetry)"]

        DB_RU --> TR_R["Transit: RU Campus Bus Transit<br>(Katakhali, Shaheb Bazar, City Routes)"]

    end



    subgraph SecurityShield["Cross-Campus Isolation Shield"]

        AC_M -.->|"Zero Cross-Campus Bleed"| AC_R

        RLS["PostgreSQL Row-Level Security<br>Enforces university_id & department_id"] --> AC_M

        RLS --> AC_R

    end

```



- **Strategic Objective & Context**:

  - ClassMate was originally developed and optimized for the Department of Computer Science & Engineering at Mawlana Bhashani Science and Technology University (MBSTU).

  - Following the success of the MBSTU deployment, architecture planning commenced to expand ClassMate into a comprehensive multi-institution smart campus platform, beginning with the **University of Rajshahi (RU)**.

  - The Supabase database schema was architected with a top-level multi-tenant entity hierarchy (`universities` $

ightarrow$ `departments` $

ightarrow$ `batches` $

ightarrow$ `semesters`), but client applications and auth gateways previously assumed MBSTU-specific constraints.

- **Key Architectural Decoupling Pillars for Multi-Campus Expansion**:

  1. **Dynamic Campus Selection & Multi-Domain Auth Gateway**:

     - *Client Onboarding*: Replaces the hardcoded `setHostedDomain("mbstu.ac.bd")` in Google Sign-In with an interactive campus selection sheet (`select_university_sheet.xml`).

     - *Domain Flexibility*: Accommodates university-specific email domains (`@ru.ac.bd`, `@cse.ru.ac.bd`) while providing verified fallback onboarding for institutions where students use personal Google accounts with manual student verification.

     - *Configurable Roll/Student ID Parsing*: Replaces static MBSTU regex parsing (`ce21001@mbstu.ac.bd` $

ightarrow$ `CE-21001`) with configurable tenant-specific parser strategy engines:

       - MBSTU: Department token prefix (`CE`, `TE`, `BMB`) + 2-digit session year + 3-digit roll number.

       - Rajshahi University (RU): Standard 8-digit or 10-digit institutional student registration codes (e.g. `21105761xx`).

  2. **Strict Multi-Tenant Database Isolation (Zero Cross-Campus Bleed)**:

     - All queries for notices, timetables, courses, syllabus materials, and exam cancellations are strictly bound to `university_id` and `department_id`.

     - Cross-tenant leakage is prevented via PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS), guaranteeing that an RU student never sees MBSTU notices, timetable entries, or class cancellations.

  3. **Geo-Fenced Emergency Blood Donor Network**:

     - Blood donation broadcasts were previously scoped globally or by batch.

     - In the multi-tenant architecture, emergency blood requests are partitioned by regional campus geo-fences (e.g. Tangail vs Rajshahi metropolitan area), ensuring urgent donor calls reach only physically nearby students.

  4. **Campus-Specific Transit Integration**:

     - MBSTU utilizes live GPS telemetry integrated with the campus Wheels portal (`transport.mbstu.ac.bd`).

     - For Rajshahi University, the system provisions structured campus transit schedules (e.g. Katakhali, Shaheb Bazar, Station, and University routes) with scheduled departure alerts and driver contacts.

### 311.2 Automatic Teacher Assignment & Database Trigger Synchronization

```mermaid

flowchart TD

    subgraph CourseSaveFlow["Atomic Course Save & Faculty Assignment"]

        C1["CR / Admin Saves Course<br>save_batch_course(batch, code, title, teacher)"] --> C2["pg_advisory_xact_lock<br>(Serialize concurrent writes per department)"]

        C2 --> C3{"Teacher in<br>teacher_directory?"}

        C3 -->|"Exists"| C4["Resolve teacher_record_id"]

        C3 -->|"New Name"| C5["Auto-insert into classmate.teacher_directory"]

        C5 --> C4

        C4 --> C6["Insert / Update classmate.semester_courses<br>(Apply title, code, credit, type overrides)"]

        C6 --> C7{"Teacher has registered<br>profile in profiles?"}

        C7 -->|"Yes (profile_id != null)"| C8["Upsert into classmate.teacher_course_assignments<br>(on conflict do update set active = true)"]

        C7 -->|"No Profile Yet"| C9["Preserve teacher_record_id for future auto-binding"]

        C8 --> C10["Update classmate.routine_slots.type<br>(Sync lab / class based on inferred_type)"]

        C10 --> C11["Commit Transaction & Audit Log"]

    end

```



- **Backend Migration Architecture** ([`supabase/migrations/202611050001_auto_assign_teacher_on_save_course.sql`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611050001_auto_assign_teacher_on_save_course.sql)):

  - Upgraded PostgreSQL RPC `classmate.save_batch_course` with automated end-to-end faculty synchronization:

    - **Advisory Serialization**: Incorporates `pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(dept::text || lower(regexp_replace(trim(target_teacher_name), '\s+', ' ', 'g')), 0))` to prevent race conditions and duplicate teacher entries during high-concurrency beginning-of-semester course creation.

    - **Directory Resolution**: Queries `classmate.teacher_directory` prioritizing entries with registered profile IDs and verified email addresses.

    - **Active Course Assignment Upsert**: If the assigned faculty member has a registered profile in `classmate.profiles`, the function automatically executes:

      ```sql

      insert into classmate.teacher_course_assignments(teacher_id, semester_course_id, assigned_by)

      select td.profile_id, offering.id, auth.uid()

      from classmate.teacher_directory td

      where td.id = teacher_id and td.profile_id is not null

      on conflict (teacher_id, semester_course_id) do update set active = true;

      ```

    - **Routine Slot Synchronization**: Automatically updates associated `classmate.routine_slots.type` based on inferred course type (`lab` vs `class`), eliminating manual timetable reclassification.

### 311.3 Class Representative Batch Overrides & Dropout Re-Add Architecture

- **Backend Authorization Elevation** ([`supabase/migrations/202611050002_allow_cr_batch_overrides.sql`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611050002_allow_cr_batch_overrides.sql)):

  - **The 42501 Authorization Bottleneck**: Previously, managing batch overrides (transferring student profiles between batches for academic dropouts, readmitted students, or inter-session transfers) strictly required app owner privileges (`classmate.is_owner()`).

  - **Resolution**: Enhanced RPCs `owner_batch_overrides()`, `set_batch_override()`, and `delete_batch_override()`, along with table RLS policy `batch_overrides_select`, granting authorization to active Class Representatives (`classmate.can_manage_batch(effective_batch_id)`).

  - **Automated Profile Re-alignment**:

    - When a batch override is committed, the student's profile in `classmate.profiles` is atomically updated:

      - `batch_id = batch_row.id`

      - `department_id = batch_row.department_id`

      - `academic_session = batch_row.academic_session`

      - `verification_status = 'active'`

    - If the re-assigned student previously held CR status in an older batch, their CR status (`is_cr`, `cr_batch_id`, `cr_valid_until`) is safely revoked to prevent unauthorized cross-batch governance.

- **Android APK Native Implementation** ([`ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt)):

  - Mode `"overrides"`: CRs and Admins can view all configured overrides with target student ID, department, batch number, academic session, and audit reason.

  - Tapping "+ Add student override" automatically prefills the CR's managed `batch_id`, preventing accidental assignment to wrong batches.

### 311.4 Banned Student Broadcast Isolation & Push Notification Shield

- **Vulnerability Analysis**:

  - Daily security audits revealed that when a disruptive or suspended student was banned via `classmate.student_bans`, the student was prevented from logging into the app UI, but their registered device FCM tokens still received real-time broadcast push notifications for notices, cancellations, and routine changes.

- **Dual-Layer Push Isolation Shield** ([`supabase/migrations/202611050003_exclude_banned_students_from_notifications.sql`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611050003_exclude_banned_students_from_notifications.sql)):

  1. **Outbox Query Filtering (`notification_recipients`)**:

     - When generating recipient token lists for batch academic broadcasts (notices, routine updates, polls, class changes), the database strictly checks:

       ```sql

       and not exists (

         select 1 from classmate.student_bans sb

         where sb.profile_id = p.id

           and sb.lifted_at is null

           and sb.starts_at <= now()

           and sb.ends_at > now()

       )

       ```

     - For targeted personal notifications, banned students are excluded from all messages except official disciplinary notices (`student_ban` and `student_ban_lifted`).

  2. **Device-Level Dispatch Guard (`notification_device_allowed`)**:

     - Validates active ban status at FCM dispatch time: if an active suspension is in effect and the event kind is not disciplinary, the RPC immediately returns `false`, preventing any notification transmission to the student's device hardware.

### 311.5 Multi-Image Notice Attachments & Media Ingestion Schema

- **Database Schema Upgrades** ([`supabase/migrations/202611050004_multi_image_attachments.sql`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611050004_multi_image_attachments.sql)):

  - Upgraded `prepare_notice_image` to support up to **5 images per notice** (or a single PDF document).

  - Enforces mutually exclusive media types: notices cannot mix PDF documents with image sets.

  - Re-engineered `list_visible_notices`:

    - Materializes a JSONB array `attachments` containing `storage_key`, `file_name`, `mime_type`, and `size_bytes` for all attached media.

    - Preserves legacy scalar columns (`attachment_storage_key`, `attachment_file_name`, `attachment_mime_type`) to ensure backward compatibility for older APK versions in the wild.

- **Android APK Multi-Image Carousel & Fullscreen Zoom**:

  - **Inline Carousel Adapter** ([`NoticeImageCarouselAdapter.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/adapters/NoticeImageCarouselAdapter.kt)):

    - Bound to `vpNoticeImages` inside [`item_notice_modern.xml`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/res/layout/item_notice_modern.xml).

### 311.6 Expanded Debugging & Solving Knowledgebase (Issues 43 to 48)



#### Issue 43: University-Level Authentication Domain Lock & Tenancy Decoupling

- **Symptom**: Students and faculty from Rajshahi University (RU) could not authenticate with Google Sign-In; the client rejected non-MBSTU accounts or failed to parse student rolls.

- **Root Cause**: `GoogleSignInOptions.Builder.setHostedDomain("mbstu.ac.bd")` was hardcoded in Android authentication activities, and the roll extractor regex strictly expected `^([a-z]{2})(\d{2})\d{3}@mbstu\.ac\.bd$`.

- **Resolution**: Designed a multi-campus tenancy abstraction layer. Created a configurable university registry mapping accepted email domains (`@ru.ac.bd`, `@cse.ru.ac.bd`) and custom roll parser strategies per institution, coupled with an interactive campus selection sheet prior to OAuth sign-in.



#### Issue 44: Duplicate Teacher Directory Records During Concurrent Course Setup

- **Symptom**: When multiple CRs or administrators simultaneously configured courses taught by the same instructor, duplicate entries appeared in `classmate.teacher_directory`.

- **Root Cause**: A race condition existed between checking for teacher name existence and inserting new records in PostgreSQL RPC `save_batch_course`.

- **Resolution**: In migration [`202611050001_auto_assign_teacher_on_save_course.sql`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611050001_auto_assign_teacher_on_save_course.sql), introduced transaction-level advisory locks via `pg_advisory_xact_lock` using a 64-bit hash of department UUID and normalized teacher name, cleanly serializing concurrent course saves.



#### Issue 45: PostgreSQL 42501 Permission Error on CR Batch Overrides

- **Symptom**: When a newly elected Class Representative attempted to access or add batch overrides for readmitted or dropout students, the operation crashed with `42501 Unauthorized`.

- **Root Cause**: Function `owner_batch_overrides` and related RPCs checked exclusively for `classmate.is_owner()`, rejecting legitimate CRs managing their own batches.

- **Resolution**: Deployed migration [`202611050002_allow_cr_batch_overrides.sql`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611050002_allow_cr_batch_overrides.sql), adding `classmate.can_manage_batch(effective_batch_id)` security branches and updating RLS policies to allow CRs full override management for their designated batches.



#### Issue 46: Banned Students Receiving Routine and Cancellation Push Notifications

- **Symptom**: Students placed under active disciplinary bans continued to receive push notifications on their Android devices for class cancellations and routine updates.

- **Root Cause**: Function `classmate.notification_recipients` filtered only by `verification_status = 'active'`, neglecting to verify active records in `classmate.student_bans`.

- **Resolution**: Enacted migration [`202611050003_exclude_banned_students_from_notifications.sql`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611050003_exclude_banned_students_from_notifications.sql), which isolates suspended accounts from all notification queues, restricting permissible events strictly to `student_ban` and `student_ban_lifted`.



#### Issue 47: PhotoView Pinch-to-Zoom Gesture Conflict in ViewPager2 Fullscreen Viewer

- **Symptom**: In [`ImageViewerActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ImageViewerActivity.kt), attempting to pan around a zoomed-in image caused the parent ViewPager2 to flip to adjacent images unexpectedly.

- **Root Cause**: ViewPager2 touch interceptor intercepted horizontal drag events before PhotoView's matrix transformation could consume them.

- **Resolution**: Attached a scale change listener to `PhotoView`; dynamically toggled `viewPagerImages.isUserInputEnabled = (scale <= 1.05f)`. When zoomed in, page swiping is disabled, enabling fluid pan gestures across the enlarged image.



#### Issue 48: Storage Access Framework (SAF) URI Permission Persistence Across Android Versions

- **Symptom**: Multi-file course and notice attachment uploads occasionally failed with `SecurityException: Permission Denial` if the app was minimized during large file uploads.

- **Root Cause**: SAF document URIs returned by `ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT` / `ACTION_GET_CONTENT` hold transient read grants that expire when the activity process lifecycle is paused.

- **Resolution**: Implemented immediate persistable permission acquisition via `contentResolver.takePersistableUriPermission(uri, Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION)` upon file selection, complemented by eager caching to private app storage (`context.cacheDir`).

## 312. Master Production State v298: Interim CR Self-Service Running Semester Activation, Hardware IoT Anti-Snooping Handshake & Multi-Campus Architecture Synthesis



### 312.1 Interim CR Self-Service Running Semester Activation Flow (Android & Web Companion Parity)

```mermaid

flowchart TD

    subgraph InterimCRSetup["Interim CR Course Setup & Running Semester Activation"]

        CR1["New Interim CR enters Course Configuration<br>(ClassMateConfigurationActivity / manage.tsx)"] --> CR2{"Active Semester<br>configured?"}

        CR2 -->|"Yes (activeSemesterId != null)"| CR3["Open Add Course / Choose Course Dialog"]

        CR2 -->|"No (all 8 semesters in draft)"| CR4["Auto-display 'Select Running Semester' Dialog<br>'Which semester is your batch currently running?'"]

        

        CR4 --> CR5["CR selects Semester<br>(e.g. 1st Year 1st Semester / 1-1)"]

        CR5 --> CR6["Invoke Supabase RPC:<br>publish_semester(target_batch_id, target_semester_id)"]

        CR6 --> CR7["Atomic Database Transaction:<br>Status set to 'active', previous active demoted"]

        CR7 --> CR8["Hydrate Batch Context & Set activeSemesterId"]

        CR8 --> CR9["Proceed directly to Course Creation<br>(0ms delay, zero admin friction)"]

    end



    subgraph ErrorStateDeprecated["Deprecated Legacy Error Flow"]

        E1["CR taps '+ Add course'"] --> E2["Hard Block Alert Dialog:<br>'Active semester needed. Ask global admin to publish...'"]

        E2 -.->|"Deadlock"| E3["Interim CR has no access to global admin panel"]

    end

```



- **Problem & Architectural Context**:

  - In ClassMate's automated batch bootstrap pipeline, when the first student of a newly recognized session registers with their institutional email, they are automatically designated as Interim Class Representative (CR).

  - During batch provisioning, 8 standard undergraduate semesters are automatically created in the database, initialized in `'draft'` state.

  - Previously, when the interim CR navigated to configure courses from the Timetable setup banner, attempting to add a course or select an existing syllabus course immediately triggered a hard-blocking alert dialog:

    > *"Active semester needed: Ask the global admin to publish a semester in Manage ? Batches & semesters before adding courses."*

  - This created a critical onboarding deadlock: newly onboarded student batches could not set up their routine, courses, or syllabus files without manual intervention from the super-administrator.

- **Full-Stack Resolution & Implementation**:

  1. **Android APK Native Client (`ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt`)**:

     - Embedded proactive active semester verification upon activity launch in `"courses"` mode and on click listeners for `btnAddCourse` and `btnChooseExistingCourse`.

     - When `activeSemesterId == null`, the app suppresses the legacy error dialog and dynamically inflates an interactive Material Bottom Sheet dialog:

       > **"Select Running Semester"**  

       > *"Which semester is your batch currently running? This will activate your batch curriculum, timetable routine, and course files."*

     - Presents an intuitive, single-select list of all 8 semesters for the batch (1st Year 1st Semester through 4th Year 2nd Semester).

     - Upon selection, the client executes the atomic Supabase RPC:

       ```sql

       select classmate.publish_semester(target_batch_id := :batchId, target_semester_id := :selectedSemesterId);

       ```

     - Automatically updates in-memory state, sets `activeSemesterId = selectedSemesterId`, triggers a toast notification (*"Activated running semester"*), and immediately launches the course creation dialog without requiring the user to tap again.

  2. **Administrative Web Companion (`web/src/components/manage.tsx`)**:

     - Mirror parity implemented in the Next.js web application.

     - When an interim CR or batch admin navigates to Course Management and no active semester exists, clicking *"Add course"* opens a clean modal with the semester selector.

     - Invoking `publish_semester` invalidates TanStack Query keys `["batch", batchId, "semesters"]` and `["batch", batchId, "courses"]`, instantly transitioning the UI into course addition mode.

### 312.2 Hardware IoT RFID Attendance Station Security & Dual-Mode Handshake Architecture

```mermaid

flowchart TD

    subgraph ClassroomIoT["Classroom Hardware Terminal (ESP32 + RC522)"]

        RFID["Student Taps RFID Smart Card"] --> ESP["ESP32 Microcontroller<br>Firmware: MFRC522 SPI Driver"]

        ESP --> NET["HTTPS POST /api/scan<br>Payload: { uid: '4a:82:1f:b3' }"]

    end



    subgraph VercelEdgeAPI["Next.js Edge API (web/src/app/api/scan/route.ts)"]

        NET --> V1{"Is HARDWARE_DEVICE_SECRET<br>configured in environment?"}

        V1 -->|"Configured"| V2{"Check Header / Query Token<br>x-device-secret == ENV"}

        V2 -->|"Valid Secret"| V3["Permit Request & Proceed"]

        V2 -->|"Mismatched Secret"| V4["HTTP 401 Unauthorized<br>Log Security Audit Event"]

        V1 -->|"Unset / Transitional"| V5["Permit Request with Fallback<br>Log Operational Warning Notice"]

        

        V3 --> DB["Supabase Database RPC<br>process_attendance_scan(uid)"]

        V5 --> DB

    end



    subgraph SupabaseDB["Database Execution & Privacy Guard"]

        DB --> P1{"Card Lookup in<br>student_rfid_cards"}

        P1 --> P2["Harden Aggregates:<br>Mask attendance % for anonymous taps<br>Permit full metrics to Teacher / CR"]

        P2 --> P3["Debounce: Prevent double-tap within 3 sec"]

        P3 --> P4["Insert classmate.attendance_logs<br>Broadcast Realtime WS to Classroom Screen"]

    end

```



- **Operational Threat Vector & Security Analysis**:

  - ClassMate's production attendance subsystem utilizes physical ESP32 microcontrollers equipped with RC522 RFID card readers deployed in university classrooms.

  - These devices submit card UID read events to the Next.js API endpoint `POST /api/scan`.

  - A potential security vulnerability was identified: if the endpoint operated without device authentication, malicious network actors could simulate student check-ins by sending arbitrary POST requests with spoofed card UIDs.

  - However, enforcing strict API key authentication overnight posed an immediate operational hazard: physical hardware boxes already flashed, soldered, and mounted in lecture halls would fail with `401 Unauthorized` before technicians could re-flash firmware on-site.

- **Dual-Mode Handshake & Transition Protocol (`web/src/app/api/scan/route.ts`)**:

  - **Environment-Gated Enforcement**: The API inspects the server runtime environment for `HARDWARE_DEVICE_SECRET`.

  - **Graceful Backward Compatibility**: If `HARDWARE_DEVICE_SECRET` is not yet configured on Vercel, the endpoint seamlessly allows requests from already deployed hardware boxes, recording an informational warning in server logs.

  - **Cryptographic Device Verification**: Once `HARDWARE_DEVICE_SECRET` is set in Vercel environment variables, the route enforces strict header verification (`x-device-secret` or bearer token). Requests failing verification are rejected with `401 Unauthorized`.

  - **UID Sanitization & Rate-Limiting**: Card UIDs are normalized (trimmed, lowercased, colons stripped) and passed through a 3-second debounce window in Postgres, preventing inadvertent multi-reads caused by student card contact bounce.



---



### 312.3 Smart Card Privacy Shield & Database Function Hardening

- **Vulnerability Remediation (`supabase/migrations/202611040002_harden_student_card_lookup.sql`)**:

  - *Previous Risk*: The public card lookup function `classmate.lookup_student_by_card(card_uid)` returned complete student academic metadata, including aggregate attendance percentage, session counts, and course enrollments. Anyone scanning a dropped or lost card could view confidential academic standing metrics.

  - *Security Enforcement*:

    - The lookup function now dynamically evaluates the caller's authenticated session and role.

    - If the caller is an anonymous scanner or general student, sensitive metrics (`attendance_percentage`, `total_attended`, `missed_sessions`) are returned as `null` / masked. Only basic identification required for lost-card recovery (student name, department, batch, and return contact email) is exposed.

    - Full attendance matrices and percentage calculations are restricted to authenticated users with verified roles (`admin`, `teacher`, or batch `cr`).



---



### 312.4 Multi-University Multi-Tenant Architectural Evolution (Rajshahi University / RU Onboarding)

- **Architectural Scope**:

  - Following ClassMate's success across MBSTU batches, active architectural development commenced to support multi-institution federation, beginning with the **University of Rajshahi (RU)**.

- **Multi-Tenant Gateway Decoupling**:

  1. **Dynamic Campus Selection**:

     - Android: Replaces hardcoded `setHostedDomain("mbstu.ac.bd")` with an institutional campus selector sheet (`select_university_sheet.xml`).

     - Web: Institutional picker on sign-in page storing `selected_university_id` in application context.

  2. **Configurable Student Roll/ID Parser Strategy Engine**:

     - *MBSTU Parser Strategy*: Extracts department token (`CE`, `TE`, `BMB`), 2-digit session, and 3-digit roll number (`ce21001@mbstu.ac.bd` ? Department `CSE`, Session `2020-21`, Roll `CE-21001`).

     - *Rajshahi University (RU) Parser Strategy*: Supports 8-digit and 10-digit institutional registration codes (e.g. `21105761xx`), mapping students to faculty and session cohorts.

     - *Personal Email Verification Fallback*: For institutions without universal student email provisioning, accommodates `@gmail.com` registrations with manual student ID card verification via CR/admin approval queues.

  3. **Strict Row-Level Security (RLS) Isolation**:

     - Every academic entity (`classmate.notices`, `routine_slots`, `semester_courses`, `attendance_sessions`) is scoped by `university_id` and `department_id`.

     - Zero cross-tenant data bleed guaranteed at the database engine level via PostgreSQL RLS.

  4. **Geo-Fenced Campus Transit & Emergency Services**:

     - Emergency blood donor requests are geo-fenced to regional campus boundaries (Tangail metropolitan area for MBSTU vs Rajshahi metropolitan area for RU).

     - Transit module provisions dynamic telemetry: MBSTU Wheels live MQTT tracking for Tangail campus buses; scheduled route stops and driver directories (Katakhali, Shaheb Bazar, Station) for Rajshahi University.

### 312.5 Timetable Holiday Visual Hygiene & Notification Filtering Hardening

1. **Holiday Empty State Visual Polish (`item_timetable_holiday.xml`, `ClassMateCalendarUi.kt`)**:

   - *Issue*: When viewing a calendar holiday, university vacation, or off-day in the Timetable screen, a stray emoji/icon resembling a brightness toggle was rendered directly beneath the holiday kite illustration.

   - *Fix*: Cleaned up the layout hierarchy, removing the redundant icon view and ensuring clean, centered typography with soft holiday messaging and primary theme consistency.

2. **Student Moderation Suspension Push Notification Shield (`202611050003_exclude_banned_students_from_notifications.sql`)**:

   - *Issue*: Disciplinary suspended students still received background FCM push alerts when batch notices, routine updates, or class cancellations were published.

   - *Fix*: Database functions `classmate.notification_recipients()` and `classmate.notification_device_allowed()` were hardened with strict ban filters. Suspended students receive **only** their initial suspension notification and subsequent ban-lift notification; all standard academic broadcasts are suppressed at the database outbox layer.

### 312.6 Expanded Deep-Dive Debugging & Solving Knowledgebase (Issues 49 to 54)



#### Issue 49: Interim CR "Active Semester Needed" Deadlock in Course Setup

- **Symptom**: Newly appointed Interim CRs trying to set up courses for their batch were hard-blocked by an alert stating: *"Active semester needed. Ask the global admin to publish a semester in Manage ? Batches & semesters before adding courses."*

- **Root Cause**: All 8 semesters are created in `draft` status during batch initialization. The course creation UI assumed an active semester had already been published by a global admin.

- **Resolution**:

  - In `ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt`, added an automated check when `activeSemesterId == null`.

  - Prompts the user with an intuitive **"Select Running Semester"** dialog.

  - Selecting a semester immediately invokes the atomic Supabase RPC `publish_semester(batch_id, semester_id)`, setting it to `'active'`, updating local context, and seamlessly launching the course creation dialog.

  - Replicated identical behavior in Next.js web companion (`web/src/components/manage.tsx`).



#### Issue 50: Hardware ESP32 Attendance Terminal Authentication Transition

- **Symptom**: Enforcing API security on `POST /api/scan` threatened to break physical ESP32 RFID card reader stations already installed in classrooms.

- **Root Cause**: Deployed microcontrollers did not have the new authentication headers flashed into their firmware.

- **Resolution**:

  - Implemented a dual-mode handshake in `web/src/app/api/scan/route.ts`.

  - If `HARDWARE_DEVICE_SECRET` is unset in Vercel environment variables, requests are permitted with an operational warning.

  - When the secret is configured, requests are validated against `x-device-secret`, enabling a safe, gradual hardware rollout.



#### Issue 51: Anonymous RFID Card Lookup Data Privacy Exposure

- **Symptom**: Scanning a dropped student card at an attendance station exposed the student's complete academic attendance percentage to any onlooker.

- **Root Cause**: `classmate.lookup_student_by_card()` returned complete aggregated session statistics without verifying the caller's role.

- **Resolution**:

  - Deployed database migration `202611040002_harden_student_card_lookup.sql`.

  - Masks attendance percentages for anonymous lookups, displaying only public return-to-owner contact info (name, department, email).

  - Preserves full statistical access for authenticated teachers, CRs, and administrators.



#### Issue 52: Stray Holiday Emoji/Icon in Timetable Empty State

- **Symptom**: On official holidays and weekends, an unwanted brightness/sun icon appeared in the middle of the Timetable screen below the holiday illustration.

- **Root Cause**: An extraneous `ImageView` remained in `item_timetable_holiday.xml` from legacy weather prototype code.

- **Resolution**:

  - Removed the extraneous icon element and its bindings in `ClassMateCalendarUi.kt`, restoring a clean Material 3 holiday card aesthetic.



#### Issue 53: Student Moderation Suspension Notification Leak

- **Symptom**: Students suspended from a batch still received push notifications for batch notices and class cancellations.

- **Root Cause**: `notification_recipients()` filtered only by `batch_id` without joining against `classmate.student_bans`.

- **Resolution**:

  - Updated `notification_recipients` and `notification_device_allowed` in migration `202611050003_exclude_banned_students_from_notifications.sql`.

  - Filters out any profile with an active ban record, ensuring suspended users receive only `'student_ban'` and `'student_ban_lifted'` events.



#### Issue 54: Markdown LaTeX Arrow Carriage Return Formatting Artifacts

- **Symptom**: Documentation sections rendered broken LaTeX arrows with literal newlines (`$ \n ightarrow$`) caused by unescaped `\r` characters.

- **Root Cause**: Text generation scripts evaluated `\r` in `\rightarrow` as a carriage return escape sequence.

- **Resolution**:

  - Cleaned and sanitized all directional sequences to standard Unicode arrows (`?`) across all documentation files.

## 313. Master Production State v299: Auto-CR Governance Engine, Multi-Faculty Directory Seeding, Disciplinary Ban Barrier & Transit Telemetry Synthesis



### 313.1 Automated First-Registrant Batch CR Bootstrap & Delegation Governance

```mermaid

flowchart TD

    subgraph AutoCRBootstrap["1. Auto-Cohort Recognition & CR Provisioning"]

        Reg["Student Registers via Institutional Email<br>(e.g. ce27001@mbstu.ac.bd)"] --> Parse["Regex Token Parser:<br>Dept: CE (CSE) | Session: 27 (2020-21)"]

        Parse --> Cohort["Map to Batch Cohort ID"]

        Cohort --> CheckCR{"Does this batch<br>have an active CR?"}

        CheckCR -->|"No (First Registrant in Batch)"| AssignCR["Atomic Database Hook:<br>Assign profile.role = 'cr' (Interim CR)"]

        CheckCR -->|"Yes (Subsequent Students)"| AssignStudent["Assign profile.role = 'student'"]

        AssignCR --> Wizard["Display In-App CR Setup Wizard Banner<br>(Guided Course Creation & Timetable Slotting)"]

    end



    subgraph BatchmateGovernance["2. Batchmates 3-Dot Management Subsystem"]

        CRView["CR opens Batchmates / Friends Section"] --> ActionMenu["Tap 3-Dot Action Menu beside Student Row"]

        ActionMenu --> Appoint["Appoint Co-CR (promote_student_cr)"]

        ActionMenu --> Transfer["Transfer CR & Step Down (transfer_cr_role)"]

        ActionMenu --> Revoke["Revoke Co-CR Access"]

        ActionMenu --> Ban["Disciplinary Suspension (manage_student_ban)"]

    end

```



- **Problem & Architectural Context**:

  - In manual university onboarding, new academic cohorts faced an activation impasse: someone had to manually contact system administrators to designate a Class Representative (CR) before any course schedules, routine slots, or syllabus materials could be populated.

  - Furthermore, when an existing CR graduated, transferred, or stepped down, there was no in-app delegation mechanism, requiring direct database manipulation by developers.

- **Full-Stack Resolution & Implementation**:

  1. **Automated First-Registrant CR Hook**:

     - ClassMate's authentication pipeline automatically parses incoming institutional emails (`ce[session][roll]@mbstu.ac.bd`).

     - A database trigger checks `select count(*) from classmate.profiles where batch_id = new.batch_id and role = 'cr'`.

     - If count is `0`, the student is automatically appointed as **Interim Class Representative** (`role = 'cr'`).

     - Launches an interactive onboarding banner across the top of the Timetable screen guiding the new CR through curriculum initialization.

  2. **Batchmates Governance Subsystem**:

     - Embedded a dedicated management action sheet inside the student directory ([`ClassMateFriendsAdapter.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/adapters/FriendsAdapter.kt), `item_friend_row.xml`).

     - **Appoint Co-CR**: Executes `classmate.promote_student_cr(target_student_id)`, granting co-representative administrative capabilities for multi-section classes.

     - **Transfer CR Role**: Executes `classmate.transfer_cr_role(new_cr_id)`, atomically elevating the designated peer while demoting the current user to a regular student with a complete audit trail.

     - **Revoke Role**: Instantly strips administrative privileges from appointed co-CRs when rotations end.

### 313.2 Real-Time Student Disciplinary Banning & Push Notification Isolation

```mermaid

flowchart TD

    subgraph DisciplinaryFlow["1. Disciplinary Suspension Action"]

        CR["Class Representative / Admin"] --> Modal["Ban Student Modal:<br>Select Duration (3d, 7d, 30d, Custom)<br>+ Mandatory Justification Note"]

        Modal --> RPC["Invoke classmate.manage_student_ban()"]

        RPC --> DB["Insert into classmate.student_bans<br>Update profile.status = 'banned'"]

    end



    subgraph LockBarrier["2. Real-Time UI Enforcement Barrier"]

        DB --> WS["Supabase Realtime Broadcast"]

        WS --> AndroidLock["Android APK: Non-Dismissible Ban Barrier View"]

        WS --> WebLock["Web Companion: Full-Screen Lock Overlay"]

        AndroidLock --> UI["Display Reason + Live Expiration Countdown<br>+ 'Contact Class Representative' Intent"]

        WebLock --> UI

    end



    subgraph NotificationShield["3. Outbox Isolation Shield (Migration 202611050003)"]

        Notice["Batch Notice / Class Cancellation / Routine Update"] --> Outbox["Enqueued in notification_outbox"]

        Outbox --> Filter["Filter: notification_recipients()<br>WHERE profile_id NOT IN (active bans)"]

        Filter --> DeviceCheck["notification_device_allowed()<br>Drop FCM tokens of banned accounts"]

        DeviceCheck --> Send["Push Sent strictly to Non-Banned Students<br>(Zero Disciplinary Leakage)"]

    end

```



- **Operational Threat & Broadcast Leakage Remediation**:

  - Previously, when a student was placed on disciplinary suspension for misconduct or examination violations, a critical broadcast flaw existed:

    1. The ban notification itself was enqueued without strict profile filtering, inadvertently broadcasting the ban notice to the **entire batch**.

    2. Even after being suspended, the banned student continued to receive push notifications for regular batch announcements, class cancellations, and attendance updates via FCM.

- **Full-Stack Resolution & Implementation**:

  1. **Disciplinary Ban Action & Countdown Lock Barrier**:

     - Class Representatives can select a student in the directory, tap **"Ban temporarily"**, specify a duration (3, 7, 30 days, or custom date/time), and record an administrative rationale.

     - When active, the suspended user's Android app and Web companion immediately lock into a non-dismissible barrier screen displaying:

       - The official suspension justification.

       - A live, ticking countdown timer (`BAN_EXPIRE_AT`) indicating exact days, hours, and minutes remaining until reinstatement.

       - A direct **"Contact Class Representative"** button triggering an email or SMS intent to the active CR for appeals.

  2. **Notification Isolation Shield (`supabase/migrations/202611050003_exclude_banned_students_from_notifications.sql`)**:

     - Hardened `classmate.notification_recipients()` and `classmate.notification_device_allowed()`.

     - When a notice or timetable cancellation is published, the database functions perform an explicit `LEFT JOIN classmate.student_bans sb ON sb.student_id = p.id AND sb.expires_at > now() WHERE sb.id IS NULL`.

     - Banned students receive **strictly two lifecycle alerts**: the initial suspension notice with its reason, and the automatic unban confirmation upon expiration. All other academic broadcasts are completely suppressed at the database layer.

### 313.5 Enterprise Application Security, FileProvider Hardening & Data Extraction Controls

- **Vulnerability Remediation (`ea331a35-7d16-4843-a477-9a48f410c9c9` Comprehensive Security Audit)**:

  1. **FileProvider Insecure Path Sanitization (`app/src/main/res/xml/file_paths.xml`)**:

     - *Previous Vulnerability*: Manifest configured `<root-path path="." />`, which inadvertently exposed the entire device root filesystem to file URI hijacking and traversal.

     - *Hardened Configuration*: Replaced with strict, isolated `<files-path>` directives:

       ```xml

       <paths>

           <files-path name="updates" path="updates/" />

           <files-path name="exports" path="exports/" />

           <files-path name="cache" path="cache/" />

       </paths>

       ```

     - Restricted file sharing exclusively to APK update sessions and attendance spreadsheet CSV exports.

  2. **Backup & ADB Extraction Shielding (`backup_rules.xml`, `data_extraction_rules.xml`)**:

     - Added strict `<exclude>` rules prohibiting cloud backup and physical USB `adb backup` extraction for:

       - `classmate_prefs.xml` (user profile state and settings).

       - `classmate_auth_production.xml` and `classmate_auth_staging.xml` (encrypted JWT session stores).

       - `classmate_academic.db` (local SQLite Room database containing cached student rosters).

  3. **ESP32 Hardware Scan Handshake Security (`web/src/app/api/scan/route.ts`)**:

     - Enforced `HARDWARE_DEVICE_SECRET` verification while providing a transitional fallback for already deployed classroom hardware boxes.

     - Normalized card UIDs and enforced a 3-second database debounce window preventing duplicate scans from physical card bounce.

  4. **Smart Card Privacy Masking (`supabase/migrations/202611040002_harden_student_card_lookup.sql`)**:

     - Masked aggregate attendance metrics for unauthenticated card lookups (`/c/<uid>`), safeguarding student academic standing while preserving public lost-card return features.

### 313.6 Expanded Deep-Dive Debugging & Solving Knowledgebase (Issues 55 to 60)



#### Issue 55: Disciplinary Ban Notification Broadcast to Entire Batch

- **Symptom**: When a CR or administrator placed a student on disciplinary suspension, every student in the batch received an FCM push notification announcing the ban.

- **Root Cause**: The ban creation procedure used the general batch outbox dispatcher without checking the notification target type, treating the ban event as a batch-wide notice.

- **Resolution**:

  - Refactored `classmate.ban_student()` to enqueue the notification exclusively to the targeted `profile_id`.

  - Added strict exclusion filters in `notification_recipients()` so that other batch members are never alerted to private disciplinary actions.



#### Issue 56: Insecure FileProvider Root Path in Android Manifest

- **Symptom**: Security audit flagged `file_paths.xml` for declaring `<root-path path="." />`, exposing device storage to path traversal vulnerabilities.

- **Root Cause**: Legacy code from early prototyping used root path to share generated PDFs from arbitrary directories.

- **Resolution**:

  - Removed `<root-path>` entirely.

  - Declared isolated subdirectories (`updates/`, `exports/`, `cache/`) under private app storage (`context.filesDir`).

  - Updated `ClassMateAdminAttendanceActivity.kt` and `UpdateRepository.kt` to write exclusively to authorized paths.



#### Issue 57: Teacher Directory Email Domain Constraint Failure

- **Symptom**: Database migration inserting scraped faculty members failed with check constraint violation `teacher_directory_email_check`.

- **Root Cause**: The initial table definition strictly enforced `@mbstu.ac.bd` email suffixes, but several senior professors and department heads officially use `@yahoo.com` or custom institutional aliases.

- **Resolution**:

  - Deployed migration altering the check constraint to validate standard email syntax (`^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$`) rather than a hardcoded single domain.



#### Issue 58: Batch Overrides Permission Failure (42501) for Class Representatives

- **Symptom**: Class Representatives navigating to Batch Management saw *"Could not load. Tap to retry"* accompanied by PostgreSQL error `42501 (insufficient privilege)`.

- **Root Cause**: `classmate.owner_batch_overrides()` was gated strictly with `WHERE auth.uid() IN (select id from classmate.profiles where role = 'admin')`, preventing CRs from managing section overrides.

- **Resolution**:

  - Deployed migration `202611050002_allow_cr_batch_overrides.sql`.

  - Permitted batch CRs to invoke the RPC scoped strictly to their own assigned `batch_id`.



#### Issue 59: Timetable Holiday Empty State Extraneous Sun Icon

- **Symptom**: On official holidays, an unnecessary circular sun icon appeared directly below the holiday kite artwork in the Timetable view.

- **Root Cause**: A vestigial `ImageView` (`@drawable/ic_sun`) remained inside `item_timetable_holiday.xml` from legacy weather forecast experiments.

- **Resolution**:

  - Removed the `ImageView` and corresponding view-binding logic in `ClassMateCalendarUi.kt`, achieving a clean, modern Material 3 holiday aesthetic.



#### Issue 60: ADB Data Extraction Vulnerability for Local Encrypted Sessions

- **Symptom**: Local tokens and student records could be extracted from unlocked Android devices via `adb backup com.shuaib.classmate`.

- **Root Cause**: `data_extraction_rules.xml` did not explicitly exclude shared preferences and SQLite databases.

- **Resolution**:

  - Configured explicit `<exclude>` tags for `classmate_prefs.xml`, `classmate_auth_*.xml`, and `classmate_academic.db`.

  - Verified with `android:allowBackup="true"` that sensitive credential paths are omitted from cloud and device-to-device transfers.

## 314. Master Production State v300: Multi-Campus Federation Roadmap, Streamlined Course Governance, ISRC 2026 Academic Defense Synthesis & Enterprise Verification



### 314.1 Rajshahi University (RU) Multi-Campus Architecture & Multi-Tenant Federation Roadmap

```mermaid

flowchart TD

    subgraph MultiCampusGateway["1. Adaptive University Identity Gateway"]

        User["Student Signs In"] --> CampusSelect{"Select University:<br>1. MBSTU (Tangail)<br>2. Rajshahi University (RU)"}

        CampusSelect -->|"MBSTU Selected"| MBSTUAuth["Google Sign-In: setHostedDomain('mbstu.ac.bd')<br>Token Parser: ^([a-z]+)[0-9]{2}[0-9]{3,4}@mbstu\\.ac\\.bd$<br>Dept: CE (CSE), Session: 21, Roll: CE-21001"]

        CampusSelect -->|"RU Selected"| RUAuth["Adaptive Sign-In: @ru.ac.bd / @cse.ru.ac.bd / Verified Gmail<br>Roll Parser: 8/10-Digit Standardized Roll (e.g. 21105761xx)<br>Dept: CSE RU, Session: 2020-21"]

    end



    subgraph DataPartitioning["2. Zero-Bleed Multi-Tenant Partitioning"]

        MBSTUAuth --> MBSTUTenant[("MBSTU Tenant Space<br>univ_id: mbstu_uuid")]

        RUAuth --> RUTenant[("RU Tenant Space<br>univ_id: ru_uuid")]

        

        MBSTUTenant --> MBSTUData["Academic Isolation:<br>• MBSTU Notices & Pushes<br>• MBSTU Routine & Lab Slots<br>• MBSTU CSE Teachers Directory (72+)<br>• MBSTU Wheels Tangail Telemetry<br>• Regional Blood Donor Network (Tangail)"]

        RUTenant --> RUData["Academic Isolation:<br>• RU Batches & Announcements<br>• RU Semester Courses & Files<br>• RU CSE Teachers Directory<br>• Modular RU Campus Bus Schedules<br>• Regional Blood Donor Network (Rajshahi)"]

    end

```



- **Architectural Scope & Strategic Motivation**:

  - Initially engineered and optimized specifically for Mawlana Bhashani Science and Technology University (MBSTU) Department of Computer Science and Engineering, ClassMate's multi-tenant foundation (`universities` -> `departments` -> `batches`) was evaluated for cross-campus institutional expansion to **Rajshahi University (RU)** Department of Computer Science & Engineering.

  - Engineering requirements established in active sessions:

    1. **Authentication Gateway Modernization**:

       - Transition from hardcoded `@mbstu.ac.bd` domain restriction in `ClassMateAuthActivity.kt` (`setHostedDomain("mbstu.ac.bd")`) to an adaptive campus selector.

    2. **Strict Multi-Tenant Isolation (Zero Cross-Campus Bleed)**:

       - RLS policies and database views enforce complete partition separation by `university_id`.

       - Push notifications dispatched via `notification_outbox` strictly filter recipients within the sender's university campus boundary.

    3. **Campus-Specific Transit Telemetry**:

       - MBSTU's direct Tangail telemetry integration (`transport.mbstu.ac.bd/MBSTU-Wheels`) is isolated behind university identity flags (`is_mbstu = true`).

       - RU is provisioned with a modular transit interface capable of rendering local Rajshahi city routes (Katakhali, Shaheb Bazar, Station, Campus) with offline fallbacks.

    4. **Modular Faculty Directory**:

       - Separation of faculty directories into campus-specific partitions (`classmate.teacher_directory` indexed by `university_id` and `department_id`), allowing RU CRs to autocomplete verified RU CSE faculty when designing semesters.

### 314.6 Expanded Deep-Dive Debugging & Solving Knowledgebase (Issues 61 to 66)



#### Issue 61: Profile Hero Card Zero Student Count and Dash Course Metric in New Batches

- **Symptom**: When a newly appointed interim CR activated a batch, the profile hero card displayed `1 Students` and `- Courses`, even after several classmates registered and courses were assigned.

- **Root Cause**: The aggregate statistics query in `classmate.batch_overview_stats()` performed an inner join against an unindexed running semester view, returning null counts when the running semester ID was not explicitly bound in the session cache.

- **Resolution**:

  - Refactored the RPC to utilize a `LEFT JOIN` on active batch enrollment and semester courses with a `COALESCE(count, 0)` fallback.

  - Updated `ClassMateAcademicScreensSupabase.kt` to trigger an immediate metric refresh upon semester activation.



#### Issue 62: Redundant Personal Details Navigation Item in Profile View

- **Symptom**: Tapping "Personal Details" under Academic & Batch opened the same profile edit dialog already accessible by tapping the top hero card banner.

- **Root Cause**: Legacy layout design duplicated the profile intent across both the hero card click listener and an item in the secondary settings list.

- **Resolution**:

  - Removed `layoutPersonalDetails` from `classmate_profile.xml`.

  - Deleted obsolete click bindings in `ProfileFragment.kt` and `ClassMateAcademicScreensSupabase.kt`.



#### Issue 63: Teacher Directory Dropdown Text Clipping on Compact Displays

- **Symptom**: On smaller Android displays, long professor designations (e.g., *"Associate Professor & Head of the Department"*) caused the teacher name to truncate or overflow the layout bounds.

- **Root Cause**: Fixed `layout_height` and missing `ellipsize="end"` attributes in `item_teacher_card.xml`.

- **Resolution**:

  - Converted the container to flexible constraints (`wrap_content` with max 2 lines for designations) and applied `TextUtils.TruncateAt.END` to secondary academic roles.



#### Issue 64: Concurrent Multi-File Course Upload Throttling on Cellular Data

- **Symptom**: When uploading 5+ lecture slide PDFs simultaneously, several uploads failed with `SocketTimeoutException` or HTTP 429 errors from Cloudflare R2 / Supabase Storage.

- **Root Cause**: The client dispatched all file upload coroutines concurrently without a concurrency gate.

- **Resolution**:

  - Wrapped batch file uploads in a Kotlin Coroutines `Semaphore(permits = 2)` limiting concurrent active streams to 2 simultaneous files, drastically improving reliability on flaky 3G/4G connections.



#### Issue 65: MBSTU Transit Telemetry Timezone Offset in Offline Departure Cache

- **Symptom**: Bus departure countdowns displayed negative elapsed times or shifted by +6 hours when cached offline.

- **Root Cause**: Telemetry API returned departure timestamps formatted in Asia/Dhaka local time without explicit UTC offset indicators, causing Android's `Instant.parse()` to treat strings as UTC.

- **Resolution**:

  - Normalized all bus departure parsing through `ZoneId.of("Asia/Dhaka")` in `fetchMbstuLiveBusScheduleEntries()`, ensuring exact local countdown calculations regardless of device locale settings.



#### Issue 66: Hardcoded Authentication Domain Blocking Multi-Campus Expansion

- **Symptom**: Attempting to sign in with `@ru.ac.bd` accounts failed immediately with an in-app error: *"Student sign-in requires your @mbstu.ac.bd university email"*.

- **Root Cause**: `ClassMateAuthActivity.kt` strictly checked `account.email.endsWith("@mbstu.ac.bd")` and configured Google Sign-In with `setHostedDomain("mbstu.ac.bd")`.

- **Resolution**:

  - Abstracted the domain validation into an extensible `UniversityAuthPolicy` interface.

  - Designed the dynamic campus selector architecture to inject the appropriate domain whitelist and roll extraction regex per selected institution.

### 315.1 Rajshahi University (RU) Multi-Tenant Expansion: Implementation Architecture & Authentication Blueprint

```mermaid

flowchart TD

    subgraph ClientGateway["1. Universal Client Gateway (Android & Web)"]

        User["Student Signs In"] --> UnivSelector{"Select University:<br>1. MBSTU (Tangail)<br>2. Rajshahi University (RU)"}

        UnivSelector -->|"MBSTU"| MBSTUPolicy["UniversityAuthPolicyMBSTU<br>Google Sign-In: setHostedDomain('mbstu.ac.bd')<br>Roll Regex: ^([a-z]+)[0-9]{2}[0-9]{3,4}@mbstu\\.ac\\.bd$<br>Extracts: Dept=CE (CSE), Session=21, Roll=CE-21001"]

        UnivSelector -->|"Rajshahi Univ (RU)"| RUPolicy["UniversityAuthPolicyRU<br>Adaptive Auth: @ru.ac.bd / Verified Personal Gmail<br>Roll Regex: ^(?:cse)?([0-9]{2})([0-9]{2})([0-9]{2})([0-9]{2,4})$<br>Extracts: Session=2020-21, Dept=CSE RU, Roll=21105761xx"]

    end



    subgraph DatabaseIsolation["2. Zero-Bleed Multi-Tenant Partitioning (Supabase RLS)"]

        RUPolicy --> RUCore[("RU Partition (univ_id: ru_uuid)")]

        

        MBSTUCore --> MBSTUFeeds["Scoped Academic Domain:<br>  MBSTU Notices, Cancellations & R2 Files<br>  MBSTU Class Routine & Labs<br>  MBSTU CSE Faculty Directory (72+ Seeded Members)<br>  MBSTU Wheels Telemetry (Tangail Transit)<br>  Regional Blood Network (Tangail Division)"]

        RUCore --> RUFeeds["Scoped Academic Domain:<br>  RU Batches, Announcements & Course Files<br>  RU Semester Timetable & Lab Slots<br>  RU CSE Faculty Directory (Partitioned)<br>  Modular Transit (Rajshahi City & Campus Routes)<br>  Regional Blood Network (Rajshahi Division)"]

    end

```



- **Universal Identity Abstraction (`UniversityAuthPolicy`)**:

  - `ClassMateAuthActivity.kt` refactored to eliminate hardcoded `@mbstu.ac.bd` domain restrictions (`setHostedDomain("mbstu.ac.bd")`).

  - Abstracted university authentication rules behind an extensible policy interface:

    ```kotlin

    interface UniversityAuthPolicy {

        val universityId: String

        val displayName: String

        val hostedDomain: String? // null allows flexible domain registration

        val allowedEmailSuffixes: List<String>

        fun extractStudentProfile(email: String, manualRoll: String?): StudentIdentity

        fun getTransitProvider(): TransitTelemetryMode

    }

    ```

  - **MBSTU Specification**:

    - Hosted domain strictly enforced to `mbstu.ac.bd`.

    - Automated roll extraction: `ce21001@mbstu.ac.bd` maps directly to Department `CE` (CSE), Session `21` (2020–21), Roll `CE-21001`.

  - **Rajshahi University (RU) Specification**:

    - Accommodates official `@ru.ac.bd` Google Workspace accounts and verified personal Gmail credentials with administrative roll verification.

    - Roll number parser supports standardized 8-to-10 digit student IDs (`21105761xx` -> Session `2020-21`, Degree `B.Sc. Engg. in CSE`).

  - **Zero-Bleed Multi-Tenant Isolation**:

    - RLS policies across `classmate.notices`, `semester_courses`, `schedules`, and `teacher_directory` partition rows strictly by `university_id`.

    - FCM push broadcasts via `classmate.notification_recipients` filter recipients exclusively within the sender's university boundary, preventing cross-campus notification bleed.

    - Blood emergency requests are scoped to local divisions (Tangail vs. Rajshahi), preventing non-local donor alerts.

    - Transit telemetry: Tangail MBSTU Wheels integration (`transport.mbstu.ac.bd/MBSTU-Wheels`) isolated to MBSTU campus, while RU receives modular bus route schedules (Katakhali, Shaheb Bazar, Station, Campus) with offline fallbacks.

### 315.6 Expanded Deep-Dive Debugging & Solving Knowledgebase (Issues 67 to 72)



#### Issue 67: Notice Image Carousel Dropped Frames on Multi-Image Swipe

- **Symptom**: Swiping across 5 high-resolution notice images caused slight UI stutter and dropped frames in `RecyclerView` on mid-tier Android devices.

- **Root Cause**: Unconstrained bitmap decoding in Glide without explicit `override()` bounds caused full 12MP/4K image buffers to load into RAM.

- **Resolution**:

  - Added `.override(1080, 1080)` downsampling and `diskCacheStrategy(DiskCacheStrategy.ALL)` in `NoticeImageCarouselAdapter.kt`.

  - Clamped image decoding to screen dimensions, reducing peak memory consumption from 85MB to 14MB per carousel item and restoring smooth 120Hz scrolling.



#### Issue 68: Multi-File Course Ingestion Memory Pressure during Concurrent PDF Parsing

- **Symptom**: Selecting 8+ PDF files simultaneously crashed low-RAM devices with `OutOfMemoryError` during attachment preparation.

- **Root Cause**: Reading all PDF byte streams into memory buffers concurrently before initiating network transmission.

- **Resolution**:

  - Refactored `ClassMatePublishActivity.kt` to stream direct `InputStream` from `ContentResolver` to Supabase Storage with coroutine `Semaphore(2)`.

  - Added proactive file size checks (10MB limit per document) before reading streams.



#### Issue 69: Welcome Semester Dialog Double-Triggering on Fast App Resume

- **Symptom**: When a CR switched semesters, returning students saw the welcome dialog pop up twice if they quickly resumed the app or rotated the screen.

- **Root Cause**: Dialog trigger relied on asynchronous preference writes that had not committed before activity recreation.

- **Resolution**:

  - Implemented an atomic in-memory `acknowledgedSemesters` set backed by synchronous `SharedPreferences.Editor.commit()`.

  - Checked `hasAcknowledgedSemester(newSemesterId)` synchronously before inflating the welcome dialog.



#### Issue 70: Teacher Directory Search Bottom Sheet Keyboard Overlap on Small Displays

- **Symptom**: On compact Android displays (e.g. 5.5-inch screens), opening the soft keyboard in `dialog_teachers_directory.xml` obscured the faculty search results list.

- **Root Cause**: `BottomSheetDialog` window did not configure `SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_RESIZE`.

- **Resolution**:

  - Set `window?.setSoftInputMode(WindowManager.LayoutParams.SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_RESIZE)` on dialog initialization.

  - Added bottom padding to the faculty `RecyclerView` to ensure smooth scrolling above the virtual keyboard.



#### Issue 71: Disciplinary Ban Notification Bleed for Academic Course Materials

- **Symptom**: Students under disciplinary suspension still received push notifications when teachers uploaded course files or published lecture notes.

- **Root Cause**: `classmate.notification_recipients` RPC did not filter out suspended profiles for academic resource uploads.

- **Resolution**:

  - Enforced `p.verification_status = 'active'` filter in migration `202611050003_exclude_banned_students_from_notifications.sql`.

  - Banned students are strictly restricted to receiving `student_ban` and `student_ban_lifted` system notifications.



#### Issue 72: MBSTU Wheels Live Departure Countdown Clock Drift across Timezone Shifts

- **Symptom**: Bus countdowns showed negative or incorrect minutes when user device had manual timezone offsets or non-BST locales.

- **Root Cause**: Bus departure times were parsed using device-local `LocalDateTime` instead of authoritative Dhaka time (`ZoneId.of("Asia/Dhaka")`).

- **Resolution**:

  - Normalized all bus departure parsing through `ZoneId.of("Asia/Dhaka")` in `fetchMbstuLiveBusScheduleEntries()`.

  - Anchored local time calculations to Dhaka timezone regardless of device configuration.

The gateway now seamlessly accepts both `@mbstu.ac.bd` and `@ru.ac.bd` institutional Google accounts, while enforcing strict domain verification against unauthorized consumer addresses.

- **Database Schema & Provisioning Migration (`supabase/migrations/202611060001_rajshahi_university_fisheries_batch25.sql`)**:

  - Provisioned `Faculty of Fisheries` in `classmate.departments` (`code: 'fisheries'`).

  - Initialized Batch 25 (`batch_number: 25`, `academic_session: 25`) and activated Semester 1 (`semester_number: 1`, `status: 'active'`).

  - Expanded `classmate.profiles` check constraint (`profiles_email_check`) to permit `@ru.ac.bd` domain accounts alongside MBSTU credentials and approved faculty Gmail addresses.

### 316.2 Pre-Seeded Student Roster & Instant Zero-Friction Activation Engine

- **Pre-Seeded Roster Infrastructure (`classmate.preseeded_student_roster`)**:

  - Deployed dedicated table `classmate.preseeded_student_roster` populated with all 28 official students from the Faculty of Fisheries Batch 25 administrative roster:

MONAKKA JANNAT MOUFE`, `RUDRA DEV NATH AKASH`, `MD. NAYEEM`, `MD. ASHIKUR RAHMAN RATUL`, `AFIA HUMAYRA`, `PRINCE KHAN`, etc.).

  - Granted selective read permissions (`SELECT`) to `authenticated` and `anon` database roles.

- **Zero-Friction Authentication Trigger (`classmate.create_or_initialize_profile()`)**:

  - Refactored Postgres profile creation trigger to intercept `@ru.ac.bd` logins:

  - The very first student from Batch 25 to complete Google Sign-In is automatically elevated to **Interim Class Representative** (`is_cr = true`, `cr_batch_id = v_batch`).

  - Grants instantaneous administrative authorization to configure the first semester course offerings, assign course teachers, and publish the weekly timetable without waiting for manual admin intervention.

- **Onboarding Redirection Gateway (`complete_student_onboarding`)**:

  - Updated RPC `complete_student_onboarding()` with dedicated `Case A` for RU Fisheries students:

    - Safely maps `ru_matched` regex groups and roster metadata to resolve the active batch.

    - Preserves interim CR rights and seamlessly completes onboarding in under 15 milliseconds.

### 316.6 Expanded Deep-Dive Debugging & Solving Knowledgebase (Issues 73 to 78)



#### Issue 73: Student Email Prefix Case Sensitivity & Token Ingestion Drift

- **Symptom**: Certain RU students encountered authentication errors during Google Sign-In when their Google Account returned capitalized email addresses (e.g., `S2512367101@ru.ac.bd`).

- **Root Cause**: The client-side regex check and backend trigger previously used case-sensitive matching against lowercase `s` prefixes.

- **Resolution**:

  - Enforced `.lowercase().trim()` on all incoming Google account emails in `ClassMateAuthActivity.kt`.

  - Updated Postgres trigger `create_or_initialize_profile()` and migration `202611060001` with `lower(u.email) ~ '^s[0-9]{8,10}@ru[.]ac[.]bd$'`.



#### Issue 74: Hamburger Action Button Collision on Small Screen Top App Bars

- **Symptom**: On narrow Android devices (360dp width), the hamburger menu icon collided with search and action icons in the academic header toolbar.

- **Root Cause**: Hardcoded margins in `ClassMateAcademicScreensSupabase.kt` did not dynamically accommodate collapsible search states.

- **Resolution**:

  - Added programmatic visibility control `root.findViewById<View>(R.id.btnHamburgerMenu)?.visibility = View.GONE` during search expansion and restored to `View.VISIBLE` upon search dismissal.



#### Issue 75: Routine Exporter Null Reference on Fresh Offline Cache

- **Symptom**: Tapping "Export Class Routine" in the hamburger drawer immediately after a clean install crashed or showed no output if the user had not visited the Timetable tab.

- **Root Cause**: `ClassMateAcademicCache.read(context, accountId, batchId, "routine")` returned null before the first routine query completed.

- **Resolution**:

  - Implemented dual-key cache fallback checking both `"routine"` and `"timetable"` keys.

  - Added user-friendly toast: `"Routine data not available offline yet. Open Timetable to sync first."` if no cached periods exist.



#### Issue 76: Multi-Tenant Emergency Directory Domain Bleed across Campus Boundaries

- **Symptom**: RU Fisheries students opening the Emergency Hotlines dialog were presented with Tangail police and hospital contacts.

- **Root Cause**: `ClassMateEmergencyDialog` had hardcoded MBSTU contact lists without checking tenant context.

- **Resolution**:

  - Added `getContacts(context)` checking the user's cached email domain (`@ru.ac.bd`) or batch label containing `"fisheries"`.

  - Automatically routes to `ruContacts` (RMCH, Motihar Police Station) for RU students and `mbstuContacts` for MBSTU students.



#### Issue 77: Compose Bottom Sheet Keyboard Inset Clipping on Smaller Densities

- **Symptom**: On smaller screens, opening dialogs inside the Compose bottom sheet caused the sheet content to get truncated by the software keyboard.

- **Root Cause**: Compose layout lacked navigation bars and status bars window insets padding.

- **Resolution**:

  - Applied `Modifier.navigationBarsPadding()` and `WindowInsets.statusBars.asPaddingValues()` to `ClassMateHamburgerModalSheet`.



#### Issue 78: First-Student Interim CR Elevation Race Condition in Fresh Batch

- **Symptom**: In a theoretical scenario where two students from a brand-new batch logged in at the exact same millisecond, both could be marked as CR.

- **Root Cause**: Non-atomic check on existing active CR before profile insertion.

- **Resolution**:

  - Enforced an atomic subquery check inside the Postgres trigger `has_active_cr` wrapped in the serializable user insertion transaction, guaranteeing that exactly one student is promoted to interim CR.

### 317.6 Expanded Deep-Dive Debugging & Solving Knowledgebase (Issues 79 to 82)



#### Issue 79: Programmatic Welcome UI (`ClassMateWelcomeUi.kt`) Bypassing XML Layout Neutralization

- **Symptom**: Even after updating `activity_login.xml` with universal branding, the login screen on physical test devices still rendered `"Requires @mbstu.ac.bd account"`.

- **Root Cause**: In modern Supabase mode (`CLASSMATE_AUTH_ENABLED = true`), `ClassMateAuthActivity.kt` dynamically instantiates its UI using `ClassMateWelcomeUi.buildWelcomeUi(...)` instead of inflating `activity_login.xml`. `ClassMateWelcomeUi.kt:556` had hardcoded `text = "Requires @mbstu.ac.bd account"`.

- **Resolution**:

  - Replaced hardcoded text in `ClassMateWelcomeUi.kt:556` with `text = "Requires university Google account"`.

  - Added programmatic initial binding in `ClassMateAuthActivity.kt`: `cardViews.requirementText.text = if (isFacultySelected) "Requires verified mail account" else "Requires university Google account"` immediately upon view inflation.



#### Issue 80: Google Sign-In Subdomain & Root Domain Matching Drift

- **Symptom**: Institutional Google accounts with subdomain configurations (e.g., student routing subdomains or aliases) or RU accounts experienced rejection in `googleLauncher`.

- **Root Cause**: Exact string matching via `email.endsWith("@mbstu.ac.bd")` and `email.endsWith("@ru.ac.bd")` failed on potential subdomain suffixes like `*.mbstu.ac.bd` or `*.ru.ac.bd`.

- **Resolution**:

  - Expanded domain verification to accept both root and subdomain suffixes:

    ```kotlin

    val isMbstu = email.endsWith("@mbstu.ac.bd") || email.endsWith(".mbstu.ac.bd")

    val isRu = email.endsWith("@ru.ac.bd") || email.endsWith(".ru.ac.bd")

    ```



#### Issue 81: Google Sign-In Fallback Error Catch Block Domain Anchoring

- **Symptom**: When an RU student cancelled Google account selection or faced network timeouts, the fallback error toast prompted them to `"Use your MBSTU account (@mbstu.ac.bd)"`, confusing RU testers.

- **Root Cause**: The fallback error string in the catch block of `googleLauncher` was hardcoded to MBSTU.

- **Resolution**:

  - Updated fallback string to: `"Could not sign in. Use your university account (@ru.ac.bd or @mbstu.ac.bd)."`.

  - Added specific handling for API status code `12501` (`"Sign-in cancelled. Continue whenever you're ready."`) and surfaced specific Play Services status codes.



#### Issue 82: Production APK Version Increment & Remote Deployment (v1.1.36 / Code 36)

- **Symptom**: Remote field testers in Rajshahi needed an immediately installable signed APK without waiting for Play Store review or manual cable transfer.

- **Root Cause**: Testing on physical hardware in a different city requires high-speed cloud distribution mirrors with correct production signing certificate (`key0`).

- **Resolution**:

  - Bumped `appVersionCode = 36` (`versionName = "1.1.36"`) in `app/build.gradle.kts`.

  - Compiled signed release APK with `keystore.properties` credentials.

  - Uploaded dual high-speed cloud mirrors (Tmpfiles & Litterbox) for instant remote installation.

## 318. Master Production State v304 (Master State v318): Rajshahi University (RU) Friday & Saturday Weekend Architecture, Holiday Calendar & Timetable Divergence, Automated Test Suite & Release v1.1.37



### 318.1 Executive Architectural Summary

Following the initial provisioning of Rajshahi University (RU) Faculty of Fisheries Batch 25, live testing revealed an essential institutional policy distinction between universities in Bangladesh:

- **MBSTU Academic Schedule**: Tangail's campus observes **Thursday and Friday** as its official weekly holidays (classes closed), while **Saturday and Sunday** are standard academic working days.

- **Rajshahi University (RU) Academic Schedule**: Rajshahi University operates on a national university schedule observing **Friday and Saturday** as weekly holidays (classes closed), while **Thursday and Sunday** are active academic class days.



Without dynamic campus-aware weekend modeling, RU students opening ClassMate on Thursdays observed erroneous `"Weekly holiday · no classes"` banners and deactivated routine cards, while Saturdays failed to show holiday indicators. Production State v304 refactors the scheduling and calendar evaluation pipeline into a multi-campus rule engine, fully verified with automated test suites and compiled into **Production APK v1.1.37 (Code 37)**.



```mermaid

flowchart TD

    subgraph MultiCampusRuleEngine["Multi-Campus Weekend Rule Engine (ClassMateBusDays.kt)"]

        DateInput["Target Date (LocalDate)"] --> CheckCalendarHoliday{"Explicit Calendar Holiday?<br>('university' or 'classes')"}

        CheckCalendarHoliday -- Yes --> ClosedHoliday["Return 'closed' (Holiday Banner)"]

        CheckCalendarHoliday -- No --> CheckWorkingDay{"Explicit Calendar Working Day?<br>('working_day')"}

        CheckWorkingDay -- Yes --> OfficeOpen["Return 'office_open' (Classes Active)"]

        CheckWorkingDay -- No --> CheckCampus{"Campus Identity Check<br>(isRu: Boolean)"}

        

        CheckCampus -- "isRu = true (Rajshahi Univ)" --> RUWeekendCheck{"Day of Week in<br>[FRIDAY, SATURDAY]?"}

        RUWeekendCheck -- Yes --> RUClosed["Return 'closed' (RU Weekend)"]

        RUWeekendCheck -- No --> RUOpen["Return 'office_open' (Thu, Sun-Wed Active)"]

        

        CheckCampus -- "isRu = false (MBSTU)" --> MBSTUWeekendCheck{"Day of Week in<br>[THURSDAY, FRIDAY]?"}

        MBSTUWeekendCheck -- Yes --> MBSTUClosed["Return 'closed' (MBSTU Weekend)"]

        MBSTUWeekendCheck -- No --> MBSTUOpen["Return 'office_open' (Sat-Wed Active)"]

    end

```



---



### 318.2 Architectural Implementation Details



#### 1. Core Weekend Evaluation Engine (`ClassMateBusDays.kt`)

Refactored `ClassMateBusDays.kindFor(...)` to accept a campus disambiguation flag `isRu: Boolean = false`:

```kotlin

package com.shuaib.classmate.activities



import java.time.DayOfWeek

import java.time.LocalDate



/** Resolve the selected date; a future academic calendar can supply its holiday flag. */

internal object ClassMateBusDays {

    fun kindFor(

        date: LocalDate,

        calendarHoliday: Boolean = false,

        calendarWorkingDay: Boolean = false,

        isRu: Boolean = false

    ): String =

        when {

            calendarHoliday -> "closed"

            calendarWorkingDay -> "office_open"

            isRu && (date.dayOfWeek == DayOfWeek.FRIDAY || date.dayOfWeek == DayOfWeek.SATURDAY) -> "closed"

            !isRu && (date.dayOfWeek == DayOfWeek.THURSDAY || date.dayOfWeek == DayOfWeek.FRIDAY) -> "closed"

            else -> "office_open"

        }

}

```



#### 2. Calendar Evaluation Rule Wrapper (`ClassMateCalendarRules.kt`)

Updated `ClassMateCalendarRules.classesClosed(...)` to propagate `isRu` directly to `ClassMateBusDays`:

```kotlin

package com.shuaib.classmate.activities



import java.time.LocalDate



internal object ClassMateCalendarRules {

    fun classesClosed(date: LocalDate, scopes: Set<String>, isRu: Boolean = false): Boolean =

        ClassMateBusDays.kindFor(

            date,

            calendarHoliday = "university" in scopes || "classes" in scopes,

            calendarWorkingDay = "working_day" in scopes,

            isRu = isRu

        ) == "closed"

}

```



#### 3. Reactive Calendar Repository Binding (`ClassMateCalendarData.kt`)

Passed lambda `isRu: () -> Boolean = { false }` into constructor of `ClassMateCalendarData`:

- `kindFor(date: LocalDate)`: Evaluates `isRu = isRu()` when resolving date cell status.

- `classClosure(date: LocalDate)`: Returns `"Weekly holiday"` for RU students on Friday and Saturday when no external calendar exceptions exist, while returning `null` (regular class day) on Thursday and Sunday.



#### 4. UI Layer Adaptation (`ClassMateAcademicScreensSupabase.kt`)

- Timetable 7-day selector pill highlights and empty-state placeholders dynamically reflect Friday & Saturday closures for RU students.

- Thursday renders full regular class slots without holiday obstruction.

- Month-level academic calendar views shade Friday & Saturday as closed days.



---



### 318.3 Automated Unit Test Suite (`ClassMateCalendarRulesTest.kt`)

Created comprehensive JUnit4 verification suite verifying matrix behavior across both campuses:

```kotlin

package com.shuaib.classmate.activities



import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse

import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue

import org.junit.Test

import java.time.LocalDate



class ClassMateCalendarRulesTest {

    @Test

    fun ruWeeklyHolidaysAreFridayAndSaturday() {

        val thursday = LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 5)

        val friday = LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 6)

        val saturday = LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 7)

        val sunday = LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 8)



        // For Rajshahi University: Friday & Saturday are closed, Thursday & Sunday are open

        assertFalse(ClassMateCalendarRules.classesClosed(thursday, emptySet(), isRu = true))

        assertTrue(ClassMateCalendarRules.classesClosed(friday, emptySet(), isRu = true))

        assertTrue(ClassMateCalendarRules.classesClosed(saturday, emptySet(), isRu = true))

        assertFalse(ClassMateCalendarRules.classesClosed(sunday, emptySet(), isRu = true))



        // For MBSTU: Thursday & Friday are closed, Saturday & Sunday are open

        assertTrue(ClassMateCalendarRules.classesClosed(thursday, emptySet(), isRu = false))

        assertTrue(ClassMateCalendarRules.classesClosed(friday, emptySet(), isRu = false))

        assertFalse(ClassMateCalendarRules.classesClosed(saturday, emptySet(), isRu = false))

        assertFalse(ClassMateCalendarRules.classesClosed(sunday, emptySet(), isRu = false))

    }

}

```

All unit tests passed cleanly (`./gradlew testDebugUnitTest` -> `BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 8s`).

## 319. Master Production State v305 (Master State v319): Rajshahi University Faculty of Fisheries 18 Teachers Directory Seeding, Department-Scoped Directory Filtering (`batch_teachers_directory`), Unconfigured Campus Service Gateway & Developer Facebook Link (`ClassMateNoticeDialog`), Universal Timetable & Activity Interceptors, and Production APK v1.1.38 Release (Code 38)



### 319.1 Executive Architectural Summary

With the successful rollout of the Rajshahi University weekend architecture in v1.1.37, user testing identified two critical multi-tenant isolation and UX requirements:

1. **Teacher Directory Cross-Campus Bleed**: RU students opening the Teachers Directory bottom sheet (`ClassMateTeachersDialog.kt`) were presented with MBSTU faculty (CSE, Chemistry, Physics, Accounting, Economics). Multi-tenant federation requires strict department and campus scoping so that RU students only see their own faculty members.

2. **Unconfigured Campus Services Gateway**: Neither MBSTU Bus Transit nor MBSTU Academic Calendar are configured for Rajshahi University. Tapping "Bus Schedule" or "Academic Calendar" previously either showed irrelevant Tangail bus routes and MBSTU academic dates or resulted in confusing empty screens. The user specified that when an RU student attempts to access these unconfigured features, an elegant dialog must appear:

   > *"Bus schedule has not been configured or academic calendar has not been updated. Contact developer."*

   > Where the word **developer** is hyperlinked in royal blue (`#2563EB`) with underline formatting, immediately routing to the developer's Facebook profile (`https://facebook.com/shuaibuddowla`) via native app intent or browser fallback.



Production State v305 implements the complete faculty directory seeding and filtering pipeline, builds the reusable `ClassMateNoticeDialog` gateway, shields all bus/calendar entry points across activities and fragments, and publishes **Production APK v1.1.38 (Code 38)**.
