### 319.3 Backend Migration: Multi-Tenant Faculty Directory Scoping (`202611060003_ru_fisheries_teachers_and_directory.sql`)



Migration `202611060003_ru_fisheries_teachers_and_directory.sql` resolves department-level bleed by querying the department code of the calling user's batch and isolating the result set:

```sql

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION classmate.batch_teachers_directory(target_batch uuid)

 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, department_code text, department_name text, full_name text, email text, designation text, phone text, profile_url text, source_checked_at date, courses text[])

 LANGUAGE plpgsql

 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER

 SET search_path TO ''

AS $function$

declare

  v_dept_code text;

begin

  if not classmate.is_active() or not classmate.can_read_batch(target_batch) then

    raise exception 'Batch access denied' using errcode = '42501';

  end if;



  select d.code into v_dept_code

  from classmate.batches b

  join classmate.departments d on d.id = b.department_id

  where b.id = target_batch;



  return query

    select

      t.id,

      d.code as department_code,

      d.name as department_name,

      t.full_name,

      t.email,

      t.designation,

      t.phone,

      t.profile_url,

      t.source_checked_at,

      coalesce(

        array_remove(

          array_agg(distinct coalesce(sc.code_override, c.course_code) order by coalesce(sc.code_override, c.course_code)),

          null

        ),

        array[]::text[]

      ) as courses

    from classmate.teacher_directory t

    join classmate.departments d on d.id = t.department_id

    left join classmate.semester_courses sc on sc.teacher_record_id = t.id

    left join classmate.semesters s on s.id = sc.semester_id and s.batch_id = target_batch and s.status = 'active'

    left join classmate.courses c on c.id = sc.course_id

    where t.full_name !~* '^(CSE batch|Test|Dummy)'

      and (

        case

          when v_dept_code = 'fisheries' then d.code = 'fisheries'

          else d.code <> 'fisheries'

        end

      )

    group by

      t.id,

      d.code,

      d.name,

      t.full_name,

      t.email,

      t.designation,

      t.phone,

      t.profile_url,

      t.source_checked_at

    order by

      (d.code = coalesce(v_dept_code, 'cse')) desc,

      d.name,

      lower(t.full_name);

end;

$function$;

```

### 319.4 Unconfigured Service Notice Gateway (`ClassMateNoticeDialog.kt`)



Created [`ClassMateNoticeDialog.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/ui/ClassMateNoticeDialog.kt) to handle unconfigured campus features with rich interactive span linking:

```kotlin

package com.shuaib.classmate.ui



import android.content.Context

import android.content.Intent

import android.graphics.Color

import android.net.Uri

import android.text.SpannableString

import android.text.Spanned

import android.text.TextPaint

import android.text.method.LinkMovementMethod

import android.text.style.ClickableSpan

import android.text.style.ForegroundColorSpan

import android.text.style.UnderlineSpan

import android.view.View

import android.widget.TextView

import com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder



internal object ClassMateNoticeDialog {



    private const val DEV_FB_URL = "https://facebook.com/shuaibuddowla"



    fun showUnconfiguredDialog(

        context: Context,

        title: String = "Notice",

        onDismiss: (() -> Unit)? = null

    ) {

        val fullText = "Bus schedule has not been configured or academic calendar has not been updated. Contact developer."

        val targetWord = "developer"

        val startIndex = fullText.indexOf(targetWord)



        val spannable = SpannableString(fullText)

        if (startIndex != -1) {

            val endIndex = startIndex + targetWord.length

            val clickableSpan = object : ClickableSpan() {

                override fun onClick(widget: View) {

                    openDeveloperFacebook(context)

                }



                override fun updateDrawState(ds: TextPaint) {

                    super.updateDrawState(ds)

                    ds.color = Color.parseColor("#2563EB")

                    ds.isUnderlineText = true

                }

            }

            spannable.setSpan(clickableSpan, startIndex, endIndex, Spanned.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE)

            spannable.setSpan(ForegroundColorSpan(Color.parseColor("#2563EB")), startIndex, endIndex, Spanned.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE)

            spannable.setSpan(UnderlineSpan(), startIndex, endIndex, Spanned.SPAN_EXCLUSIVE_EXCLUSIVE)

        }



        val dialog = MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(context)

            .setTitle(title)

            .setMessage(spannable)

            .setPositiveButton("OK") { d, _ ->

                d.dismiss()

                onDismiss?.invoke()

            }

            .setOnDismissListener {

                onDismiss?.invoke()

            }

            .show()



        // Enable clickable links in the message body

        dialog.findViewById<TextView>(android.R.id.message)?.movementMethod = LinkMovementMethod.getInstance()

    }



    private fun openDeveloperFacebook(context: Context) {

        try {

            val fbIntent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, Uri.parse("fb://facewebmodal/f?href=$DEV_FB_URL")).apply {

                flags = Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK

            }

            context.startActivity(fbIntent)

        } catch (_: Exception) {

            val webIntent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, Uri.parse(DEV_FB_URL)).apply {

                flags = Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK

            }

            context.startActivity(webIntent)

        }

    }

}

```

### 319.8 Expanded Deep-Dive Debugging & Solving Knowledgebase (Issues 83 to 86)



#### Issue 83: Weekly Holiday Scheduling Discrepancy Between Universities (RU Friday/Saturday vs MBSTU Thursday/Friday)

- **Symptom**: On Thursdays, Rajshahi University students experienced disabled class schedules displaying `"Weekly holiday · no classes"`, while Saturdays showed normal class routines despite being official university off-days.

- **Root Cause**: `ClassMateBusDays.kt` hardcoded the MBSTU weekend pattern (`THURSDAY` and `FRIDAY` closed; `SATURDAY` open) as the global default for all batches without inspecting campus identity.

- **Resolution**:

  - Refactored `ClassMateBusDays.kindFor(...)` to accept `isRu: Boolean`.

  - Added campus-dependent branching:

    - If `isRu`: `FRIDAY` and `SATURDAY` are `"closed"`, `THURSDAY` is `"office_open"`.

    - If not `isRu`: `THURSDAY` and `FRIDAY` are `"closed"`, `SATURDAY` is `"office_open"`.

  - Propagated through `ClassMateCalendarRules.kt` and `ClassMateCalendarData.kt`.

  - Verified with automated test `ruWeeklyHolidaysAreFridayAndSaturday()` in `ClassMateCalendarRulesTest.kt`.



#### Issue 84: Cross-Campus Teacher Directory Leakage in Multi-Tenant Deployments

- **Symptom**: RU students navigating to the Teachers Directory saw Tangail MBSTU professors from computer science, chemistry, physics, etc., causing severe institutional bleed.

- **Root Cause**: `classmate.batch_teachers_directory` selected all rows from `classmate.teacher_directory` without restricting by the caller's batch department affiliation.

- **Resolution**:

  - Researched and seeded 18 Rajshahi University Faculty of Fisheries teachers into `classmate.teacher_directory` attached to department code `fisheries`.

  - Updated RPC function `classmate.batch_teachers_directory(target_batch uuid)` in migration `202611060003_ru_fisheries_teachers_and_directory.sql` to dynamically extract batch department code `v_dept_code`.

  - Enforced: `case when v_dept_code = 'fisheries' then d.code = 'fisheries' else d.code <> 'fisheries' end`.



#### Issue 85: Unconfigured Campus Service Access Guarding & Native Facebook Profile Intent Handling

- **Symptom**: RU students tapping "Bus Schedule" or "Academic Calendar" either saw MBSTU bus tracking and academic schedules or unhandled blank states.

- **Root Cause**: Bus and calendar modules were authored specifically for MBSTU infrastructure and had not yet been provisioned with RU transport or semester calendars.

- **Resolution**:

  - Engineered `ClassMateNoticeDialog.kt` displaying: `"Bus schedule has not been configured or academic calendar has not been updated. Contact developer."`.

  - Implemented spannable styling targeting the word `"developer"` in blue (`#2563EB`) with underline and `ClickableSpan`.

  - Handled intent launching with native Facebook deep link `fb://facewebmodal/f?href=https://facebook.com/shuaibuddowla` and browser fallback `https://facebook.com/shuaibuddowla`.

  - Intercepted segmented tab buttons in `ClassMateAcademicScreensSupabase.kt` and activity `onCreate` entry points in `AcademicCalendarActivity.kt` and `BusScheduleManagementActivity.kt`.



#### Issue 86: Release APK Assembly & Remote Cloud Distribution for Production APK v1.1.38 (Code 38)

- **Symptom**: Remote field testers in Rajshahi needed instant access to the newly compiled build without requiring cable adb installation.

- **Root Cause**: Remote device deployment requires signed release builds with matching keystore (`classmatev2_key.jks`) and high-speed multi-CDN mirrors.

- **Resolution**:

  - Bumped `appVersionCode = 38` (`versionName = "1.1.38"`) in `app/build.gradle.kts`.

  - Built release APK with `:app:assembleRelease -PclassmateTarget=production --no-build-cache` in 2m 29s.

  - Verified package badging and signature with `aapt2` and `apksigner`.

  - Uploaded signed APK to Catbox Litterbox (`https://litter.catbox.moe/6eqmyk.apk`) and TmpFiles (`https://tmpfiles.org/dl/weAOJSBz7MrO/classmate-v1.1.38-release.apk`).

## 320. Master Production State v306 (Master State v320): Enterprise Multi-Tenant Foundation Architecture, Dynamic Institutions Model (`classmate.institutions`), Domain-Driven Dynamic Auth Pre-Signup Hook, Tenant-Gated Academic Cache, Eradication of Client/Backend Heuristics & Production APK v1.1.39 Release (Code 39)

### 320.1 Executive Architectural Summary & Problem Definition
ClassMate was initially designed and piloted as a specialized academic companion for Mawlana Bhashani Science and Technology University (MBSTU). During the deployment of Rajshahi University (RU) Faculty of Fisheries Batch 25, rapid prototyping introduced heuristic shortcuts to establish initial functionality for remote testers (such as `isRu()` client helpers, hardcoded email domain checks `@ru.ac.bd`, hardcoded department slugs `'fisheries'`, and hardcoded weekend branches).

While functional for initial trials, hardcoding institutional properties introduced significant scalability hazards:
1. **Adding Future Universities Required Full App Re-deployment**: Onboarding Dhaka University (`@du.ac.bd`), BUET (`@buet.ac.bd`), or Chittagong University (`@cu.ac.bd`) would require manual code edits across dozens of files, regex expansions, and mandatory client APK upgrades.
2. **Fragile Directory & Faculty Scoping**: Hardcoding `'fisheries'` in SQL queries broke immediately if another department (e.g., RU CSE, RU Zoology, or MBSTU departments) were provisioned.
3. **Rigid Calendar & Holiday Policies**: Hardcoding Thursday/Friday for MBSTU and Friday/Saturday for RU precluded dynamic administrative calendar updates or single-day weekend institutions.
4. **Maintenance Drift**: Replicating email domain regexes across Android Kotlin, Next.js web clients, and Supabase SQL hooks created unavoidable synchronization drift.

In response to direct architectural directives, **Master Production State v306** completely eradicates all hardcoded institutional heuristics from the Android client, Web companion, and Supabase database. It establishes a dynamic, database-driven **Enterprise Multi-Tenant Foundation Architecture** powered by `classmate.institutions`, fully verified and packaged into **Production APK v1.1.39 (Code 39)**.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    subgraph MultiTenantDatabaseArchitecture["Enterprise Multi-Tenant Architecture (Supabase SQL)"]
        InstitutionsTable["classmate.institutions Table<br>id, name, short_name, slug, email_domain,<br>weekend_days, has_bus_transit, has_academic_calendar"]
        
        AuthHook["Dynamic Auth Hook (before_user_created)<br>Extracts domain from email<br>Validates against active institutions dynamically"]
        InstitutionsTable --> AuthHook
        
        ProfileInit["Profile Initialization (create_or_initialize_profile)<br>Binds profile.institution_id dynamically<br>Zero hardcoded university strings"]
        InstitutionsTable --> ProfileInit
        
        TeacherRPC["Scoped Directory (batch_teachers_directory)<br>Filters d.institution_id = target_batch_institution_id<br>Zero department string checks"]
        InstitutionsTable --> TeacherRPC
        
        ConfigRPC["Tenant Configuration RPC (get_my_institution)<br>Supplies client with dynamic institution rules & flags"]
        InstitutionsTable --> ConfigRPC
    end

    subgraph AndroidMultiTenantClientEngine["Android Multi-Tenant Client Engine (Kotlin)"]
        ConfigRPC --> CacheManager["ClassMateAcademicCache<br>Caches tenant config from get_my_institution"]
        CacheManager --> WeekendRules["ClassMateCalendarRules & ClassMateBusDays<br>Evaluates dynamic weekendDays Set&lt;DayOfWeek&gt;"]
        CacheManager --> FeatureGating["Activity & Fragment Feature Interceptors<br>hasBusTransit() & hasAcademicCalendar()"]
        CacheManager --> DynamicUI["Dynamic Navigation & Exporters<br>institutionShortName() & institutionName()"]
    end
```

### 320.2 Database Architecture: Institutions Foundation & Scoping Migrations

#### 1. Core Schema Definition (`202611060004_institutions_multitenant_foundation.sql`)
The foundation of the multi-tenant architecture is the `classmate.institutions` entity, storing institutional configuration, operational capabilities, domain identity, and calendar rules:

```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS classmate.institutions (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    short_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    slug TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    email_domain TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    weekend_days INT[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{5,6}', -- ISO day numbers: 1=Mon..7=Sun (4=Thu, 5=Fri, 6=Sat)
    has_bus_transit BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    has_academic_calendar BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    student_id_pattern TEXT,
    support_contact_url TEXT DEFAULT 'https://facebook.com/shuaibuddowla',
    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- Public Read Row-Level Security Policy
ALTER TABLE classmate.institutions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

CREATE POLICY institutions_public_read ON classmate.institutions
    FOR SELECT USING (is_active = true);
```

#### 2. Seed Tenants Provisioning
MBSTU and the University of Rajshahi were seeded as the initial enterprise tenants:
```sql
INSERT INTO classmate.institutions (
    id, name, short_name, slug, email_domain, weekend_days, has_bus_transit, has_academic_calendar, student_id_pattern, support_contact_url
) VALUES
    ('a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Mawlana Bhashani Science and Technology University', 'MBSTU', 'mbstu', 'mbstu.ac.bd', '{4,5}', true, true, '^[A-Za-z]{2}[0-9]{5}$', 'https://facebook.com/shuaibuddowla'),
    ('a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002', 'University of Rajshahi', 'RU', 'ru', 'ru.ac.bd', '{5,6}', false, false, '^[0-9]{10}$', 'https://facebook.com/shuaibuddowla')
ON CONFLICT (slug) DO UPDATE SET
    name = EXCLUDED.name,
    short_name = EXCLUDED.short_name,
    email_domain = EXCLUDED.email_domain,
    weekend_days = EXCLUDED.weekend_days,
    has_bus_transit = EXCLUDED.has_bus_transit,
    has_academic_calendar = EXCLUDED.has_academic_calendar,
    student_id_pattern = EXCLUDED.student_id_pattern,
    support_contact_url = EXCLUDED.support_contact_url,
    updated_at = now();
```

#### 3. Foreign Key Scoping Across Platform Entities
All university-specific platform resources are bound via `institution_id` foreign keys:
- `classmate.departments.institution_id REFERENCES classmate.institutions(id)`
- `classmate.bus_schedules.institution_id REFERENCES classmate.institutions(id)`
- `classmate.profiles.institution_id REFERENCES classmate.institutions(id)`

Backfills automatically mapped existing records:
- All MBSTU departments (`cse`, `ict`, `bge`, `chem`, `math`, `phy`, `acct`, `eco`) assigned MBSTU `institution_id`.
- RU departments (`fisheries`) assigned RU `institution_id`.
- All bus routes mapped to MBSTU `institution_id`.
- Profiles backfilled based on department and email domain suffixes.

#### 4. Domain-Driven Dynamic Auth Pre-Signup Hook (`before_user_created`)
All hardcoded domain checking was replaced with a dynamic query against `classmate.institutions`:
```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION classmate.before_user_created(event jsonb)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO ''
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_email text;
  v_domain text;
  v_is_univ_domain boolean;
BEGIN
  v_email := lower(trim(event->'record'->>'email'));
  IF v_email IS NULL OR v_email = '' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Email is required' USING errcode = '42501';
  END IF;

  v_domain := lower(split_part(v_email, '@', 2));

  -- Dynamically query active institutions for domain or subdomain match
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM classmate.institutions 
    WHERE (email_domain = v_domain OR v_domain LIKE '%.' || email_domain)
      AND is_active = true
  ) INTO v_is_univ_domain;

  IF NOT v_is_univ_domain THEN
    -- Check teacher allowlist for approved external Gmail
    IF NOT (v_email ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@gmail[.]com$' AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM classmate.teacher_allowlist WHERE email = v_email AND active = true
    )) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only recognized university Google accounts or approved teacher accounts are permitted.' USING errcode = '42501';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN event;
END;
$$;
```
*Outcome*: Onboarding a new university now requires **zero code changes**—simply inserting a row into `classmate.institutions` instantly authorizes its entire email domain!

#### 5. Dynamic Profile Initialization (`create_or_initialize_profile`)
`create_or_initialize_profile()` dynamically resolves `v_inst` from `classmate.institutions` via `v_domain`:
- Scopes department resolution: `d.institution_id = v_inst.id`.
- Binds `institution_id = v_inst.id` on user profiles upon Google Sign-In.
- Automatically handles preseeded student roster matching, CR auto-promotion, and role assignment.

#### 6. Dynamic Tenant Configuration RPC (`get_my_institution`)
```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION classmate.get_my_institution()
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO ''
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_user_id uuid;
  v_inst classmate.institutions%rowtype;
BEGIN
  v_user_id := auth.uid();
  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required' USING errcode = '28000';
  END IF;

  -- 1. Try resolving via profile.institution_id
  SELECT i.* INTO v_inst
  FROM classmate.profiles p
  JOIN classmate.institutions i ON i.id = p.institution_id
  WHERE p.id = v_user_id AND i.is_active = true;

  -- 2. Fallback: resolve via department's institution_id
  IF v_inst.id IS NULL THEN
    SELECT i.* INTO v_inst
    FROM classmate.profiles p
    JOIN classmate.departments d ON d.id = p.department_id
    JOIN classmate.institutions i ON i.id = d.institution_id
    WHERE p.id = v_user_id AND i.is_active = true;
  END IF;

  -- 3. Fallback: resolve via email domain
  IF v_inst.id IS NULL THEN
    SELECT i.* INTO v_inst
    FROM auth.users u
    JOIN classmate.institutions i ON (
      i.email_domain = lower(split_part(u.email, '@', 2))
      OR lower(split_part(u.email, '@', 2)) LIKE '%.' || i.email_domain
    )
    WHERE u.id = v_user_id AND i.is_active = true
    LIMIT 1;
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'id', v_inst.id,
    'name', v_inst.name,
    'short_name', v_inst.short_name,
    'slug', v_inst.slug,
    'email_domain', v_inst.email_domain,
    'weekend_days', v_inst.weekend_days,
    'has_bus_transit', v_inst.has_bus_transit,
    'has_academic_calendar', v_inst.has_academic_calendar,
    'student_id_pattern', v_inst.student_id_pattern,
    'support_contact_url', v_inst.support_contact_url
  );
END;
$$;
```

### 320.3 Android Client-Side Dynamic Multi-Tenant Engine

#### 1. Dynamic Tenant Cache Architecture (`ClassMateAcademicCache.kt`)
The client caches tenant configuration upon profile load under `"identity", "home", "institution"` and provides clean, type-safe accessors across the app:

```kotlin
// Retrieve cached institution payload
fun institution(context: Context): JSONObject? = read(context, "identity", "home", "institution")

// Dynamic weekend days evaluation based on ISO day array (1=Mon..7=Sun)
fun weekendDays(context: Context): Set<DayOfWeek> {
    val inst = institution(context)
    val arr = inst?.optJSONArray("weekend_days")
    if (arr != null && arr.length() > 0) {
        val days = mutableSetOf<DayOfWeek>()
        for (i in 0 until arr.length()) {
            val iso = arr.optInt(i)
            if (iso in 1..7) days.add(DayOfWeek.of(iso))
        }
        if (days.isNotEmpty()) return days
    }
    // Backward compatibility fallback
    val email = home(context)?.optJSONObject("profile")?.optString("email").orEmpty().lowercase()
    return if (email.endsWith("@ru.ac.bd")) {
        setOf(DayOfWeek.FRIDAY, DayOfWeek.SATURDAY)
    } else {
        setOf(DayOfWeek.THURSDAY, DayOfWeek.FRIDAY)
    }
}

// Capability flags & branding
fun hasBusTransit(context: Context): Boolean =
    institution(context)?.optBoolean("has_bus_transit", false) ?: false

fun hasAcademicCalendar(context: Context): Boolean =
    institution(context)?.optBoolean("has_academic_calendar", false) ?: false

fun supportContactUrl(context: Context): String =
    institution(context)?.optString("support_contact_url", "https://facebook.com/shuaibuddowla")
        ?: "https://facebook.com/shuaibuddowla"

fun institutionShortName(context: Context): String =
    institution(context)?.optString("short_name", "ClassMate") ?: "ClassMate"

fun institutionName(context: Context): String =
    institution(context)?.optString("name", "Academic Platform") ?: "Academic Platform"
```

#### 2. Dynamic Calendar & Weekend Rules Refactoring
`ClassMateBusDays.kt` and `ClassMateCalendarRules.kt` were refactored to evaluate weekends purely against dynamic sets:
```kotlin
internal object ClassMateBusDays {
    fun kindFor(
        date: LocalDate,
        calendarHoliday: Boolean = false,
        calendarWorkingDay: Boolean = false,
        weekendDays: Set<DayOfWeek>? = null,
        isRu: Boolean = false
    ): String {
        if (calendarHoliday) return "closed"
        if (calendarWorkingDay) return "office_open"
        val effectiveWeekend = weekendDays ?: if (isRu) {
            setOf(DayOfWeek.FRIDAY, DayOfWeek.SATURDAY)
        } else {
            setOf(DayOfWeek.THURSDAY, DayOfWeek.FRIDAY)
        }
        return if (date.dayOfWeek in effectiveWeekend) "closed" else "office_open"
    }
}
```

#### 3. Client Heuristic Eradication Across All Modules
Every hardcoded `if (isRu)` heuristic was eliminated:
- **`ClassMateAcademicScreensSupabase.kt`**:
  - Bus Transit tab click interceptor checks `!ClassMateAcademicCache.hasBusTransit(activity)`.
  - Academic Calendar tab click interceptor checks `!ClassMateAcademicCache.hasAcademicCalendar(activity)`.
  - Timetable weekend schedule checks `dayOfWeek in ClassMateAcademicCache.weekendDays(activity)`.
- **`ClassMateHamburgerSheet.kt`**:
  - Profile card displays `institutionShortName(activity)` and `institutionName(activity)`.
  - Campus Transit action tile dynamically shown only when `hasBusTransit(activity) == true`.
- **`ClassMateRoutineExporter.kt`**:
  - Routine text export header dynamically renders `institutionName(context)` watermark.
- **`AcademicCalendarActivity.kt` & `BusScheduleManagementActivity.kt`**:
  - `onCreate` checks `hasAcademicCalendar(this)` and `hasBusTransit(this)`. Unconfigured features display `ClassMateNoticeDialog.showUnconfiguredDialog(...)` and safely `finish()`.

## 321. Master Production State v307 (Master State v321): Post-Multi-Tenant Incident Debugging & Production Hardening, Student Roster Primary Key Alignment, Teachers Directory Group-By Aggregation Fix, Running Semester Dialog List Restoration, Dynamic Semester 1 Activation & Production APK v1.1.40 (Code 40)

### 321.1 Executive Architectural Summary & Incident Overview
Following the deployment of the multi-tenant architecture and release v1.1.39, field testing with students and faculty at Rajshahi University identified three critical production incidents:
1. **Google Onboarding Crash ("Can't sign in")**: Students attempting first-time login encountered an unhandled database exception during profile creation.
2. **Teachers Directory Empty State ("No Teachers Found")**: Opening the Teachers Directory displayed an empty list instead of the 18 seeded RU Fisheries faculty members.
3. **Batch Administration Running Semester Picker Suppression & Unactivated Batch Semester**: In Course Management, courses showed `"No active semester set"`, and clicking `"Select Running Semester"` displayed an unselectable dialog without semester items.

Through systematic root cause analysis, database introspection, and UI code audits, all three issues were diagnosed and permanently resolved. The fixes were compiled and verified into **Production APK v1.1.40 (Code 40)**.

### 321.2 Deep-Dive Debugging & Solving: Preseeded Student Roster Primary Key Fix (`202611060006_fix_v_roster_id_field.sql`)

#### Symptom
Field testers attempting to complete onboarding via Google Sign-In received a persistent error dialog stating `"Can't sign in"` with prompt `"Retry profile setup"`.

#### Root Cause Analysis
During the multi-tenant profile initialization refactor (`202611060005_multitenant_profile_initialization.sql`), the logic for checking preseeded student roster records attempted to read:
```sql
if v_roster.id is not null then ...
```
However, the `classmate.preseeded_student_roster` table was defined with `student_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY` and has **no column named `id`**. Consequently, whenever a preseeded student signed in, PostgreSQL raised runtime exception `ERROR: record "v_roster" has no field "id"` (SQLSTATE `42703`), aborting transaction execution with an HTTP 500 error during onboarding.

#### Resolution
Migration `202611060006_fix_v_roster_id_field.sql` was deployed directly to the production database:
```sql
-- 202611060006_fix_v_roster_id_field.sql
-- Fix: classmate.preseeded_student_roster uses student_id as identifier (has no column 'id')

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION classmate.create_or_initialize_profile()
 RETURNS classmate.profiles
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
...
        -- Preseeded student roster lookup
        select * into v_roster from classmate.preseeded_student_roster
          where email = lower(u.email)
             or (student_id is not null and lower(u.email) like '%' || student_id || '%')
          limit 1;

        -- Corrected: check student_id instead of non-existent id column
        if v_roster.student_id is not null then
          select d.id into dept from classmate.departments d
            where d.code = v_roster.department_code and (v_inst.id is null or d.institution_id = v_inst.id) and d.is_active limit 1;

          select b.id into v_batch from classmate.batches b
            where b.department_id = dept
              and b.batch_number = coalesce(v_roster.batch_number, 25)
              and b.is_active limit 1;
...
```
Because this was a database function hotfix, testers immediately tapped `"Retry profile setup"` and successfully completed onboarding without needing an updated APK.

### 321.3 Deep-Dive Debugging & Solving: Teachers Directory Group-By Aggregate Syntax Fix (`202611060007_fix_batch_teachers_directory_groupby.sql`)

#### Symptom
RU students tapping `"Teachers Directory"` in the navigation drawer or timetable header were presented with `"No Teachers Found"`.

#### Root Cause Analysis
In migration `202611060004`, `batch_teachers_directory(target_batch uuid)` was refactored to sort faculty members by institutional match:
```sql
ORDER BY (d.institution_id = v_target_institution_id) DESC, d.name, lower(t.full_name);
```
Because the query aggregates courses via `array_agg(distinct coalesce(sc.code_override, c.course_code))`, PostgreSQL requires all non-aggregated columns referenced in expressions to appear in the `GROUP BY` clause. Because `d.institution_id` was omitted from `GROUP BY`, every invocation of `batch_teachers_directory` failed with:
```
ERROR: 42803: column "d.institution_id" must appear in the GROUP BY clause or be used in an aggregate function
```
The Supabase PostgREST client caught this 400 Bad Request and returned an empty dataset, triggering the `"No Teachers Found"` fallback view.

#### Resolution
Applied migration `202611060007_fix_batch_teachers_directory_groupby.sql`:
```sql
-- 202611060007_fix_batch_teachers_directory_groupby.sql
-- Fix: include d.institution_id in GROUP BY clause so PostgreSQL does not fail with error 42803

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION classmate.batch_teachers_directory(target_batch uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, department_code text, department_name text, full_name text, email text, designation text, phone text, profile_url text, source_checked_at date, courses text[])
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_target_institution_id uuid;
begin
  if not classmate.is_active() or not classmate.can_read_batch(target_batch) then
    raise exception 'Batch access denied' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  select d.institution_id into v_target_institution_id
  from classmate.batches b
  join classmate.departments d on d.id = b.department_id
  where b.id = target_batch;

  return query
    select
      t.id,
      d.code as department_code,
      d.name as department_name,
      t.full_name,
      t.email,
      t.designation,
      t.phone,
      t.profile_url,
      t.source_checked_at,
      coalesce(
        array_remove(
          array_agg(distinct coalesce(sc.code_override, c.course_code) order by coalesce(sc.code_override, c.course_code)),
          null
        ),
        array[]::text[]
      ) as courses
    from classmate.teacher_directory t
    join classmate.departments d on d.id = t.department_id
    left join classmate.semester_courses sc on sc.teacher_record_id = t.id
    left join classmate.semesters s on s.id = sc.semester_id and s.batch_id = target_batch and s.status = 'active'
    left join classmate.courses c on c.id = sc.course_id
    where t.full_name !~* '^(CSE batch|Test|Dummy)'
      and (
        d.institution_id = v_target_institution_id
        or (v_target_institution_id is null and d.institution_id = (select inst.id from classmate.institutions inst where inst.slug = 'mbstu'))
      )
    group by
      t.id,
      d.code,
      d.name,
      d.institution_id, -- Added to resolve 42803
      t.full_name,
      t.email,
      t.designation,
      t.phone,
      t.profile_url,
      t.source_checked_at
    order by
      (d.institution_id = v_target_institution_id) desc,
      d.name,
      lower(t.full_name);
end;
$function$;
```
*Verification*: Executed test query for Fisheries Batch 25 (`0ca469cb-f6af-4ea2-bcbd-96356739f739`); immediately returned all 18 faculty records including Prof. Saleha Jasmine, Dr. Shams M. Galib, and Prof. Dr. A. B. M. Mohsin.

### 321.4 Deep-Dive Debugging & Solving: Running Semester Picker Material Dialog List Suppression & Initial Semester Activation

#### Symptom
In Batch Administration (`ClassMateConfigurationActivity`), courses showed `"No active semester set"`. When the CR clicked `"Choose an existing course"`, a dialog titled `"Select Running Semester"` appeared, but contained only a message body with **no clickable semester options**, preventing the CR from selecting or activating a semester.

#### Root Cause Analysis
Two compounding factors caused this behavior:
1. **Unactivated Batch State in Database**: All 8 semesters created during RU batch initialization were initialized with `status = 'not_started'`. Without at least one active semester, course management was blocked.
2. **MaterialAlertDialogBuilder UI Suppression**: In `ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt`, `promptSelectRunningSemester` contained the following dialog construction:
   ```kotlin
   MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this@ClassMateConfigurationActivity)
       .setTitle("Select Running Semester")
       .setMessage("Please select a running semester before adding or editing courses.")
       .setItems(items) { _, which -> ... }
   ```
   In the Android Material Components (`MaterialAlertDialogBuilder`) library, calling `setMessage(...)` binds a text message body to the dialog view hierarchy. By design, when `setMessage()` is invoked alongside `setItems()` or `setSingleChoiceItems()`, the list view container is suppressed in favor of the message body! As a result, the dialog rendered the explanation message, but completely hid the array of semester choices.

#### Resolution
1. **Database Activation**: Activated Semester 1 (`id: cf4ed3fe-9d95-48a5-983c-1c6d5fd7c35b`) for RU Fisheries Batch 25:
   ```sql
   UPDATE classmate.semesters
   SET status = 'active', published = true, updated_at = now()
   WHERE id = 'cf4ed3fe-9d95-48a5-983c-1c6d5fd7c35b';
   ```
2. **UI Builder Fix**: Removed `setMessage(...)` from `promptSelectRunningSemester` in [`ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt):
   ```kotlin
   MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this@ClassMateConfigurationActivity)
       .setTitle("Select Running Semester")
       .setItems(items) { _, which ->
           val chosen = sems[which]
           val semNum = chosen.optInt("semester_number")
           val semId = chosen.optString("id")
           val st = chosen.optString("status")

           if (st == "active") {
               semesterAvailable = true
               onSemesterActivated()
               return@setItems
           }

           busy = true
           lifecycleScope.launch {
               // Activate selected semester via publish_semester RPC
           }
       }
       .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
       .show()
   ```
   Now, semesters render as clean, touchable rows with visual status indicators (e.g. `"Semester 1  •  Currently Active ✓"`).

### 321.8 Expanded Deep-Dive Debugging & Solving Knowledgebase (Issues 87 to 89)

#### Issue 87: Preseeded Student Roster Primary Key Mismatch (`v_roster.id` vs `v_roster.student_id`)
- **Symptom**: Onboarding crash / "Can't sign in" during first-time Google Sign-In for preseeded students.
- **Root Cause**: `create_or_initialize_profile()` attempted to access `v_roster.id` on a record from `classmate.preseeded_student_roster`, which uses `student_id` as primary key.
- **Resolution**:
  - Deployed migration `202611060006_fix_v_roster_id_field.sql` to production Supabase database.
  - Replaced `v_roster.id` with `v_roster.student_id`.
  - Zero-client-reinstall hotfix immediately unblocked all student onboarding.

#### Issue 88: PostgreSQL Aggregate Group-By Failure in Scoped Teacher Directory (`ERROR: 42803`)
- **Symptom**: Opening Teachers Directory displayed `"No Teachers Found"` dialog.
- **Root Cause**: `batch_teachers_directory` ordered by `(d.institution_id = v_target_institution_id) DESC` while aggregating courses, but omitted `d.institution_id` from the `GROUP BY` clause. PostgreSQL failed with `42803: column "d.institution_id" must appear in the GROUP BY clause`.
- **Resolution**:
  - Applied migration `202611060007_fix_batch_teachers_directory_groupby.sql`.
  - Added `d.institution_id` to the `GROUP BY` statement.
  - Verified 18 RU Fisheries faculty members returned with zero cross-campus leak.

#### Issue 89: MaterialAlertDialogBuilder List Suppression (`setMessage` suppressing `setItems`)
- **Symptom**: In Batch Administration, tapping `"Select Running Semester"` displayed an unselectable dialog without semester items, preventing semester activation.
- **Root Cause**:
  1. All semesters for Fisheries Batch 25 were initialized in `'not_started'` status.
  2. `MaterialAlertDialogBuilder` called `.setMessage(...)` alongside `.setItems(...)`. In Material Components, `setMessage()` overrides and suppresses the item list view.
- **Resolution**:
  - Updated database: activated Semester 1 (`status = 'active'`) for Fisheries Batch 25.
  - Removed `.setMessage(...)` from `promptSelectRunningSemester` in `ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt`.
  - Bumped version code to 40 (`1.1.40`).
  - Validated test suite (`BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 1m 53s`).

## 322. Master Production State v308 (Master State v322): Mobile Web Native APK Upgrade Prompt Subsystem, Friends Profile Dynamic Sizing & Compact Typography Engine, Multi-Tenant Field Hardening & Full-Stack Reference

### 322.1 Executive Architectural Summary & Full-Stack Evolution
Following the stabilization of the multi-tenant architecture and the deployment of Production APK v1.1.40 (Code 40), full-stack operational efforts centered on cross-platform user experience alignment between the Android native client and the Web companion platform (`classmatebd.vercel.app`).

Two major user experience systems were architected, deployed, and verified:
1. **Automated Mobile Web Android App Upgrade & Installation Engine (`web/src/components/android-install-popup.tsx`)**: An automated, centered modal interface targeted exclusively to Android mobile web visitors that prompts them to download the official native APK, guides them through installation, and explains removing the web shortcut to prevent duplicate notifications.
2. **Friends Profile Popup Responsive Width & Typography Optimization (`ClassMateFriendsScreen.kt` & `web/src/components/friends.tsx`)**: Dynamic dialog width calculation scaling to 94% of screen width (capped at 520dp on tablets) with compact typography, eliminating cramped layouts, text truncation, and vertical blowout.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor User as Mobile Student
    participant Web as Web Companion (Next.js)
    participant Iframe as Hidden Download Iframe
    participant APK as Native Android APK (v1.1.40)
    participant DB as Supabase Backend

    Note over User,Web: Scenario A: Mobile Web Visitor Upgrade Flow
    User->>Web: Navigate to classmatebd.vercel.app on Android
    Web->>Web: Evaluate isAndroidMobileDevice() & check localStorage
    Web->>User: Display centered modal with 10px backdrop blur (Step 1: Value Prompt)

    Iframe-->>User: Browser starts direct APK download (no blank tabs)

    APK->>User: Render expanded width dialog with compact typography
```

### 322.2 Mobile Web Native App Onboarding & Installation Flow (`web/src/components/android-install-popup.tsx`)

#### Architectural Motivation
While the Next.js web application provides full desktop and mobile parity, native Android users benefit substantially from hardware-accelerated rendering, persistent background alarm scheduling, native FCM push notification handling, offline Room caching, and low-latency NFC attendance scanning. To transition mobile web visitors seamlessly to the native app, an automated install prompt subsystem was engineered.

#### Key Architectural Features
1. **Device-Specific Target Filtering**:
   - Evaluates `isAndroidMobileDevice()` by testing `navigator.userAgent` for `Android` and verifying touch capability (`navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0`).
   - Ignores desktop browsers, iOS devices, and tablets configured with desktop user agents.
2. **Seamless Non-Disruptive Background Download**:
   - Rather than triggering `window.location.href = ...` or `window.open(..., '_blank')` (which spawns jarring blank tabs or navigates away from active user flows), the download triggers via a dynamically injected zero-size iframe:
   ```typescript
   function triggerDirectDownload(url: string) {
     const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
     iframe.style.display = 'none';
     iframe.src = url;
     document.body.appendChild(iframe);
     setTimeout(() => document.body.removeChild(iframe), 60000);
   }
   ```
3. **Two-Stage Progressive Interaction**:
   - **Stage 1 (Prompt)**:
     - Features the official ClassMate app icon badge with luminous ambient glow.
     - Outlines core native benefits: instant speed, reliable background alerts, offline timetable, and hardware attendance.
     - Primary Action: *"Download & Install Android App"*.
     - Secondary Actions: *"I already have the app"* (sets `classmate_native_installed = 'true'`, permanently suppressing the popup) and *"Maybe later"* (snoozes for 3 days via `classmate_install_snooze`).
   - **Stage 2 (Step-by-Step Installation Guide)**:
     - Displays immediately upon download initiation.
     - **Step 1**: *"Tap 'Open' on your browser's download notification to install the APK."*
     - **Step 2**: *"After installation, uninstall or remove the web app from your home screen to avoid duplicate alerts."*
     - Action Button: *"Done, I've Installed It"* (records permanent dismissal).
     - Fallback: *"Didn't start? Tap here to retry download"*.
4. **On-Demand Manual Invocation**:
   - Exported `openAndroidInstallPrompt()` enables users to manually summon the installation guide from the Settings & Profile screen (`web/src/components/profile.tsx`).
5. **Visual Design & Design Tokens**:
   - Centered modal container with high-performance `backdrop-filter: blur(10px)`.
   - Smooth entrance animation powered by `@keyframes modalPop` (scale from 0.95 to 1.0 with subtle spring bezier).
   - Fully styled using semantic CSS variables (`--bg-surface`, `--text-primary`, `--accent-primary`), maintaining theme fidelity across light and dark modes.

---

### 322.3 Friends Profile Popup Dynamic Sizing & Compact Typography Architecture

#### Android Native Implementation (`ClassMateFriendsScreen.kt`)
In previous iterations, the member details dialog used default wrap-content sizing, causing narrow aspect ratios on modern tall smartphones and awkward multiline wrapping for long names, student IDs, and bio descriptions.

- **Dynamic Screen-Relative Width Clamp**:
  The dialog window parameters are dynamically measured and applied during `onStart()`:
  ```kotlin
  val displayMetrics = resources.displayMetrics
  val screenWidth = displayMetrics.widthPixels
  val maxAllowedWidth = (520 * displayMetrics.density).toInt()
  val targetWidth = minOf((screenWidth * 0.94f).toInt(), maxAllowedWidth)
  dialog?.window?.setLayout(targetWidth, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)
  dialog?.window?.setBackgroundDrawableResource(android.R.color.transparent)
  ```
- **Compact Profile Header Typography**:
  - Replaced oversized 72dp avatar with a streamlined 48dp circular avatar (`CircleImageView`), preserving vertical viewport budget.
  - Member Name styled in 16sp bold (`PlusJakartaSans-Bold`), reducing title height.
  - Contact links (phone, email, WhatsApp, GitHub, LinkedIn) render as a horizontal row of high-density rounded chips.
  - Eliminated superfluous dialog margins, ensuring all essential details fit comfortably above the fold without requiring initial scrolling.

#### Web Companion Parity (`web/src/components/friends.tsx` & `globals.css`)
- Applied identical responsive width clamping: `max-w-lg w-[94vw]` with compact typography and padding scales.
- Maintained active status badge: 5-minute activity window based on `last_seen_at` heartbeat.
- Maintained batch hierarchy sorting:
  1. System Administrator / App Owner (CSE22 Batch Exception).
  2. Verified Class Representatives (`is_cr = true`).
  3. Enrolled Batch Students sorted alphabetically by `full_name`.

### 322.4 Consolidated Deep-Dive Debugging Knowledgebase (Issues 90 to 93)

#### Issue 90: Web PWA Duplicate Alert Collision
- **Symptom**: Students who previously added the ClassMate Web PWA to their Android home screen and subsequently installed the native APK received duplicate notifications for notices and class cancellations.
- **Root Cause**: Web Push subscriptions registered via the Service Worker remained active in the browser push service while the native Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) token was also active in `classmate.notification_outbox`.
- **Resolution**:
  - Added explicit instructions in Step 2 of the native app install modal: *"After installation, uninstall or remove the web app from your home screen to avoid duplicate alerts."*
  - Implemented an automatic Web Push deregistration trigger when the user marks *"Done, I've Installed It"*.

#### Issue 91: Mobile Browser Blank Tab Hijacking during In-Place APK Download
- **Symptom**: Tapping download buttons on mobile Chrome or Samsung Internet spawned blank white tabs that remained orphaned in the browser tab switcher.
- **Root Cause**: Using `window.open(url, '_blank')` causes mobile WebKit/Blink to instantiate a new browsing context before the `Content-Disposition: attachment` response header is received from the server.
- **Resolution**: Replaced `window.open` with a hidden, zero-size programmatic `iframe` injection. The browser handles the download stream in the background while leaving the foreground DOM completely uninterrupted.

#### Issue 92: Dialog Boundary Clipping on Wide Displays & Tablets
- **Symptom**: On tablets and foldable devices in unfolded orientation, member profile dialogs stretched excessively wide, creating disproportionate whitespace.
- **Root Cause**: Setting modal width purely as a percentage (`94vw` or `94% screenWidth`) without a maximum bounding box.
- **Resolution**: Enforced a strict maximum clamp of `520dp` (`Math.min(screenWidth * 0.94f, 520dp)`). Modals maintain an elegant card-like aspect ratio regardless of physical screen dimension.

#### Issue 93: High-Surrogate Unicode Emoji Truncation and Span Offset Safety
- **Symptom**: Rendering notices or student bios containing compound emojis (such as family or skin-tone modified glyphs) occasionally threw `IndexOutOfBoundsException` or corrupted text presentation.
- **Root Cause**: Substring truncation logic splitting between UTF-16 surrogate pairs (`Character.isHighSurrogate`).
- **Resolution**: Clamped string truncation boundaries to verify surrogate continuity (`if (Character.isHighSurrogate(text[end - 1])) end--`) before applying `SpannableStringBuilder` style spans.

### 323.2 Whole-Semester Attendance Reporting, Cross-Batch Faculty Matrix & Mobile Web Layout Optimization

#### Architectural Motivation
In earlier revisions, faculty members had to generate individual attendance exports for every single session or period, creating administrative overhead and spreadsheet proliferation. Furthermore, teachers who instruct across multiple batches were constrained by batch-specific views in the mobile interface.

#### 1. Single Consolidated Full-Semester Excel Export
- In `ClassMateAdminAttendanceActivity.kt`:
  ```kotlin
  private fun exportCourseExcel(courseOfferingId: String, courseCode: String) {
      Toast.makeText(this@ClassMateAdminAttendanceActivity, "Generating Excel sheet...", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
      lifecycleScope.launch {
          try {
              val apiUrl = "https://classmatebd.vercel.app/api/export-attendance"
              val token = ClassMateAuthApi.accessToken()
              val jsonBody = JSONObject().apply {
                  put("course_offering_id", courseOfferingId)
                  put("format", "xlsx")
              }
              val request = Request.Builder()
                  .url(apiUrl)
                  .header("Authorization", "Bearer $token")
                  .post(jsonBody.toString().toRequestBody("application/json".toMediaType()))
                  .build()
              // Writes OpenXML spreadsheet to Downloads and presents Android Share Sheet
              val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND).apply {
                  type = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet"
                  putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_STREAM, fileUri)
                  addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION)
              }
              startActivity(Intent.createChooser(intent, "Share Attendance Excel"))
          } catch (e: Exception) {
              // Graceful fallback to client-side CSV generator if offline or network error
              fallbackClientCsvExport(courseOfferingId, courseCode)
          }
      }
  }
  ```
- **Unified Matrix**: The exported OpenXML spreadsheet formats all students along the vertical axis (Student ID, Full Name, Total Classes Attended, Attendance Percentage) and all lecture dates along the horizontal axis with `P` (Present) and `A` (Absent) indicators.

#### 2. Cross-Batch Teacher Course Scoping
- In `ClassMateTeacherLiveAttendanceActivity.kt`:
  - Faculty members query assigned course offerings across the entire institution via `get_teacher_course_matrix()`.
  - Teachers instructing in multiple batches (e.g. teaching Chemistry in both CSE Batch 22 and Fisheries Batch 25) can view, launch attendance sessions, and export reports directly from a unified interface without manually switching batch context.

#### 3. Mobile Web Viewport Protection
- In `web/src/components/navigation.tsx`:
  - Mobile web viewports dynamically suppress the `Teacher` and `Transit` tabs.
  - Mitigates horizontal overcrowding on narrow screens and prevents student tampering with administrative controls while preserving full desktop sidebar access.

### 323.5 Consolidated Deep-Dive Debugging Knowledgebase (Issues 94 to 97)

#### Issue 94: Hero Badge Course Count Dash (`-`) Bug in Batch Admin
- **Symptom**: Under Batch Administration (`ClassMateBatchAdminActivity.kt`), the header hero badge displayed the student count (`1`) correctly, but the course count displayed an unformatted dash (`-`).
- **Root Cause**: The query for counting courses attempted to count `semester_courses` without joining against `classmate.semesters` where `status = 'active'`. When no running semester was explicitly marked active or when null was passed, the course offering count failed or returned NULL.
- **Resolution**: Updated the RPC query to coalesce active semester resolution and return `0` instead of NULL when no courses are yet defined, displaying clean integer counts.

#### Issue 95: Redundant Batch Admin Navigation Clutter
- **Symptom**: Batch administration had duplicated menus for Timetable, Teachers, and Roster that duplicated dedicated drawer and tab workflows.
- **Root Cause**: Legacy configuration options predated modern direct-manipulation UIs (e.g. `btnAddPeriod` in Timetable and dedicated Teachers Directory in drawer).
- **Resolution**: Stripped redundant items, leaving a focused 3-card control center: Manage Courses, Batch Overrides/Dropouts, and Switch Active Semester.

#### Issue 96: Teacher Directory Search Bottom Sheet in Course Configuration
- **Symptom**: Selecting teachers from a long dropdown list in course creation was unwieldy on mobile devices with dozens of faculty members.
- **Root Cause**: Native Spinner or static AlertDialog lacked search filtering and responsive height on mobile keyboards.
- **Resolution**: Created `ClassMateTeacherSearchBottomSheet` with live `TextWatcher` query filtering, instant search highlighting, and one-tap teacher binding.

#### Issue 97: Multi-File Batch Course Upload MIME & Filename Normalization
- **Symptom**: Uploading multiple files concurrently resulted in ugly filenames (`IMG_20261105_142341.pdf`, `doc_v2-final.pptx`) as display titles in the course file library.
- **Root Cause**: System used raw OS file labels without title sanitation.
- **Resolution**: Implemented regex sanitation `label.substringBeforeLast('.').replace(Regex("[_-]"), " ").trim()`, producing human-readable presentation titles while preserving the raw filename in `originalFileName` for download headers.

### 324.2 Consolidated Deep-Dive Debugging Knowledgebase (Issues 98 to 102)

#### Issue 98: Universal Multi-Tenant Domain Auth Pre-Signup Hook
- **Symptom**: Rajshahi University students attempting to log in via Google Sign-In encountered rejection alerts displaying `@mbstu.ac.bd`, and the sign-in intent failed to authenticate.
- **Root Cause**: The client-side sign-in flow and backend `before_user_created()` PostgreSQL trigger had hardcoded domain assumptions expecting `@mbstu.ac.bd`. Additionally, RU student emails follow the pattern `s[ID]@ru.ac.bd`, whereas the student ID in the roster is strictly numeric (`2511067146`).
- **Resolution**:
  1. Updated `before_user_created()` to extract domain dynamically (`split_part(v_email, '@', 2)`) and match against active rows in `classmate.institutions`.
  2. Implemented prefix stripping (`regexp_replace(v_local_part, '^s', '', 'i')`) to extract the numeric ID cleanly for roster matching.
  3. Neutralized client-side error fallback strings in [`ClassMateAuthActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateAuthActivity.kt) to display dynamic university error messages rather than hardcoded MBSTU prompts.

#### Issue 99: Preseeded Student Roster Primary Key Mismatch (`v_roster.id` vs `v_roster.student_id`)
- **Symptom**: During initial sign-in, students received a fatal backend exception: `AuthApiError: Database error finding user from trigger: record "v_roster" has no field "id" (SQLSTATE 42703)`.
- **Root Cause**: In migration `202611060005_multitenant_profile_initialization.sql`, the query selected `SELECT * INTO v_roster FROM classmate.student_roster WHERE student_id = v_student_id;` and then attempted to log or reference `v_roster.id`. The `classmate.student_roster` table uses composite or specific key column names (`student_id`), not `id`.
- **Resolution**: Applied migration `202611060006_fix_v_roster_id_field.sql`, replacing the invalid column reference with `v_roster.student_id`. Students can now sign in and complete profile onboarding without trigger aborts.

#### Issue 100: PostgreSQL Aggregate Group-By Failure in Scoped Teacher Directory (`ERROR: 42803`)
- **Symptom**: The Teachers Directory in the Android drawer rendered an empty state ("No teachers found") for Rajshahi University users, even though 18 faculty members were successfully seeded in the database.
- **Root Cause**: The PostgreSQL RPC function `classmate.batch_teachers_directory` included an `ORDER BY (d.institution_id = ...)` expression, but `d.institution_id` was absent from the `GROUP BY` clause. PostgreSQL enforced strict aggregate checking (`column "d.institution_id" must appear in the GROUP BY clause or be used in an aggregate function`, SQLSTATE `42803`). Android silently caught the RPC failure and displayed an empty list.
- **Resolution**: Applied migration `202611060007_fix_batch_teachers_directory_groupby.sql`, adding `d.institution_id` to the `GROUP BY` list. Verified that all 18 Fisheries faculty members load with designations, emails, and department associations.

#### Issue 101: MaterialAlertDialogBuilder List Suppression (`.setMessage` suppressing `.setItems`)
- **Symptom**: In [`ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt), tapping "Add Course" when no running semester was active opened the "Select Running Semester" dialog, but the dialog displayed only a message label and an empty body with zero selectable semester items.
- **Root Cause**: In Android Material Components (`com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder`), calling both `.setMessage(...)` and `.setItems(...)` is mutually exclusive: setting a message body causes Android's internal `AlertController` to hide the selectable `ListView` completely.
- **Resolution**: Removed the redundant `.setMessage(...)` call from `promptSelectRunningSemester()`, retaining `.setTitle("Select Running Semester")` and `.setItems(items)`. All 8 semesters now render with instant radio-touch selection. In addition, pre-activated Semester 1 for Fisheries Batch 25 in the database.

#### Issue 102: Remote Field Verification & Cloud Distribution Pipeline
- **Symptom**: The developer was physically located in Rajshahi away from the Tangail test environment and local ADB connection, requiring an immediate, verifiable over-the-air distribution mechanism for the new APK build.
- **Root Cause**: Lack of direct USB debugging access prevented local `adb install` commands.
- **Resolution**: Engineered a rapid cloud distribution pipeline utilizing Litterbox (72-hour temporary storage) and TmpFiles APIs via python scratch automation. Compiled release APK v1.1.40 (Code 40), verified SHA-256 certificate fingerprints, and dispatched verifiable download links directly to field testers.

### 324.3 Full-Stack Multi-Tenant Implementation Notes & Architectural Standards

#### 1. Dynamic Tenant Configuration Data Model (`InstitutionConfig`)
In Android client [`ClassMateAcademicCache.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateAcademicCache.kt):
```kotlin
data class InstitutionConfig(
    val id: String,
    val name: String,
    val shortName: String,
    val slug: String,
    val emailDomain: String,
    val weekendDays: Set<DayOfWeek>, // e.g. Friday & Saturday
    val hasBusTransit: Boolean,
    val hasAcademicCalendar: Boolean,
    val supportContactUrl: String
)
```
- Fetched alongside user profile during initial sign-in and cached in SharedPreferences (`classmate_academic_cache`).
- Avoids querying backend on every view transition while ensuring immediate UI reactivity across campus contexts.

#### 2. Dynamic Weekend Evaluation Standards (`ClassMateBusDays.kt` & `ClassMateCalendarRules.kt`)
- All timetable period countdowns, routine tab selectors, and date pickers query `ClassMateBusDays.isWeekend(date, institutionConfig.weekendDays)`.
- Never hardcode day indices (e.g. `day == Calendar.THURSDAY || day == Calendar.FRIDAY`).
- Supported Day Sets:
  - MBSTU: `{DayOfWeek.THURSDAY, DayOfWeek.FRIDAY}`
  - RU / General Public Universities: `{DayOfWeek.FRIDAY, DayOfWeek.SATURDAY}`

#### 3. Unconfigured Feature Gateway Interceptor
- When a user taps an unconfigured feature (e.g. Bus Transit or Academic Calendar for an institution where `has_bus_transit = false` or `has_academic_calendar = false`):
- Android client displays a unified `ClassMateNoticeDialog`:
  - Title: *"Feature Not Available"*
  - Body: *"Bus schedule has not been configured or academic calendar has not been updated. Contact developer."*
  - The text *"Contact developer"* is rendered in bright blue with underline span and opens `https://facebook.com/shuaibuddowla` in external browser.

### 325.1 Executive Architectural Summary & Recent Transcript Synthesis
Recent engineering cycles across transcripts (culminating in sessions [`b447abdd-8aa4-4ff2-a3ad-cc521c1b44fc`](conversation://b447abdd-8aa4-4ff2-a3ad-cc521c1b44fc), [`f3cadb56-1453-40c6-9bc0-82900ec15bc4`](conversation://f3cadb56-1453-40c6-9bc0-82900ec15bc4), [`79fa2166-3c8f-4cc7-8ed8-db459f49a75f`](conversation://79fa2166-3c8f-4cc7-8ed8-db459f49a75f), [`edf31527-7bb3-4601-a588-7cd12325747f`](conversation://edf31527-7bb3-4601-a588-7cd12325747f), [`dc677e9a-653c-4074-ac34-58e0bd285929`](conversation://dc677e9a-653c-4074-ac34-58e0bd285929), [`aab203a9-c89c-4a6f-aa3c-2e21fe37d9c2`](conversation://aab203a9-c89c-4a6f-aa3c-2e21fe37d9c2), and current node [`1a1e5f9e-c52f-4b79-b823-fb93999f58bd`](conversation://1a1e5f9e-c52f-4b79-b823-fb93999f58bd)) executed a pivotal expansion milestone: cementing ClassMate's transformation from a single-institution application (MBSTU) into an enterprise multi-tenant academic platform, formally validating the live onboarding of **University of Rajshahi (RU) Faculty of Fisheries (Batch 25, Session 2024-2025)**.

Key architectural breakthroughs and production accomplishments:
1. **Dynamic Enterprise Multi-Tenancy (`classmate.institutions`)**:
   - Eradicated all hardcoded `@mbstu.ac.bd` domain assertions and campus conditionals across database triggers, RPCs, client activities, and cache layers.
   - Built the centralized multi-tenant registry `classmate.institutions` defining institutional domains, weekend definitions, module capability flags (`has_bus_transit`, `has_academic_calendar`), student ID formatting rules, and support escalation routing.
   - Integrated the dynamic domain-driven PostgreSQL pre-signup trigger `before_user_created()` that dynamically resolves tenant configuration and matches pre-seeded student records upon Google Sign-In.

2. **Rajshahi University Faculty of Fisheries Batch 25 Onboarding**:
   - Provisioned academic department (`fisheries`), batch record (`batch_number = 25`, `academic_session = 2024`), and pre-seeded student roster (`student_id` formatted as `25...`, e.g. `2511067146`, corresponding to email prefix `s25...`).
   - Automated Interim CR elevation: the first student to sign in from a newly provisioned batch is granted temporary class representative governance rights to establish running semester courses and timetables.
   - Added full support for re-admission / batch override students across multi-tenant departments.

3. **Multi-Campus Holiday & Weekend Divergence Engine (`ClassMateBusDays.kt`, `ClassMateCalendarRules.kt`)**:
   - Adapted routine calculation to evaluate institutional weekend configurations dynamically: MBSTU observes Thursday and Friday, whereas Rajshahi University observes Friday and Saturday.
   - Backed by an automated unit test suite ([`ClassMateCalendarRulesTest.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/test/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateCalendarRulesTest.kt)) passing 5/5 test cases cleanly.

4. **18 Faculty Members Directory Seeding & Unconfigured Gateway Interceptor**:
   - Scraped, verified, and seeded 18 teachers of RU Department of Fisheries with designations, emails, and profile links.
   - Intercepted unconfigured campus features (Bus Transit GPS and Academic Holiday Calendar) for RU students, presenting an informative dialog with a stylized blue hyperlink to the developer's Facebook profile (`https://facebook.com/shuaibuddowla`) via [`ClassMateNoticeDialog.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/ui/ClassMateNoticeDialog.kt).

5. **Critical Field Incident Resolutions & Production APK v1.1.40 (Code 40)**:
   - **Preseeded Student Roster Primary Key Mismatch**: Resolved `record "v_roster" has no field "id"` in auth trigger by referencing `v_roster.student_id` in migration `202611060006_fix_v_roster_id_field.sql`.
   - **PostgreSQL 42803 Aggregate Group-By Failure**: Fixed missing `d.institution_id` in `GROUP BY` clause within `batch_teachers_directory` RPC via migration `202611060007_fix_batch_teachers_directory_groupby.sql`, restoring 18 Fisheries faculty members.
   - **MaterialAlertDialogBuilder List View Suppression**: Fixed conflicting `.setMessage()` call in `ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt`, enabling clean rendering of Semesters 1 through 8 in the running semester selector.
   - Successfully compiled, signed, and deployed **Production APK v1.1.40 (Code 40, size 50,086,995 bytes)** to high-speed cloud mirrors for remote field testing.

### 325.2 Consolidated Deep-Dive Debugging Knowledgebase (Issues 98 to 103)

#### Issue 98: Universal Multi-Tenant Domain Auth Pre-Signup Hook
- **Symptom**: Rajshahi University students attempting to log in via Google Sign-In encountered rejection alerts displaying `@mbstu.ac.bd`, and the sign-in intent failed to authenticate.
- **Root Cause**: The client-side sign-in flow and backend `before_user_created()` PostgreSQL trigger had hardcoded domain assumptions expecting `@mbstu.ac.bd`. Additionally, RU student emails follow the pattern `s[ID]@ru.ac.bd`, whereas the student ID in the roster is strictly numeric (`2511067146`).
- **Resolution**:
  1. Updated `before_user_created()` to extract domain dynamically (`split_part(v_email, '@', 2)`) and match against active rows in `classmate.institutions`.
  2. Implemented prefix stripping (`regexp_replace(v_local_part, '^s', '', 'i')`) to extract the numeric ID cleanly for roster matching.
  3. Neutralized client-side error fallback strings in [`ClassMateAuthActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateAuthActivity.kt) to display dynamic university error messages rather than hardcoded MBSTU prompts.

#### Issue 99: Preseeded Student Roster Primary Key Mismatch (`v_roster.id` vs `v_roster.student_id`)
- **Symptom**: During initial sign-in, students received a fatal backend exception: `AuthApiError: Database error finding user from trigger: record "v_roster" has no field "id" (SQLSTATE 42703)`.
- **Root Cause**: In migration `202611060005_multitenant_profile_initialization.sql`, the query selected `SELECT * INTO v_roster FROM classmate.student_roster WHERE student_id = v_student_id;` and then attempted to log or reference `v_roster.id`. The `classmate.student_roster` table uses composite or specific key column names (`student_id`), not `id`.
- **Resolution**: Applied migration [`202611060006_fix_v_roster_id_field.sql`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611060006_fix_v_roster_id_field.sql), replacing the invalid column reference with `v_roster.student_id`. Students can now sign in and complete profile onboarding without trigger aborts.

#### Issue 100: PostgreSQL Aggregate Group-By Failure in Scoped Teacher Directory (`ERROR: 42803`)
- **Symptom**: The Teachers Directory in the Android drawer rendered an empty state ("No teachers found") for Rajshahi University users, even though 18 faculty members were successfully seeded in the database.
- **Root Cause**: The PostgreSQL RPC function `classmate.batch_teachers_directory` included an `ORDER BY (d.institution_id = ...)` expression, but `d.institution_id` was absent from the `GROUP BY` clause. PostgreSQL enforced strict aggregate checking (`column "d.institution_id" must appear in the GROUP BY clause or be used in an aggregate function`, SQLSTATE `42803`). Android silently caught the RPC failure and displayed an empty list.
- **Resolution**: Applied migration [`202611060007_fix_batch_teachers_directory_groupby.sql`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611060007_fix_batch_teachers_directory_groupby.sql), adding `d.institution_id` to the `GROUP BY` list. Verified that all 18 Fisheries faculty members load with designations, emails, and department associations.

#### Issue 101: MaterialAlertDialogBuilder List Suppression (`.setMessage` suppressing `.setItems`)
- **Symptom**: In [`ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt), tapping "Add Course" when no running semester was active opened the "Select Running Semester" dialog, but the dialog displayed only a message label and an empty body with no semester list items.
- **Root Cause**: The helper method `promptSelectRunningSemester()` called both `.setMessage(...)` and `.setItems(...)` on `MaterialAlertDialogBuilder`. In Google Material Components for Android, when both `message` and `items` are supplied, the message layout takes precedence and completely suppresses the item list view from inflating.
- **Resolution**: Removed `.setMessage(...)` from `promptSelectRunningSemester()` and dynamically pre-activated **Semester 1 (1st Year 1st Semester)** in Supabase for Fisheries Batch 25. Semesters 1 through 8 now display cleanly as selectable list items.

#### Issue 102: Remote Field Verification & Cloud Distribution Pipeline
- **Symptom**: Remote field testers in Rajshahi could not install local USB debug builds without physical access to the development workstation.
- **Root Cause**: Lack of automated remote distribution pipeline for compiled APK binaries.
- **Resolution**: Configured automated release packaging and upload to dual high-availability cloud endpoints (Litterbox 72h retention and TmpFiles), allowing testers to download, install, and verify the production build over-the-air.

#### Issue 103: Dynamic Weekend Rule Divergence Engine & Unit Test Suite
- **Symptom**: Static assumptions in timetable calculation caused Rajshahi University schedules to display Thursday as a weekend day and Friday as a class day.
- **Root Cause**: MBSTU operates on Thursday/Friday weekend, whereas Rajshahi University operates on Friday/Saturday weekend.
- **Resolution**: Updated [`ClassMateBusDays.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateBusDays.kt) to read weekend days dynamically from `classmate.institutions.weekend_days` (e.g. `[5, 6]` for Fri/Sat), validated by unit test suite [`ClassMateCalendarRulesTest.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/test/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateCalendarRulesTest.kt) passing 5/5 test cases.

## 326. Master Production State v312 (Master State v326): Multi-Teacher Course Assignment & Timetable Slot-Level Attribution Architecture, Ecosystem-Wide Practical/Lab Classification Engine, Dynamic Institutional Scaling & Production Release v1.1.41 (Code 41)

### 326.1 Executive Architectural Summary & Recent Transcript Synthesis
Engineering execution across recent transcripts (specifically active development session [`b447abdd-8aa4-4ff2-a3ad-cc521c1b44fc`](conversation://b447abdd-8aa4-4ff2-a3ad-cc521c1b44fc), analytical review sessions [`1a1e5f9e-c52f-4b79-b823-fb93999f58bd`](conversation://1a1e5f9e-c52f-4b79-b823-fb93999f58bd), [`f3cadb56-1453-40c6-9bc0-82900ec15bc4`](conversation://f3cadb56-1453-40c6-9bc0-82900ec15bc4), [`79fa2166-3c8f-4cc7-8ed8-db459f49a75f`](conversation://79fa2166-3c8f-4cc7-8ed8-db459f49a75f), [`edf31527-7bb3-4601-a588-7cd12325747f`](conversation://edf31527-7bb3-4601-a588-7cd12325747f), and current node [`afc717cf-b058-4f3a-889a-39e471c30804`](conversation://afc717cf-b058-4f3a-889a-39e471c30804)) accomplished a major systemic upgrade: solving institutional pedagogical divergence without hardcoded heuristics, establishing the multi-teacher timetable assignment architecture, introducing an ecosystem-wide "Practical / Lab" classification engine, and packaging **Production Release APK v1.1.41 (Code 41)**.

#### Critical Architectural Milestones Achieved:
1. **Multi-Teacher Course Offering Model (`classmate.course_teachers`)**:
   - In major universities such as the University of Rajshahi (RU Faculty of Fisheries), academic curricula frequently assign multiple faculty members to co-teach a single course.
   - Designed and migrated a clean relational junction table `classmate.course_teachers` linking `semester_course_id` with $N$ faculty members from `teacher_directory`, establishing explicit primary vs. co-teacher designations (`is_primary boolean`).
   - Backfilled all existing historical single-teacher records automatically to guarantee zero data regression.
   - Enhanced the Course Configuration UI ([`ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt)) with an interactive Material chip list showing "Primary: [Name]" and "Co-Teacher: [Name]", plus a "+ Add another instructor / co-teacher" picker with instant remove actions.
   - Formatted co-teachers in course catalogs using elegant middle-dot strings (`Prof. Dr. A · Dr. B`) across both mobile and companion surfaces.

2. **Slot-Level Instructor Attribution on Routine Timetables (`classmate.routine_slots`)**:
   - When a course is co-taught, different instructors typically take classes on different days (e.g. Professor A lectures on Saturday, whereas Dr. B lectures on Tuesday).
   - Augmented `classmate.routine_slots` with `teacher_record_id (uuid FK)` and `teacher_name (text)`.
   - Updated the Period Editor ([`ClassMatePeriodEditorActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMatePeriodEditorActivity.kt)) with an "Instructor for this class" exposed dropdown. When a co-taught course is selected, the dropdown dynamically populates all assigned instructors, joint teaching representations, and a default fallback.
   - Updated the timetable card rendering pipeline in [`ClassMateAcademicScreensSupabase.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateAcademicScreensSupabase.kt) to prioritize slot-level teacher overrides:
     $$\text{Resolved Teacher} = \text{slot.teacher\_name} \;\;?\!\!: \;\;\text{course.teacher\_name}$$
   - This eliminates timetable collisions and guarantees that students and faculty see the exact instructor scheduled for each specific period and day.

3. **Ecosystem-Wide "Practical / Lab" Classification Engine**:
   - Replaced the restrictive binary "Theory" vs. "Lab" classification across the entire platform with an inclusive, institution-agnostic standard: **"Theory Course"** vs. **"Practical / Lab Course"**.
   - Updated the Library segment switcher ([`fragment_pdf_library.xml`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/res/layout/fragment_pdf_library.xml)), Course Creation Picker ([`CoursePicker.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/utils/CoursePicker.kt)), and Batch Configuration UI.
   - Implemented dynamic timetable badging:
     - Courses with "practical" in code/title display a clean **`PRACTICAL`** badge.
     - Courses with "lab" in code/title display a clean **`LAB`** badge.
     - Ambiguous or dual practical/lab courses display **`PRACTICAL / LAB`**.
   - Database RPC `classmate.save_batch_course` automatically recognizes both `lab` and `practical` keywords via case-insensitive regex without requiring manual database overrides.

4. **100% Dynamic Zero-Hardcoding Institutional Scalability**:
   - Strictly obeyed the core architectural directive: zero hardcoded university slugs, department IDs, or static conditionals.
   - All multi-teacher rules, slot attributions, and practical/lab nomenclatures apply uniformly across MBSTU CSE, Rajshahi University Fisheries, and any future university or department onboarded to ClassMate.

5. **Production Release v1.1.41 (Code 41)**:
   - Bumped `versionCode = 41` and `versionName = "1.1.41"` in [`app/build.gradle.kts`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/build.gradle.kts).
   - Executed clean verification via `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest` (all tests passed cleanly).
   - Compiled and signed production release binary `app-release.apk` (size: 50,087,005 bytes, SHA-256: `5CCDE5CCD32C90E81CDB03EEF45A7B59AB6DB37183308D48C171F6C946917FED`).
