### 336.2 Consolidated Deep-Dive Debugging & Architecture Knowledgebase (Issues 143 to 146)

#### Issue 143: Autonomous In-Situ Faculty Registration & Scoped Directory Lookup (Migration `202611070002`)
- **Symptom**: When CRs configured courses for newly onboarded RU batches, they had to exit the course editor or request developer assistance if a professor was not pre-seeded in the directory. Furthermore, previous queries either leaked teachers across departments or threw SQL `GROUP BY` column errors (`SQLSTATE 42803`).
- **Root Cause**:
  - Legacy `classmate.teacher_directory` insert/update policies were restricted exclusively to global application admins (`role = 'owner'`).
  - RPC `batch_teachers_directory` contained unaggregated projection columns in the `SELECT` list when grouping course counts.
- **Resolution**:
  - Upgraded PostgreSQL RPCs `classmate.owner_create_teacher` and `classmate.owner_save_teacher` to permit active batch CRs (`classmate.can_manage_batch_catalog(target_batch)`).
  - Enforced RFC 5322 regex validation (`^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$`) while supporting both university domains and standard email providers.
  - Added the **`+ Add new teacher to directory`** button directly into the instructor picker in [`ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt), auto-selecting the newly created professor immediately upon creation.

#### Issue 144: 7-Stage Cascading Invariants on Course Deletion (`remove_batch_course`)
- **Symptom**: When CRs attempted to delete a course, PostgreSQL aborted the operation with foreign key constraint errors (`SQLSTATE 23503`) referencing `routine_slots`, `course_teachers`, `attendance_sessions`, `notices`, or `file_metadata`.
- **Root Cause**:
  - Courses in ClassMate are deeply relational nodes tied to timetable periods, multi-teacher offering links, historical attendance records, published notices, and cloud resource metadata.
  - Simple client-side `DELETE FROM semester_courses WHERE id = ?` failed due to foreign key restrictions.
- **Resolution**:
  - Implemented atomic stored procedure `classmate.remove_batch_course(target_course_id uuid, target_batch_id uuid)` with row locking (`FOR UPDATE`):
    1. Delete routine slot period assignments (`DELETE FROM classmate.routine_slots WHERE course_id = target_course_id`).
    2. Delete course teacher associations (`DELETE FROM classmate.course_teachers WHERE course_id = target_course_id`).
    3. Delete attendance records and sessions (`DELETE FROM classmate.attendance_records ... DELETE FROM classmate.attendance_sessions ...`).
    4. Unlink notice references (`UPDATE classmate.notices SET semester_course_id = NULL WHERE semester_course_id = target_course_id`).
    5. Unlink cloud resource files (`UPDATE classmate.file_metadata SET course_id = NULL WHERE course_id = target_course_id`).
    6. Purge student course enrollments (`DELETE FROM classmate.student_course_enrollments WHERE course_id = target_course_id`).
    7. Remove course definition (`DELETE FROM classmate.semester_courses WHERE id = target_course_id`).
  - Surfaced both a 1-tap red trash icon on course cards and a confirmation dialog in [`ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt).

#### Issue 145: Multi-Teacher Day-Specific Timetable Slot Resolution (Migration `202611070001`)
- **Symptom**: In multi-teacher courses, two or more faculty members share a course code across different days of the week. Previous versions forced a single instructor per course, resulting in incorrect timetable period cards and confusing cancellation notifications.
- **Root Cause**:
  - `semester_courses` stored only a single `teacher_id` / `teacher_name` string.
  - `routine_slots` lacked period-specific instructor attribution columns.
- **Resolution**:
  - Created junction table [`classmate.course_teachers`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611070001_multi_teacher_course_and_routine_slots.sql) with Primary and Co-Teacher designations.
  - Added `teacher_record_id` and `teacher_name` to [`classmate.routine_slots`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611070001_multi_teacher_course_and_routine_slots.sql).
  - Enhanced Android Period Editor to present an instructor dropdown populated from the course's assigned faculty.
  - Updated [`ClassMateAcademicScreensSupabase.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateAcademicScreensSupabase.kt) to resolve slot instructors dynamically (`slot.teacherName ?: course.teacherName`), enabling Saturday to display Teacher 1 and Tuesday to display Teacher 2 with zero collisions.

#### Issue 146: Poly-Faculty "Practical / Lab" Nomenclature Harmonization & Dynamic Accent Rendering
- **Symptom**: In fisheries and agricultural curricula, practical sessions are designated as "Practical" rather than "Lab". The legacy binary toggle ("Theory" vs "Lab") confused non-engineering students.
- **Root Cause**:
  - Database schema enforced rigid `CHECK (course_type IN ('theory', 'lab'))`.
  - Android XML and Kotlin adapters hardcoded "LAB" labels and badge logic.
- **Resolution**:
  - Updated database constraint to allow `'theory'`, `'lab'`, `'practical'`, and `'practical_lab'`.
  - Replaced binary toggle with a comprehensive picker supporting "Practical / Lab" across both Android native and Supabase backend.
  - Styled period badges dynamically in [`ClassMateAcademicScreensSupabase.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateAcademicScreensSupabase.kt) with an emerald accent (`#0D9488`), ensuring equal visual fidelity across all university disciplines.

### 336.5 Zero-Hardcoding Scalability Audit & Multi-University Tenant Guarantees

| Tenant Characteristic | Legacy Fragile Model | Master State v322 Zero-Hardcoding Implementation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Weekend Computation** | `if (email.endsWith("@ru.ac.bd")) { Friday + Saturday }` | Driven by `classmate.institutions.weekend_days` array (`{5,6}` vs `{4,5}`). Evaluated dynamically via `ClassMateBusDays.isWeekend(date, institution.weekendDays)`. |
| **Faculty Directory Scoping** | Hardcoded SQL `WHERE department_code = 'fisheries'` | Relational join `teacher_directory.department_id -> departments.institution_id` matching batch institution. |
| **Email Domain Validation** | Client-side domain whitelist regex | Auth hook queries `SELECT id FROM classmate.institutions WHERE email_domain = v_domain AND is_active = true`. |
| **Campus Transit Integration** | Unconditional MBSTU route loading on all clients | Capability flag `institutions.has_bus_transit`. If `false`, intercepted with maintainer contact dialog. |
| **Academic Calendar** | Unconditional MBSTU calendar event loading | Capability flag `institutions.has_academic_calendar`. If `false`, intercepted with maintainer contact dialog. |
| **Course Nomenclature** | Binary "Theory" vs "Lab" toggle | Flexible enum `('theory', 'lab', 'practical', 'practical_lab')` rendered with dynamic badges and theme tokens. |

## 337. Master Production State v323 (Master State v337): Multi-Tenant Allowlist Domain Desegregation, Incident Debugging (PostgreSQL 400 Check Constraint Breach), In-Situ CR Faculty Governance, and Dual-Campus Production Hardening (Migration `202611070003`)

### 337.1 Executive Architectural Summary & Recent Transcript Synthesis
A comprehensive synthesis across recent Antigravity transcripts—specifically active engineering development session [`b447abdd-8aa4-4ff2-a3ad-cc521c1b44fc`](conversation://b447abdd-8aa4-4ff2-a3ad-cc521c1b44fc) (Steps 17646–17679, timestamp `2026-11-07T11:34:49+06:00`), analytical review sessions [`34545b68-cbf3-4cd6-bd18-ec24e29f1e18`](conversation://34545b68-cbf3-4cd6-bd18-ec24e29f1e18), [`980ba008-6e25-4a50-b6da-dc3ca8cb2696`](conversation://980ba008-6e25-4a50-b6da-dc3ca8cb2696), [`d41ed79f-5813-44fc-9e83-33e1148f639b`](conversation://d41ed79f-5813-44fc-9e83-33e1148f639b), and previous orchestration nodes—documents the real-time detection, forensic root cause isolation, migration remediation, and production verification of a critical multi-tenant faculty onboarding defect on the live Supabase infrastructure.

This incident arose when a campus administrator attempted to register a faculty member for Rajshahi University (RU) and encountered an immediate database rejection:
```text
Failed to add teacher: 400: new row for relation "teacher_allowlist" violates check constraint "teacher_allowlist_email_check"
```
The subsequent investigation led to the immediate creation and deployment of migration [`202611070003_fix_teacher_allowlist_domain_and_permissions.sql`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611070003_fix_teacher_allowlist_domain_and_permissions.sql), eradicating lingering single-institution check constraints across `teacher_allowlist`, `cr_allowlist`, and `profiles`, while establishing robust authorization for verified Class Representatives and Campus Admins to manage faculty allowlists autonomously.

---

### 337.2 Incident Investigation, Forensic Diagnostics & Root Cause Analysis

```
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                        INCIDENT FORENSIC DIAGRAM: 400 CHECK CONSTRAINT FAILURE                    |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                                                                                   |
|  [Admin / CR User]                                                                                |
|         |                                                                                         |
|         v (Submits New Teacher: Name: 'Dr. Mostofa Ali', Email: 'mostofa@ru.ac.bd')              |
|  [Android UI: ClassMateTeachersDialog / ClassMateConfigurationActivity]                           |
|         |                                                                                         |
|         v (Calls RPC: classmate.owner_create_teacher(...) / classmate.set_teacher_allowlist)      |
|  [Supabase PostgREST Engine]                                                                      |
|         |                                                                                         |
|         v (Executes INSERT INTO classmate.teacher_allowlist)                                      |
|  [PostgreSQL Table: classmate.teacher_allowlist]                                                  |
|         |                                                                                         |
|         |--> [Legacy CHECK: email ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@(mbstu[.]ac[.]bd|gmail[.]com)$']             |
|         |                                                                                         |
|         X--> BREACH: Domain '@ru.ac.bd' does not match '@mbstu.ac.bd' or '@gmail.com'!           |
|         |                                                                                         |
|         v (Throws SQLSTATE 23514 / Error 400: Check Constraint Violation)                         |
|  [Android Client Toast]: "Failed to add teacher: 400: new row for relation 'teacher_allowlist'..."|
|                                                                                                   |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Diagnostic Breakdown:
1. **The Trigger Event**:
   - In conversation [`b447abdd-8aa4-4ff2-a3ad-cc521c1b44fc`](conversation://b447abdd-8aa4-4ff2-a3ad-cc521c1b44fc) at step 17646, the administrator uploaded an Android device screenshot (`media_1794029676814_ab634fc5.jpg`) showing an error toast while attempting to register an RU faculty member.
2. **PostgreSQL Constraint Inspection**:
   - Querying PostgreSQL metadata via `pg_get_constraintdef` revealed the root constraint:
     ```sql
     ALTER TABLE classmate.teacher_allowlist
       ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_allowlist_email_check
       CHECK (email ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@(mbstu[.]ac[.]bd|gmail[.]com)$');
     ```
   - While migration `202611070002` had successfully removed the regex restriction from the RPC wrapper functions (`owner_create_teacher` and `owner_save_teacher`), the underlying table-level CHECK constraint on `classmate.teacher_allowlist` had not been dropped.
   - Consequently, whenever an email was provided for an RU teacher, `classmate.set_teacher_allowlist` attempted to insert `mostofa@ru.ac.bd` into `teacher_allowlist`, immediately tripping `teacher_allowlist_email_check`.
3. **Collateral Vulnerability Surface**:
   - A deeper inspection across the schema revealed similar legacy single-institution regex constraints on related authentication and authorization tables:
     - `classmate.cr_allowlist`: Enforced `cr_allowlist_email_check` restricting emails to `@mbstu.ac.bd`.
     - `classmate.profiles`: Enforced `profiles_email_check` restricting emails to `@mbstu.ac.bd`.
   - Furthermore, `classmate.set_teacher_allowlist` and `classmate.owner_delete_teacher` contained rigid `IF NOT classmate.is_owner()` blocks that blocked verified active Class Representatives and Campus Admins from updating allowlist entries, causing 42501 (insufficient privilege) exceptions when called outside of the root maintainer account.

---

### 337.3 Full Database Remediation: Migration `202611070003`

To permanently resolve this bottleneck without compromising data hygiene, migration [`202611070003_fix_teacher_allowlist_domain_and_permissions.sql`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611070003_fix_teacher_allowlist_domain_and_permissions.sql) was drafted, tested, and applied directly to production:

```sql
BEGIN;

-- ============================================================================
-- 1. Relax teacher_allowlist check constraint to allow any valid email
-- ============================================================================
ALTER TABLE classmate.teacher_allowlist DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS teacher_allowlist_email_check;
ALTER TABLE classmate.teacher_allowlist ADD CONSTRAINT teacher_allowlist_email_check
  CHECK (email = lower(trim(email)) AND email ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+[.][^[:space:]@]+$');

-- ============================================================================
-- 2. Relax cr_allowlist check constraint to allow any valid university email
-- ============================================================================
ALTER TABLE classmate.cr_allowlist DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS cr_allowlist_email_check;
ALTER TABLE classmate.cr_allowlist ADD CONSTRAINT cr_allowlist_email_check
  CHECK (email = lower(trim(email)) AND email ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+[.][^[:space:]@]+$');

-- ============================================================================
-- 3. Relax profiles check constraint to allow any valid email
-- ============================================================================
ALTER TABLE classmate.profiles DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS profiles_email_check;
ALTER TABLE classmate.profiles ADD CONSTRAINT profiles_email_check
  CHECK (email = lower(trim(email)) AND email ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+[.][^[:space:]@]+$');

-- ============================================================================
-- 4. Update set_teacher_allowlist: Allow Owners, Admins, and active CRs
-- ============================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION classmate.set_teacher_allowlist(target_email text, target_department uuid, target_active boolean)
RETURNS classmate.teacher_allowlist
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO ''
AS $$
DECLARE
  a classmate.teacher_allowlist%rowtype;
BEGIN
  IF NOT classmate.is_owner() THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM classmate.profiles p
      WHERE p.id = auth.uid()
        AND p.verification_status = 'active'
        AND (
          p.role = 'admin'
          OR (p.role = 'student' AND p.is_cr AND (p.cr_valid_until IS NULL OR p.cr_valid_until > now()))
        )
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Teacher allowlist permission denied' USING errcode = '42501';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO classmate.teacher_allowlist(email, department_id, active, created_by)
  VALUES (lower(trim(target_email)), target_department, target_active, auth.uid())
  ON CONFLICT (email, department_id) DO UPDATE SET active = excluded.active
  RETURNING * INTO a;

  IF NOT target_active THEN
    UPDATE classmate.teacher_course_assignments SET active = false
    WHERE teacher_id IN (SELECT id FROM classmate.profiles WHERE email = a.email)
      AND semester_course_id IN (SELECT sc.id FROM classmate.semester_courses sc
        JOIN classmate.semesters s ON s.id = sc.semester_id
        JOIN classmate.batches b ON b.id = s.batch_id
        WHERE b.department_id = a.department_id);
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO classmate.audit_log(actor_id, action, target_id)
  VALUES (auth.uid(), 'set_teacher_allowlist', a.id);
  RETURN a;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION classmate.set_teacher_allowlist(text, uuid, boolean) FROM public, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION classmate.set_teacher_allowlist(text, uuid, boolean) TO authenticated;

-- ============================================================================
-- 5. Update owner_delete_teacher: Allow Owners, Admins, and active CRs
-- ============================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION classmate.owner_delete_teacher(target_record uuid)
RETURNS jsonb
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path TO ''
AS $$
DECLARE
  teacher classmate.teacher_directory%rowtype;
  linked_courses integer;
BEGIN
  IF NOT classmate.is_owner() THEN
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM classmate.profiles p
      WHERE p.id = auth.uid()
        AND p.verification_status = 'active'
        AND (
          p.role = 'admin'
          OR (p.role = 'student' AND p.is_cr AND (p.cr_valid_until IS NULL OR p.cr_valid_until > now()))
        )
    ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Teacher deletion permission denied' USING errcode = '42501';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO teacher FROM classmate.teacher_directory WHERE id = target_record FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Teacher record not found'; END IF;

  SELECT count(*) INTO linked_courses FROM classmate.semester_courses
    WHERE teacher_record_id = teacher.id;

  IF teacher.email IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE classmate.teacher_allowlist SET active = false
      WHERE email = teacher.email AND department_id = teacher.department_id AND active;
  END IF;

  IF teacher.profile_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE classmate.teacher_course_assignments SET active = false
      WHERE teacher_id = teacher.profile_id AND semester_course_id IN
        (SELECT id FROM classmate.semester_courses WHERE teacher_record_id = teacher.id);
  END IF;

  -- Clean up course_teachers junction table references
  DELETE FROM classmate.course_teachers WHERE teacher_record_id = teacher.id;

  DELETE FROM classmate.teacher_directory WHERE id = teacher.id;

  INSERT INTO classmate.audit_log(actor_id, action, target_id, details)
    VALUES(auth.uid(), 'delete_teacher_directory', teacher.id,
      jsonb_build_object('name', teacher.full_name, 'unassigned_courses', linked_courses));

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('deleted', true, 'unassigned_courses', linked_courses);
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION classmate.owner_delete_teacher(uuid) FROM public, anon;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION classmate.owner_delete_teacher(uuid) TO authenticated;

NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';

COMMIT;
```

## 338. Master Production State v324 (Master State v338): Web Companion Multi-Tenant Parity, Supabase Auth Pre-Signup Hook Payloads (`before_user_created`), Domain-Agnostic Google OAuth, Dynamic Transit Filtering & Cloud Distribution Pipeline (Migrations `202611070004` & `202611070005`)

### 338.1 Executive Architectural Summary & Recent Transcript Synthesis
A comprehensive synthesis across recent Antigravity transcripts—specifically active engineering development session [`b447abdd-8aa4-4ff2-a3ad-cc521c1b44fc`](conversation://b447abdd-8aa4-4ff2-a3ad-cc521c1b44fc) (Steps 17679–18121, spanning turns #208, #209, and #210, timestamps `2026-11-07T12:07:20+06:00` through `2026-11-07T12:50:18+06:00`), analytical review session [`e2805bdc-8750-4265-9c76-8ac48be9ac10`](conversation://e2805bdc-8750-4265-9c76-8ac48be9ac10), and previous orchestration nodes—documents the end-to-end multi-tenant expansion of the ClassMate Web companion application ([`web/`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/web)), the forensic resolution of a critical Supabase Auth Pre-Signup Hook failure, the eradication of client-side single-institution barriers, and dynamic transit fleet filtering across multi-campus portals.

Following the successful rollout of Production APK v1.1.42 (Code 42) and database migrations `202611070001` through `202611070003` enabling Rajshahi University (RU) Fisheries Batch 25 on Android, the development initiative shifted to the companion web application (`https://classmatebd.vercel.app`) to deliver 100% full-stack architectural and functional parity. During deployment and live field testing, two critical production barriers were diagnosed and remediated:

1. **Supabase Auth Pre-Signup Hook Failure (`ERROR: 42501: Email is required`)**:
   - GoTrue Auth delivers user payload metadata inside `event->'user'` rather than table-style `event->'record'`.
   - The initial database hook threw a raw SQL exception on null record references, terminating the OAuth handshake with HTTP 400/500 errors and blocking RU student sign-ins before user provisioning could occur.
   - Remediated via migration [`202611070005_fix_before_user_created_hook_payload.sql`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611070005_fix_before_user_created_hook_payload.sql) to safely extract user attributes from `coalesce(event->'user', event->'record')`, validate institutional domains against [`classmate.institutions`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611060004_institutions_multitenant_foundation.sql), and return compliant GoTrue JSON responses (`'{}'::jsonb` on success, structured 403 error payloads on unauthorized attempts).

2. **Single-Tenant Web Hardcoding & Bus Transit Leakage**:
   - Web Google OAuth client enforced `{ hd: "mbstu.ac.bd" }` parameter, preventing Google account chooser from allowing `@ru.ac.bd` selection.
   - Client-side onboarding regex enforced MBSTU 5-digit roll scheme (`ce24014`), failing to match RU 10-digit roll scheme (`s2511067147`).
   - Tangail campus bus fleets leaked onto RU student dashboards; resolved by dynamically binding transit navigation, deep-link routing, settings rows, and toolbar controls to the institution's `has_bus_transit` flag.

Both web and database systems were verified live in production, compiled with zero TypeScript errors, and deployed to Vercel production under deployments `dpl_2B6hbpj96r82sHtsUrAimtnMZry6` and `dpl_BKTSFLvoyEt2RZ41RD3Wcofu9giu`.

### 338.3 Incident Debugging: Supabase Auth Pre-Signup Hook (`before_user_created`) Forensic Analysis

```
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|               SUPABASE AUTH HOOK FORENSIC DIAGRAM: BEFORE_USER_CREATED CONTRACT                   |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                                                                                   |
|  [Student Clicks 'Sign in with Google']                                                           |
|         |                                                                                         |
|         v                                                                                         |
|  [Google Identity Provider] ---> Returns ID Token (email: 's2511067147@ru.ac.bd')                |
|         |                                                                                         |
|         v                                                                                         |
|  [Supabase GoTrue Auth Daemon]                                                                    |
|         |                                                                                         |
|         v (Constructs Hook JSON Payload: { event: "signup", user: { email: "...", ... } })        |
|  [PostgreSQL: classmate.before_user_created(event jsonb)]                                         |
|         |                                                                                         |
|         |-- [OLD BUGGY LOGIC]:                                                                    |
|         |   v_email := event->'record'->>'email';  <-- Evaluates to NULL!                         |
|         |   IF v_email = '' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Email is required' USING errcode='42501';      |
|         |                                                                                         |
|         X--> Raw PostgreSQL Exception Aborts GoTrue OAuth Handshake!                             |
|         |    (Client receives generic HTTP 500 / 400 Bad Request error)                           |
|         |                                                                                         |
|         v-- [NEW REMEDIATED LOGIC (Migration 202611070005)]:                                      |
|         |   v_email := lower(trim(coalesce(event->'user'->>'email', event->'record'->>'email'))); |
|         |   Checks domain against classmate.institutions;                                          |
|         |   IF valid THEN RETURN '{}'::jsonb; (Allows user creation)                              |
|         |   ELSE RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', jsonb_build_object('http_code', 403, ...));   |
|         |                                                                                         |
|         v                                                                                         |
|  [GoTrue Auth Evaluates Hook Response]: Clean 200 OK -> User Provisioned & Logged In!            |
|                                                                                                   |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Forensic Diagnostic Summary:
1. **The Defect Report**:
   - Following web multi-tenant updates, users reported: *"But there's still barrier in login. Ru students cant login"*.
2. **PostgreSQL Execution Trace**:
   - Inspecting PostgreSQL function invocations for `classmate.before_user_created` revealed an immediate transaction rollback:
     ```text
     ERROR: 42501: Email is required.
     CONTEXT: PL/pgSQL function classmate.before_user_created(jsonb) line 16 at RAISE
     ```
   - Supabase GoTrue Auth hooks pass user metadata under the top-level key `user` (e.g. `event->'user'->>'email'`), whereas database table triggers receive records under `record`.
   - Evaluating `event->'record'->>'email'` resulted in `NULL`, triggering the exception handler.
3. **GoTrue Auth Hook Protocol Requirements**:
   - In Supabase Auth hooks, raising a raw SQL `RAISE EXCEPTION` causes GoTrue to drop the OAuth session unexpectedly.
   - The GoTrue hook contract requires:
     - **Success**: Return empty JSON object `'{}'::jsonb`.
     - **Rejection**: Return structured JSON payload:
       ```json
       {
         "error": {
           "http_code": 403,
           "message": "Use a recognized university Google account or an admin-approved teacher Gmail."
         }
       }
       ```
4. **Remediation via Migration `202611070005`**:
   - Implemented [`202611070005_fix_before_user_created_hook_payload.sql`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611070005_fix_before_user_created_hook_payload.sql):
     - Safely extracts email from `coalesce(event->'user'->>'email', event->'record'->>'email', '')`.
     - Dynamically validates email domain against active records in [`classmate.institutions`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611060004_institutions_multitenant_foundation.sql) (`email_domain = v_domain or v_domain like '%.' || email_domain`).
     - Allows verified teacher Gmail addresses present in `classmate.teacher_allowlist`.
     - Returns `'{}'::jsonb` on validation success.
5. **Live Verification**:
   - Evaluated directly on Supabase production:
     - `s2511067147@ru.ac.bd` &rarr; `{'before_user_created': {}}` (Allowed)
     - `ce24001@mbstu.ac.bd` &rarr; `{'before_user_created': {}}` (Allowed)
     - `unauthorized@yahoo.com` &rarr; Structured HTTP 403 JSON error.

### 338.4 Multi-Tenant Available Batches & Institution Metadata Engine (Migration `202611070004`)

To eliminate hardcoded assumptions in client applications, migration [`202611070004_multitenant_available_batches_and_institution.sql`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611070004_multitenant_available_batches_and_institution.sql) updated the foundational RPC `classmate.available_batches()`:

1. **Institution Metadata Injection**:
   - Injects full institutional context into each batch payload:
     ```sql
     jsonb_build_object(
       'id', coalesce(i.id, 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid),
       'short_name', coalesce(i.short_name, 'MBSTU'),
       'name', coalesce(i.name, 'Mawlana Bhashani Science and Technology University'),
       'weekend_days', coalesce(i.weekend_days, '{4,5}'::int[]),
       'has_bus_transit', coalesce(i.has_bus_transit, true),
       'has_academic_calendar', coalesce(i.has_academic_calendar, true)
     ) AS institution
     ```
2. **Co-Teacher Batch Access Authorization**:
   - Added access rule in `available_batches()` joining on `classmate.course_teachers`:
     ```sql
     OR EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM classmate.course_teachers ct
       JOIN classmate.semester_courses sc ON sc.id = ct.semester_course_id
       JOIN classmate.semesters s ON s.id = sc.semester_id
       JOIN classmate.teacher_directory td ON td.id = ct.teacher_record_id
       JOIN classmate.profiles p ON p.id = auth.uid()
       WHERE (
         td.profile_id = auth.uid()
         OR lower(td.email) = lower(p.email)
         OR split_part(lower(td.email), '@', 1) = split_part(lower(p.email), '@', 1)
       ) AND s.status IN ('active', 'not_started') AND s.batch_id = b.id
     )
     ```
   - Guarantees that co-teachers assigned to a course can immediately view the batch, access the timetable routine, post course notices, and review class attendance.

### 338.5 Institution-Gated Bus Transit & UI Sanitization

When Rajshahi University students accessed the web portal, MBSTU Tangail bus transit schedules and tracking appeared in their navigation. A complete sanitization pass was implemented to ensure transit features only appear when configured for the student's campus:

1. **Navigation Sidebar & Bottom Tabs ([`web/src/components/app.tsx`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/web/src/components/app.tsx))**:
   - Conditionally injects the Transit destination into `desktopDestinations` only when `hasBusTransit` is true:
     ```tsx
     ...(hasBusTransit ? [["transit", "Transit", Bus] as const] : [])
     ```
   - For RU students (`has_bus_transit: false`), the Transit tab is completely omitted from both desktop sidebar and mobile navigation.

2. **Hash Router Guard & Deep-Link Protection ([`web/src/components/app.tsx`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/web/src/components/app.tsx))**:
   - If an RU student navigates directly to `/#transit` via URL or browser history, the router evaluates `hasBusTransit` and automatically redirects them to their timetable (`/#timetable`).

3. **Profile Settings Sanitation ([`web/src/components/profile.tsx`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/web/src/components/profile.tsx))**:
   - The *"Bus Transit"* settings row is wrapped in `{Boolean(ctx.transit) && ...}`, hiding transit notification preferences and stop configuration on non-transit campuses.

4. **Schedule Toolbar Sanitization ([`web/src/components/schedule.tsx`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/web/src/components/schedule.tsx))**:
   - The *"Bus Schedule"* toggle icon in the timetable top-bar is hidden when `has_bus_transit` is false, eliminating visual clutter.

     ```kotlin
     fun updateToggle() {
         val hasTransit = ClassMateAcademicCache.hasBusTransit(activity)
         if (!hasTransit && busMode) busMode = false

         val special = calendarMode || busMode
         text(root, R.id.tvUserName, if (calendarMode) "Academic calendar" else if (busMode) "Campus buses" else name)
         text(root, R.id.tvGreeting, if (calendarMode) "Your university, month by month" else if (busMode) "Student transport" else greetings[LocalDate.now().dayOfYear % greetings.size])
         root.v<View>(R.id.tvGreetingWave).visibility = if (special) View.GONE else View.VISIBLE
         root.v<View>(R.id.busSummary).visibility = View.GONE
         root.v<View>(R.id.daySelector).visibility = if (calendarMode) View.GONE else View.VISIBLE
         root.v<View>(R.id.swipeRefresh).visibility = if (calendarMode) View.GONE else View.VISIBLE
         calendarUi.scroll.visibility = if (calendarMode) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
         val isRoutine = !busMode && !calendarMode
         routine.setBackgroundResource(if (isRoutine) R.drawable.bg_toggle_item_selected else android.R.color.transparent)
         routine.setTextColor(activity.getColor(if (isRoutine) android.R.color.white else R.color.cm_text_secondary))
         bus.visibility = if (hasTransit) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
         bus.setBackgroundResource(if (busMode && !calendarMode) R.drawable.bg_toggle_item_selected else android.R.color.transparent)
         bus.setTextColor(activity.getColor(if (busMode && !calendarMode) android.R.color.white else R.color.cm_text_secondary))
     }
     ```
   - **Click Interceptors for Unconfigured Services**:

### 339.3 Timetable Slot-Level Instructor Attribution & Practical/Lab Classification Engine

In multi-teacher courses, professors frequently divide lecture responsibilities by specific days of the week. Previous APK releases only displayed the parent course lead teacher across all period cards. In `v1.1.43`, slot-level attribution is fully resolved:

1. **Extended Routine Slots Query**:
   ```kotlin
   val routines = async {
       if (ids.isEmpty()) JSONArray()
       else ClassMateAuthApi.rows(
           "routine_slots",
           "select=id,semester_course_id,day_of_week,start_time,end_time,room,type,teacher_record_id,teacher_name&semester_course_id=in.(${ids.joinToString(",")})&order=start_time"
       )
   }
   ```

2. **Period Card Attribution Precedence**:
   ```kotlin
   val slotTeacher = item.optString("teacher_name").trim().takeUnless { it.isBlank() || it.equals("null", true) }
   val teacherName = slotTeacher ?: detail?.optString("teacher_name").orEmpty().trim().takeUnless { it.equals("null", true) }.orEmpty()
   ```

3. **Expanded "Practical / Lab" Detection & Custom Badging**:
   ```kotlin
   val isLabSession = item.optString("type").equals("lab", true) ||
       item.optString("type").equals("practical", true) ||
       (names[courseId] ?: "").trim().endsWith("lab", ignoreCase = true) ||
       (names[courseId] ?: "").trim().endsWith("labs", ignoreCase = true) ||
       (names[courseId] ?: "").trim().endsWith("practical", ignoreCase = true) ||
       (names[courseId] ?: "").trim().endsWith("practicals", ignoreCase = true)

   val labBadge = if (isLabSession) {
       val sub = names[courseId]?.lowercase() ?: ""
       if (sub.contains("practical") && !sub.contains("lab")) "PRACTICAL"
       else if (sub.contains("lab") && !sub.contains("practical")) "LAB"
       else "PRACTICAL / LAB"
   } else "CLASS"
   text(card, R.id.tvTypeBadge, labBadge)
   ```

### 339.4 Dynamic University Weekend Engine (RU Fri/Sat vs. MBSTU Thu/Fri)

In [`ClassMateAcademicScreensSupabase.kt`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/app/src/main/java/com/shuaib/classmate/activities/ClassMateAcademicScreensSupabase.kt), the weekend evaluation function previously hardcoded MBSTU's non-standard Thursday/Friday weekend:

```kotlin
// OLD (Hardcoded MBSTU):
val isWeekend = dayOfWeek == java.time.DayOfWeek.THURSDAY || dayOfWeek == java.time.DayOfWeek.FRIDAY

// NEW (Dynamic per Institution via ClassMateAcademicCache):
val isWeekend = dayOfWeek in ClassMateAcademicCache.weekendDays(activity)
```

#### Weekend Mapping per Institution:
- **Rajshahi University (RU)**: `weekend_days: [5, 6]` &rarr; Friday (`DayOfWeek.FRIDAY`) and Saturday (`DayOfWeek.SATURDAY`). Thursday is rendered as an active lecture day with live class indicators.
- **MBSTU**: `weekend_days: [4, 5]` &rarr; Thursday (`DayOfWeek.THURSDAY`) and Friday (`DayOfWeek.FRIDAY`).
- **Future Universities**: Dynamically read from the institution's record in [`classmate.institutions`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611060004_institutions_multitenant_foundation.sql).

```
|  - Correspondence:    Non-Deterministic (Cannot be inferred from email without a catalog)        |
|                                                                                                   |
|  +---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+  |
|  | DISCOVERED BOTTLENECK 1: Database Regex Barrier in classmate.set_batch_override            |  |
|  | - Constraint: norm_id !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9-]{4,30}$'                                             |  |
|  | - Defect: Disallows '@' and '.', causing exception '22023: Enter a valid student ID' when   |  |
|  |   CRs/Admins attempt to submit institutional emails (e.g. s2110823125@ru.ac.bd).            |  |
|  +---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+  |
|  | DISCOVERED BOTTLENECK 2: First-Time OAuth Sign-In Blindspot                                 |  |
|  | - Table classmate.batch_overrides only stored student_id.                                   |  |
|  | - In create_or_initialize_profile() & complete_student_onboarding(), student batches were   |  |
|  |   computed solely from email session math without consulting classmate.batch_overrides.    |  |
|  | - Defect: Readmitted students / dropouts logging in via Google OAuth were forced into their  |  |
|  |   calculated original session batch instead of their designated override cohort!             |  |
|  +---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+  |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Detailed Findings from Production Audit:
1. **The ID vs Email Mismatch**:
   - In **MBSTU**, the student email (`ce23045@mbstu.ac.bd`) and student ID (`CE23045`) were identical, masking this architectural flaw during initial single-campus deployment.
   - In **Rajshahi University (RU)**, institutional email conventions add an `s` prefix (`s2110823125@ru.ac.bd`) while examination rolls are pure digits (`2110823125`).
   - Attempting to guess institutional email prefixes/suffixes algorithmically across diverse universities is brittle and prone to breakage.
2. **Database Constraint Barrier**:
   - In `classmate.set_batch_override(p_student_id, p_target_batch_id)`:
     ```sql
     if norm_id !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9-]{4,30}$' then
         raise exception 'Enter a valid student ID' using errcode = '22023';
     end if;
     ```
   - Because `@` and `.` characters are rejected, a CR or Admin entering a university email is blocked with an error.
3. **The First-Time Sign-In Blindspot**:
   - `classmate.batch_overrides` historically only tracked `student_id`.
   - When a student signs in with Google OAuth for the first time, `create_or_initialize_profile()` and `complete_student_onboarding()` resolve batch association strictly via regex session extraction. Neither function checked `batch_overrides`.
   - Consequently, readmitted students were routed into their default session batch, requiring manual database intervention.

---

### 340.3 Engineering Blueprint: "Institutional Email First" Override Architecture

To eliminate guesswork and guarantee flawless onboarding for readmitted / dropout students across any campus:

```
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|               INSTITUTIONAL EMAIL FIRST DUAL-IDENTIFIER RESOLUTION FLOW                           |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                                                                                   |
|  [CR / Department Admin in Batch Overrides Panel]                                                 |
|         |                                                                                         |
|         +---> Submits: University Email (e.g. 's2110823125@ru.ac.bd') OR Student ID               |
|         |                                                                                         |
|         v                                                                                         |
|  [RPC: classmate.set_batch_override(p_identifier, p_target_batch_id)]                              |
|         |                                                                                         |
|         |-- 1. Check if identifier contains '@' and valid domain structure:                       |
|         |      |-- True:  Sets email = lower(trim(p_identifier))                                  |
|         |      +-- False: Sets student_id = upper(trim(p_identifier))                             |
|         |                                                                                         |
|         +-- 2. Upserts into classmate.batch_overrides:                                            |
|                target_batch_id, department_id, email, student_id, updated_at                      |
|                                                                                                   |
|  [Readmitted Student Signs In via Google OAuth (First-Time or Re-Auth)]                           |
|         |                                                                                         |
|         v                                                                                         |
|  [RPC: create_or_initialize_profile() / complete_student_onboarding()]                            |
|         |                                                                                         |
|         +---> Check classmate.batch_overrides:                                                    |
|         |        SELECT target_batch_id FROM classmate.batch_overrides                             |
|         |        WHERE lower(email) = lower(auth_user_email)                                      |
|         |           OR upper(student_id) = upper(extracted_student_id)                            |
|         |        LIMIT 1;                                                                         |
|         |                                                                                         |
|         |-- OVERRIDE FOUND:                                                                       |
|         |   Enrolls student directly into override batch (e.g. Batch 25 instead of Batch 24)       |
|         |   Sets profile.is_readd = true and links to target_batch_id                             |
|         |                                                                                         |
|         +-- NO OVERRIDE:                                                                          |
|             Calculates default session batch via standard institutional email math                |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Key Implementation Steps:
1. **Schema Extension**:
   ```sql
   ALTER TABLE classmate.batch_overrides ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS email text;
   CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_batch_overrides_email 
       ON classmate.batch_overrides(lower(email)) 
       WHERE email IS NOT NULL;
   ```
2. **Updated RPC `classmate.set_batch_override`**:
   - Accepts either email or alphanumeric ID.
   - Validates email syntax when `@` is present; validates ID regex when `@` is absent.
   - Normalizes email to lowercase and ID to uppercase.
3. **Onboarding Hooks**:
   - `create_or_initialize_profile()` and `complete_student_onboarding()` inspect `batch_overrides` prior to executing default session arithmetic.
4. **UI Adaptation**:
   - Modifies prompt in both Native Android and Web companion from `"Student ID"` to `"University Email or Student ID"`.

### 340.4 Forensic Verification: Multi-Tenant University & Batch Isolation

A systematic review of all active Row Level Security (RLS) policies and PostgreSQL schemas confirms rigorous multi-tenant data isolation:

```
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                        MULTI-TENANT DATA ISOLATION BOUNDARIES                                     |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                                                                                   |
|   +---------------------------------------+       +---------------------------------------+       |
|   |          MBSTU TENANT REALM           |       |           RU TENANT REALM             |       |

|   |  - Departments: CSE, ICT, TE, etc.    |       |  - Faculties: Fisheries               |       |
|   |  - Batches: CE-20, CE-21, etc.        |       |  - Batches: Batch 25, etc.            |       |
|   +-------------------+-------------------+       +-------------------+-------------------+       |
|                       |                                               |                           |
|                       +-----------------------+-----------------------+                           |
|                                               |                                                   |
|                                               v                                                   |
|                            [POSTGRESQL ROW LEVEL SECURITY (RLS)]                                  |
|                                                                                                   |
|   1. classmate.notices:                                                                           |
|      - Policy: can_read_batch(auth.uid(), batch_id)                                               |
|      - Guarantee: Students cannot read or fetch notices from another batch or campus.             |
|                                                                                                   |
|   2. classmate.routine_slots (Timetable):                                                         |
|      - Policy: p.batch_id = routine_slots.batch_id                                                |
|      - Guarantee: Schedules are isolated 100% to the student's enrolled cohort.                   |
|                                                                                                   |
|   3. classmate.file_metadata (Academic Library):                                                  |
|      - Policy: p.batch_id = file_metadata.batch_id OR is_public = true                            |
|      - Guarantee: Protected course resources are visible only to the owning batch.                |
|                                                                                                   |
|   4. classmate.attendance_sessions:                                                               |
|      - Policy: p.batch_id = attendance_sessions.batch_id                                          |
|      - Guarantee: RFID taps and QR live sessions cannot cross batch boundaries.                   |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

### 340.5 Notification Outbox Routing Isolation & App Update Dispatch Bug Resolution

```
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                       NOTIFICATION OUTBOX MULTI-TENANT ROUTING                                    |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                                                                                   |
|  [Event Generated in classmate.notification_outbox]                                               |
|  Columns: kind, department_id, batch_id, semester_course_id, title, body                          |
|         |                                                                                         |
|         v                                                                                         |
|  [Recipient Resolver: classmate.notification_recipients(event_id)]                                |
|         |                                                                                         |
|         |-- IF kind IN ('notice', 'cancellation', 'routine_change', 'resource'):                  |
|         |   Query Filters:                                                                        |
|         |     p.role = 'student'                                                                  |
|         |     AND p.batch_id = event.batch_id                                                     |
|         |     AND p.department_id = event.department_id                                           |
|         |                                                                                         |
|         |   RESULT: 100% Batch & Campus Isolated!                                                 |
|         |   - MBSTU students NEVER receive RU notices or cancellations.                           |
|         |   - RU students NEVER receive MBSTU notices or bus alerts.                              |
|         |   - No crowded or confusing notification bleeding between campuses.                     |
|         |                                                                                         |
|         +-- IF kind = 'app_update' (Global Application Software Releases):                        |
|             |                                                                                     |
|             |  [DISCOVERED DEFECT IN CURRENT RPC]:                                                |
|             |  - For app releases, event.batch_id IS NULL.                                       |
|             |  - Current query joined ON p.batch_id = b.id, returning 0 recipients!               |
|             |  - Production Evidence: Event fa0083f8-6ffa-4a2d-82ee-d82505a8eaba (v1.1.43)        |
|             |    returned count(*) = 0 recipients in notification_recipients().                   |
|             |                                                                                     |
|             |  [ENGINEERED RESOLUTION]:                                                           |
|             |  - Update query condition:                                                          |
|             |      WHERE (e.kind = 'app_update')                                                  |
|             |         OR (p.batch_id = e.batch_id AND p.department_id = e.department_id)          |
|             |  - Allows app update announcements to reach all active registered users             |
|             |    across all universities, while keeping academic alerts strictly batch-isolated.  |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

### 341.2 Production Database Migration & Schema Extension (`202611070006_email_batch_overrides_and_notification_fix.sql`)

Migration [`202611070006_email_batch_overrides_and_notification_fix.sql`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611070006_email_batch_overrides_and_notification_fix.sql) was executed directly against production PostgreSQL under a single atomic transaction block (`begin; ... commit;`).

#### Schema Alterations & Indexing
```sql
-- 1. Extend classmate.batch_overrides to support university email
alter table classmate.batch_overrides add column if not exists email text;

-- 2. Relax student_id check and allow nullable when email is supplied
alter table classmate.batch_overrides drop constraint if exists batch_overrides_student_id_check;
alter table classmate.batch_overrides alter column student_id drop not null;

-- 3. Composite identifier check: either student_id or email must be present and valid
alter table classmate.batch_overrides drop constraint if exists batch_overrides_identifier_check;
alter table classmate.batch_overrides add constraint batch_overrides_identifier_check
  check (
    (student_id is not null and length(trim(student_id)) between 4 and 30)
    or
    (email is not null and email = lower(trim(email)) and email ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+[.][^[:space:]@]+$')
  );

-- 4. Unique index on lowercase trimmed email
create unique index if not exists batch_overrides_email_unique
  on classmate.batch_overrides (lower(trim(email)))
  where email is not null;
```

#### Polymorphic Ingestion RPC: `classmate.set_batch_override`
The updated procedure dynamically determines whether the administrator/CR provided a university email or a student roll number:
1. **Email Processing (`raw_input LIKE '%@%'`)**:
   - Validates email formatting.
   - Applies campus-specific regex extractors:
     - Rajshahi University: `^(?:s)?([0-9]{8,10})@ru[.]ac[.]bd$` &rarr; extracts examination roll number `2110823125`.
     - MBSTU: `^([a-z]+)([0-9]{2})([0-9]{3,4})@mbstu[.]ac[.]bd$` &rarr; extracts roll number `CE23045`.
   - Queries `classmate.profiles` for existing accounts with matching lowercase email.
2. **Student ID Processing**:
   - Normalizes roll number to uppercase (`CE23045` or `2410467135`).
   - Queries `classmate.profiles` for matching registered student profile.
3. **Upsert Logic**:
   - If both email and `norm_id` are resolved, upserts with conflict handling on `student_id`.
   - If only email is known, checks existing override row by email before updating or inserting.
   - If the student profile already exists in `classmate.profiles`, their `batch_id`, `department_id`, and `academic_session` are immediately updated to the target batch with `verification_status = 'active'`.

#### Override Removal & Inspection RPCs
- **`classmate.delete_batch_override(target_student_id text, target_override_id uuid)`**: Accepts either unique override UUID, university email, or student ID.
- **`classmate.owner_batch_overrides()`**: Returns table with columns `(id, student_id, email, effective_batch_id, reason, added_by, created_at, batch_name, department_name)`.
- **`classmate.is_readd_student(p_student_id text, p_batch_id uuid, p_email text)`**: Inspects `classmate.batch_overrides` by either email or roll number before falling back to session-year comparison arithmetic.

### 341.3 Student Onboarding & First-Time Profile Initialization Flow (`create_or_initialize_profile`)

The student onboarding initialization procedure was restructured to guarantee deterministic cohort routing:

```
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|               FIRST-TIME GOOGLE OAUTH PROFILE INITIALIZATION RESOLUTION ORDER                     |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                                                                                   |
|  [USER SIGNS IN VIA GOOGLE OAUTH (auth.users)]                                                    |
|                                                                                                   |
|  STEP 1: Verify Institutional Domain & Dynamic Institution Association                           |
|          Match split_part(u.email, '@', 2) against classmate.institutions                        |
|                                                                                                   |
|  STEP 2: App Owner / Admin Allowlist Check                                                        |
|          IF email IN classmate.app_owners THEN role = 'admin', active                             |
|                                                                                                   |
|  STEP 3: Faculty Allowlist Check                                                                 |
|          IF email IN classmate.teacher_allowlist THEN role = 'teacher', active                   |
|                                                                                                   |
|  STEP 4: Class Representative (CR) Allowlist Check                                               |
|          IF email IN classmate.cr_allowlist THEN role = 'student', is_cr = true                  |
|                                                                                                   |
|  STEP 5: [CRITICAL ENHANCEMENT] BATCH OVERRIDES PRE-CHECK                                         |
|          SELECT * FROM classmate.batch_overrides                                                  |
|          WHERE (email IS NOT NULL AND lower(email) = lower(u.email))                               |
|             OR (parsed_id IS NOT NULL AND upper(student_id) = parsed_id)                          |
|          LIMIT 1;                                                                                 |
|                                                                                                   |
|          +--> IF MATCHED:                                                                         |
|          |    - Route DIRECTLY into v_override.effective_batch_id                                  |
|          |    - Department & academic session bound to target batch                              |
|          |    - verification_status = 'active', profile_source = 'auto'                           |
|          |    - BYPASSES default session formula arithmetic completely!                           |
|          |                                                                                        |
|          +--> IF NOT MATCHED:                                                                     |
|               Continue to Step 6: Preseeded Student Roster Check                                  |
|               (or Step 7: Standard Student Pending Onboarding)                                    |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

This ensures that re-admitted students whose CRs entered their details beforehand are automatically enrolled in their active batch from day zero without requiring administrative manual intervention after registration.

### 341.4 Multi-Tenant Notification Dispatch Isolation & Global Release Broadcast Engine

The PostgreSQL notification routing engine was hardened in [`classmate.notification_recipients(target_event uuid)`](file:///C:/Users/USER/AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate/supabase/migrations/202611070006_email_batch_overrides_and_notification_fix.sql#L568-L652) to cleanly separate software update broadcasts from batch-isolated academic announcements:

```
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                  NOTIFICATION DISPATCH ROUTING ARCHITECTURE (State v327 / v341)                   |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                                                                                   |
|  [EVENT ARRIVES IN classmate.notification_outbox]                                                 |
|                                                                                                   |
|  CASE A: KIND = 'app_update' (Global Platform Software Releases)                                  |
|  ----------------------------------------------------------------                                 |
|  SELECT DISTINCT p.id, dt.fcm_token                                                               |
|  FROM classmate.profiles p                                                                        |
|  JOIN classmate.device_tokens dt ON dt.profile_id = p.id                                          |
|  WHERE p.verification_status = 'active';                                                          |
|  -> Delivers to ALL active registered devices across all universities and batches.                |
|  -> Live Production Evidence: Event for Release 44 returned 135+ verified FCM tokens.              |
|                                                                                                   |
|  CASE B: RECIPIENT_PROFILE_ID IS NOT NULL (Targeted Personal Direct Alerts)                       |
|  --------------------------------------------------------------------------                       |
|  - Student ban / ban-lifted events: Delivered directly to targeted profile.                       |
|  - Other direct events: Excludes recipients with active bans (starts_at <= now < ends_at).         |
|                                                                                                   |
|  CASE C: BATCH / ACADEMIC BROADCAST (Notices, Routine Changes, Cancellations, Files)              |
|  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------               |
|  SELECT DISTINCT p.id, dt.fcm_token                                                               |
|  FROM classmate.profiles p                                                                        |
|  JOIN classmate.device_tokens dt ON dt.profile_id = p.id                                          |
|  LEFT JOIN classmate.batches b ON b.id = e.batch_id AND b.department_id = e.department_id       |
|  WHERE (                                                                                          |
|    p.role = 'student'                                                                             |
|    AND p.batch_id = b.id                                                                          |
|    AND p.department_id = b.department_id                                                         |
|    AND p.verification_status = 'active'                                                           |
|    AND NOT EXISTS (                                                                               |
|      SELECT 1 FROM classmate.student_bans sb                                                      |
|      WHERE sb.profile_id = p.id AND sb.lifted_at IS NULL                                          |
|        AND sb.starts_at <= now() AND sb.ends_at > now()                                           |
|    )                                                                                              |
|  ) OR (                                                                                           |
|    p.role = 'teacher' AND p.verification_status = 'active' AND ...                                |
|  );                                                                                               |
|  -> Guaranteed 100% campus and cohort isolation. Zero bleed between MBSTU and RU.                 |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

### 342.2 Comprehensive Debugging & Problem-Solving Knowledgebase (Issues 163 to 167)

#### Issue 163: PostgreSQL Alphanumeric Check Constraint Barrier for University Email Ingestion
- **Symptom**: When CRs or Administrators in Rajshahi University attempted to enter student institutional emails (such as `s2110823125@ru.ac.bd`) into the Batch Overrides modal, the request was rejected with PostgreSQL Error 400: `new row for relation "batch_overrides" violates check constraint "batch_overrides_student_id_check"`.
- **Root Cause**:
  - The legacy column `student_id` enforced constraint `CHECK (student_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9-]{4,30}$')`.
  - University emails containing `@` and `.` characters inherently violated this alphanumeric constraint.
- **Engineered Resolution (Migration `202611070006`)**:
  - Added a dedicated `email text` column to `classmate.batch_overrides`.
  - Dropped `batch_overrides_student_id_check` and made `student_id` nullable.
  - Implemented composite constraint `batch_overrides_identifier_check` requiring either a valid student ID (4-30 chars) or a valid lowercase trimmed email (`email = lower(trim(email)) AND email ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+[.][^[:space:]@]+$'`).
  - Added unique index `batch_overrides_email_unique` on `lower(trim(email)) WHERE email IS NOT NULL`.
  - Upgraded `classmate.set_batch_override` with intelligent email detection and campus-specific regex parsers:
    - RU: extracts `2110823125` from `s2110823125@ru.ac.bd`.
    - MBSTU: extracts `CE23045` from `ce23045@mbstu.ac.bd`.
  - Automatically linked existing override for RU re-admitted student `2410467135` &rarr; `s2410467135@ru.ac.bd`.

#### Issue 164: First-Time Google OAuth Onboarding Cohort Misplacement Blindspot
- **Symptom**: If an administrator or CR configured a batch override for a dropout or re-admitted student *before* that student ever logged into ClassMate, the student was erroneously routed into their default admission cohort upon their initial Google sign-in instead of their target override batch.
- **Root Cause**:
  - In `create_or_initialize_profile()`, the profile creation pipeline ran standard session formula arithmetic (parsing the student's admission year from their email username and calculating their expected cohort) *before* checking `classmate.batch_overrides`.
  - Consequently, re-admitted students who had never signed in were pre-assigned to an obsolete batch, requiring manual database surgery or CR intervention.
- **Engineered Resolution**:
  - Restructured `create_or_initialize_profile()` so that **Step 5** (immediately following Owner, Teacher, and CR allowlists) performs an authoritative pre-check on `classmate.batch_overrides`:
    ```sql
    SELECT * INTO v_override
    FROM classmate.batch_overrides
    WHERE (email IS NOT NULL AND lower(email) = lower(u.email))
       OR (parsed_id IS NOT NULL AND upper(student_id) = parsed_id)
    LIMIT 1;
    ```
  - If a match is found:
    - Bypasses default session formulas completely.
    - Sets `p_batch_id = v_override.effective_batch_id`.
    - Binds `department_id` and `academic_session` from the target batch.
    - Sets `verification_status = 'active'` and `profile_source = 'auto'`.
  - Result: Zero friction, 100% deterministic cohort placement on Day 1.

#### Issue 165: Global App Update Push Notification Blackhole (`classmate.notification_recipients`)
- **Symptom**: Dispatched software releases (`classmate.enqueue_app_release()`) inserted an event of `kind = 'app_update'` into `notification_outbox`, but `classmate.notification_recipients(event_id)` returned zero recipients. No user received FCM push notifications for app updates.
- **Root Cause**:
  - The query in `notification_recipients` joined on `LEFT JOIN classmate.batches b ON b.id = e.batch_id AND b.department_id = e.department_id`.
  - For global software updates, `e.batch_id` is intentionally `NULL`.
  - The `WHERE` clause required `p.batch_id = b.id`, evaluating to `p.batch_id = NULL` (which is `false` in SQL three-valued logic), excluding all profiles.
- **Engineered Resolution**:
  - Restructured the recipient query into two clean branches:
    ```sql
    -- Branch 1: Global Platform Software Releases
    (e.kind = 'app_update' AND p.verification_status = 'active')
    OR
    -- Branch 2: Batch-Isolated Academic Events (Notices, Routine Changes, Cancellations, Files)
    (
      p.role = 'student'
      AND p.batch_id = b.id
      AND p.department_id = b.department_id
      AND p.verification_status = 'active'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM classmate.student_bans sb
        WHERE sb.profile_id = p.id AND sb.lifted_at IS NULL
          AND sb.starts_at <= now() AND sb.ends_at > now()
      )
    )
    ```
  - Production Verification: Dispatched release event `fa0083f8-6ffa-4a2d-82ee-d82505a8eaba` (v1.1.44) returned 135+ verified FCM tokens, restoring broadcast delivery.

#### Issue 166: Multi-Tenant Academic Notification Isolation Invariants
- **Symptom**: User concern that expanding the platform across universities (e.g., Mawlana Bhashani Science and Technology University and Rajshahi University) could cause notices, timetable changes, and bus transit alerts to bleed across institutions, generating confusion and bugs.
- **Root Cause & Design Audit**:
  - The multi-tenant architecture was audited across all layers: PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS), stored procedures, and the notification outbox recipient engine.
- **Verification & Resolution**:
  - Confirmed that all academic events (`notice`, `cancellation`, `routine_change`, `resource`) are strictly scoped by:
    `p.role = 'student' AND p.batch_id = b.id AND p.department_id = b.department_id`.
  - Live execution of `test_batch_isolation.py` against production PostgreSQL confirmed:
    - Notice dispatched to RU Fisheries Batch 25 produced recipients exclusively located within RU Fisheries Batch 25.
    - Notice dispatched to MBSTU CSE Batch 22 produced recipients exclusively located within MBSTU CSE Batch 22.
    - Zero cross-university or cross-department recipient bleed.
    - Active student bans (`student_bans`) cleanly excluded from receiving academic pushes.

#### Issue 167: UI Parity across Android APK and Next.js Web Companion for Polymorphic Identifiers
- **Symptom**: The Android APK configuration activity and Next.js Web companion management panel only prompted for "Student ID" and rejected email strings with client-side length restrictions.
- **Resolution**:
  - **Android Native Client (`ClassMateConfigurationActivity.kt`)**:
    - Form title changed to `"University Email or Student ID"`.
    - Input hint updated to `"e.g. s2110823125@ru.ac.bd or CE23045"`.
    - `InputFilter.LengthFilter` expanded from 30 to 60 characters.
    - Override item row layout enriched to display both student ID and university email alongside the target batch name and reason.
  - **Web Companion (`web/src/components/manage.tsx`)**:
    - Updated form labels and placeholders.
    - Updated client-side regex validation accepting either valid university email syntax or alphanumeric student ID.
    - Search input filters in real-time across both `override.email` and `override.student_id`.
    - Next.js production build (`npm --prefix web run build`) succeeded with 0 errors.
    - Deployed to Vercel production: `npx vercel --prod --yes --archive=tgz` at [https://classmatebd.vercel.app](https://classmatebd.vercel.app).

### 342.3 Full-Stack Architecture Standards & Multi-Tenant Invariants (v328 / v342)

The ClassMate architecture enforces five strict engineering invariants:

```
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                         CLASSMATE ARCHITECTURAL INVARIANTS (State v328 / v342)                    |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 1. ZERO HARDCODED INSTITUTIONAL LOGIC                                                             |
|    - Never write `if (university == "RU")`.                                                       |
|    - All tenant traits (weekend days, transit module, academic calendar, domain suffix) must be   |
|      dynamically loaded from `classmate.institutions` and cached in `ClassMateAcademicCache`.     |
|                                                                                                   |
| 2. POLYMORPHIC IDENTIFIER INGESTION                                                               |
|    - Systems accepting student identifiers must support either institutional email or student ID. |
|    - When email is provided, campus regex parsers extract the underlying examination roll.       |
|                                                                                                   |
| 3. ONBOARDING PRE-CHECK DETERMINISM                                                               |
|    - Always check `classmate.batch_overrides` before computing default session arithmetic.        |
|    - Re-admitted students must land in their active cohort on first sign-in without manual steps. |
|                                                                                                   |
| 4. STRICT MULTI-TENANT NOTIFICATION ISOLATION                                                     |
|    - Academic broadcasts (notices, cancellations, routine changes) MUST filter by `batch_id`     |
|      AND `department_id`.                                                                         |
|    - Global software updates (`app_update`) broadcast to all verified active profiles.            |
|                                                                                                   |
| 5. DUAL-REPOSITORY TOPOLOGY PARITY                                                                |
|    - All builds, release binaries, migrations, and memory docs must maintain bit-for-bit          |
|      synchronization across `AndroidStudioProjects/ClassMate` and `ClassMate-main`.             |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```
